app.py::BASE_DIR.text: The folder app.py lives in, used to find other files.

app.py::DB_FILE.text: The location of GovOS's database file (govos.db), next to app.py.
app.py::DB_FILE.tech: Absolute path os.path.join(dirname(abspath(__file__)), 'govos.db'); used by get_db_connection and the status route.

app.py::DIST_DIR.text: The folder holding the built website (dist), which the server sends to browsers in production.
app.py::DIST_DIR.tech: os.path.join(BASE_DIR, 'dist'); the only directory _serve_frontend serves files from (Flask static_folder is None).

app.py::FEED_MAX_AGE_SECONDS.text: How long a saved copy of a live feed (SSC notices, UPSC What's New, YouTube uploads) counts as fresh: 6 hours.
app.py::FEED_MAX_AGE_SECONDS.tech: 6 * 3600; staleness threshold used by _cache_get callers and _feed_cached.

app.py::FEED_MIN_FORCED_INTERVAL_SECONDS.text: A forced refresh of a feed less than a minute old just returns the saved copy, so the upstream site is not hammered.

app.py::FEED_RETRY_AFTER_FAILURE_SECONDS.text: After a feed fails to refresh, GovOS waits 15 minutes before trying that site again, unless forced.
app.py::FEED_RETRY_AFTER_FAILURE_SECONDS.tech: 15 * 60; back-off window checked in _feed_cached and used to prune _feed_failures.

app.py::HEALTH_MAX_AGE_SECONDS.text: How often each resource link is re-checked: every 12 hours.
app.py::HEALTH_MAX_AGE_SECONDS.tech: 12 * 3600; used by _health_due and reported by live_resources_status.

app.py::LEGACY_EXAM_ID_ALIASES.text: A tiny lookup table that translates an old exam code written by an earlier version of the app into the current code, so old saved practice attempts are not lost.
app.py::LEGACY_EXAM_ID_ALIASES.tech: Dict {'ssc-cgl-2026': 'exam-ssc-cgl-2026'}. Used by init_database's one-time migration of mock_attempts, _upsert_profile (target_exam_id), handle_mock_attempts, _merge_attempt and sync_all. Only documented, certain associations belong here.

app.py::LINK_MAX_REDIRECTS.text: How many times a checked link may forward to another address before GovOS stops following it (5).

app.py::LINK_MAX_TRACKED.text: The most links GovOS will keep on its regular health-check list (1000).
app.py::LINK_MAX_TRACKED.tech: 1000; cap on resource_link_health rows for health/sync registration; also bounds _recent_links to 4x this.

app.py::LINK_MAX_URLS.text: The most links one request may ask GovOS to check (60).

app.py::LINK_OUTBOUND_PER_MINUTE.text: The total number of fresh link checks GovOS will make per minute across all visitors (240), so it cannot be used to flood other websites.
app.py::LINK_OUTBOUND_PER_MINUTE.tech: 240; capacity and refill rate of the _LINK_BUDGET _OutboundBudget token bucket.

app.py::LINK_RATE.text: How many requests of each kind one visitor may make per minute (link verification, recheck, sync, channel uploads, scorecard reading).

app.py::LINK_REQUEST_DEADLINE_SECONDS.text: The longest a link-check request waits for all its links (30 seconds); anything still running is reported as timed out.
app.py::LINK_REQUEST_DEADLINE_SECONDS.tech: 30; timeout passed to concurrent.futures.wait in _check_links; unfinished checks are returned UNREACHABLE with refused='timed out' while the worker finishes in the background.

app.py::LINK_REUSE_SECONDS.text: A link checked within the last 5 minutes is answered from that check rather than fetched again.
app.py::LINK_REUSE_SECONDS.tech: 300; freshness window for the in-memory _recent_links cache read by _recent_link.

app.py::LINK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.text: How long GovOS waits for a website to respond when checking one link (6 seconds).
app.py::LINK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.tech: 6; socket timeout for each HEAD/GET in _check_one_link.

app.py::LINK_WORKERS.text: How many links GovOS checks at the same time, shared across all requests (8).

app.py::MAX_SOURCE_TEXT_CHARS.text: The most text (60,000 characters) GovOS keeps from one fetched source document.
app.py::MAX_SOURCE_TEXT_CHARS.tech: 60_000; truncation limit applied in _fetch_source_text before storing extracted_text.

app.py::MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES.text: The largest scorecard file a candidate may upload: 8 MB.
app.py::MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES.tech: 8 * 1024 * 1024; limit on the decoded upload in parse_result_document.

app.py::OCR_INSTALL_HINT.text: The install instruction shown when a candidate uploads a photo or scanned scorecard but the text-recognition (OCR) software is not installed on the server.
app.py::OCR_INSTALL_HINT.tech: "pip install rapidocr-onnxruntime pymupdf pillow numpy, then restart python app.py"; embedded in OCR_NOT_INSTALLED messages from parse_result_document.

app.py::OFFICIAL_HOSTS.text: A list of website addresses GovOS treats as official government or statutory bodies even when their address does not end in .gov.in or .nic.in (for example ibps.in, rbi.org.in and SSC's regional sites).
app.py::OFFICIAL_HOSTS.tech: Set of hostnames (SSC/UPSC/IBPS, RBI, SEBI, NABARD, NCERT, e-Gazette, PIB, ministries, SSC regional domains, etc.) consulted by _classify_trust; a 'www.' prefix is also accepted there.

app.py::OFFICIAL_SEARCH_DOMAINS.text: The official websites listed in the Trust Panel for display. It does not control the search itself.
app.py::OFFICIAL_SEARCH_DOMAINS.tech: List of domains returned as officialDomains by research_status; OFFICIAL-mode discovery filtering uses _classify_trust, not this list.

app.py::PROJECTION_MEMO_SIZE.text: How many prepared views of past website walks GovOS keeps in memory for quick reuse (32).

app.py::SSC_ATTACHMENT_BASE.text: The start of the address SSC uses for notice attachments; GovOS adds each file's path to it to make a working link.

app.py::SSC_NOTICE_API.text: The address of SSC's public notice-board service that GovOS reads for the latest notices.

app.py::SYLLABUS_CHANGE_WORDS.text: The words in a notice headline that suggest it might change a syllabus (corrigendum, addendum, revision, amendment, syllabus, scheme of exam, pattern, and so on).
app.py::SYLLABUS_CHANGE_WORDS.tech: Case-insensitive regex corrigend|addend|revis|amend|modif|syllab|scheme of exam|pattern|notice of; applied to headlines in _syllabus_watch_items.

app.py::TRUSTED_PUBLIC_HOSTS.text: Specific websites (PRS India and the Internet Archive) treated as trustworthy public sources, though not official.

app.py::TRUSTED_PUBLIC_SUFFIXES.text: Address endings (such as .ac.in or .edu) that GovOS treats as trustworthy public institutions, though not official.
app.py::TRUSTED_PUBLIC_SUFFIXES.tech: ('.ac.in', '.edu', '.edu.in', '.res.in', '.org.in'); hosts ending in these classify as TRUSTED_PUBLIC in _classify_trust.

app.py::UPSC_WHATS_NEW_URL.text: The address of UPSC's 'What's New' page that GovOS reads for new items.

app.py::_OutboundBudget.text: A rationing counter for outgoing link checks: it holds a number of 'tokens' that refill steadily each minute, and each check spends one.
app.py::_OutboundBudget.tech: Thread-safe token bucket of per_minute capacity, refilled continuously; take(n) spends n tokens or returns False without spending. Instantiated as _LINK_BUDGET.

app.py::_OutboundBudget.__init__.text: Creates the rationing counter, full, with a given per-minute allowance.
app.py::_OutboundBudget.__init__.tech: __init__(per_minute, clock=time.monotonic): capacity and tokens = float(per_minute), stamp = clock(), and a threading.Lock. The clock is injectable for tests.

app.py::_OutboundBudget.take.text: Tries to spend a number of tokens; says yes and spends them if enough are available, otherwise says no and spends nothing.
app.py::_OutboundBudget.take.tech: take(n): under lock, refills tokens by elapsed*capacity/60 (capped at capacity), updates stamp; returns False if n > tokens, else subtracts n and returns True.

app.py::_PublicRedirects.text: A rule for link checking: when a website forwards to another address, follow it only if the new address is also a public website, and only up to five times.
app.py::_PublicRedirects.tech: urllib HTTPRedirectHandler subclass with max_redirections = LINK_MAX_REDIRECTS; redirect_request validates newurl with _public_link.

app.py::_PublicRedirects.redirect_reques.text: Called each time a checked website forwards elsewhere; refuses the hop if the new address is not public.
app.py::_PublicRedirects.redirect_reques.tech: Calls _public_link(newurl); if not ok raises urllib.error.URLError('redirect refused: <why>'), else defers to the parent implementation.

app.py::_addition_row.text: Turns one stored verifier-added resource into the format the library shows, working out its source label fresh.
app.py::_addition_row.tech: Maps a resource_additions row to {id, title, url, subject, resourceFormat, author, description, addedAt, addedFrom, findingId, examId, sourceKind: _addition_source_kind(url, exam_id)}.

app.py::_addition_source_kind.text: Decides how a verifier-added link is labelled, using the server's own rule on every read: official only if it is on the exam's own authority's website; government site if it is another Indian government website; trusted public; or third party. The label is never stored or taken from the request, so a coaching site cannot be passed off as official.
app.py::_addition_source_kind.tech: _addition_source_kind(url, exam_id='') -> 'OFFICIAL' | 'GOVERNMENT_SITE' | 'TRUSTED_PUBLIC' | 'THIRD_PARTY'. Looks the exam up in _sources_exam_store(); OFFICIAL when estate_of(bare_host(url)) equals _exam_estate(exam); else _classify_trust 'OFFICIAL' -> GOVERNMENT_SITE, otherwise mapped via _ADDITION_SOURCE_KIND (UNVERIFIED -> THIRD_PARTY). No exam -> no official estate.

app.py::_admin_rate_limited.text: Limits how often even an administrator can start expensive Claude operations per minute, so a stuck script cannot burn through usage.
app.py::_admin_rate_limited.tech: _admin_rate_limited(scope, limit=20): tools.claude_cli.routes.LIMITER.allow('<scope>:<remote_addr>', limit, 60); returns None or a (jsonify({error:'RATE_LIMITED', retryAfter}), 429) tuple.

app.py::_age_seconds.text: How many seconds ago a stored time was; an unreadable time counts as infinitely old.

app.py::_attempt_details.text: Collects the extra details of a practice attempt (the paper and the candidate's answers) from an incoming save, ignoring empty entries so they cannot overwrite stored data. It also accepts the older layout where those details were sent at the top level.
app.py::_attempt_details.tech: _attempt_details(m): copies present entries of m['details'] (if a dict), then adds top-level userAnswers / paperData when present and not already set. Returns the dict.

app.py::_background_channel_refresh.text: During the hourly background run, refreshes the uploads of every YouTube channel GovOS has seen before.
app.py::_background_channel_refresh.tech: Reads cache keys LIKE 'yt-%' from live_feed_cache, strips the 'yt-' prefix and calls _channel_uploads_cached(keys, in_request=False).

app.py::_background_refresh_loop.text: The background routine that runs every hour once the server is up: it re-checks links that are due (up to 80 at a time), refreshes SSC's notices, UPSC's What's New and the YouTube uploads. Each step runs on its own, so one failure does not skip the others.
app.py::_background_refresh_loop.tech: Sleeps 20 s, then loops forever: steps link health (_recheck_links(_health_due()[:80])), _ssc_notices_cached(in_request=False), _upsc_whatsnew_cached(in_request=False), _background_channel_refresh, each in its own try/except with a log line; sleeps 3600 s. Feeds only re-fetch when past their own interval.

app.py::_bind_host.text: Decides which network address the server listens on. By default only this computer can reach it; a deployment that must be reachable from other machines has to set GOVOS_HOST deliberately.
app.py::_bind_host.tech: _bind_host(env=None) -> env['GOVOS_HOST'] stripped, or '127.0.0.1' when unset or empty. Used by __main__ for app.run.

app.py::_budget_exhausted.text: The reply sent when GovOS has used up its per-minute allowance of link checks: try again in a minute.
app.py::_budget_exhausted.tech: Returns a 429 response {error:'OUTBOUND_BUDGET', retryAfter:60, message} with Retry-After: 60.

app.py::_cache_get.text: Reads a saved copy of a live feed from the database and says when it was fetched, whether the last refresh failed, and whether it is now out of date.
app.py::_cache_get.tech: _cache_get(key, max_age) -> None or {payload (JSON-decoded), fetchedAt, error, stale: age > max_age} from live_feed_cache.

app.py::_cache_put.text: Saves a fresh copy of a live feed in the database with the current time.
app.py::_cache_put.tech: _cache_put(key, payload, error=None): INSERT OR REPLACE into live_feed_cache with fetched_at = _now_iso(); commits.

app.py::_channel_uploads_cached.text: Gets the latest uploads for several YouTube channels, each through its own saved copy, using the same refresh rules as the notice boards. Several channels are fetched in parallel.
app.py::_channel_uploads_cached.tech: _channel_uploads_cached(channel_ids, force=False, in_request=True) -> {cid: {items, fetchedAt[, error]}}; each via _feed_cached('yt-<cid>', ...). One id runs inline; more use a ThreadPoolExecutor(8).

app.py::_check_link_once.text: Checks one link, making sure that if several requests ask about the same link at the same moment, only one real check is made and they all share the answer.

app.py::_check_links.text: Checks a list of links and returns a result for each, in order. Recently checked links reuse their earlier result; the rest are checked in parallel, and any that take too long are reported as unreachable. If the per-minute allowance would be exceeded, nothing is checked.
app.py::_check_links.tech: _check_links(urls, spend_budget=True): reuses _recent_link hits (adds reused=True); if fresh URLs and spend_budget and not _LINK_BUDGET.take(len(fresh)) -> returns None. Submits _check_link_once to _LINK_POOL, waits up to LINK_REQUEST_DEADLINE_SECONDS; unfinished or failed futures become {status:'UNREACHABLE', httpCode:0, checkedAt, refused:'timed out'}. Returns a list in input order.

app.py::_check_one_link.text: Checks whether one link opens, the way a browser would: it first asks politely for just the headers, then tries a normal request, and reports the link as healthy, redirected, blocked, broken or unreachable. It only contacts public addresses and never downloads the page's content.
app.py::_check_one_link.tech: _check_one_link(url) -> {url, status, httpCode, checkedAt[, refused]}. Non-public URL -> UNREACHABLE with refused reason. Opener with HTTPCookieProcessor and _PublicRedirects and a browser-like UA; tries HEAD then GET (timeout LINK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS). Success: REDIRECT if the final URL differs and code is 3xx, else HEALTHY. HTTPError on HEAD is ignored (falls to GET); on GET 401/403/429 -> BLOCKED, other -> BROKEN. Other exceptions -> UNREACHABLE. Body never read.

app.py::_classify_trust.text: Labels a web address by how much it can be trusted: official (Indian government addresses ending .gov.in or .nic.in, or a listed statutory body), trusted public (universities, PRS, the Internet Archive), or unverified (everything else). A US '.gov' address is not treated as official.
app.py::_classify_trust.tech: _classify_trust(url) -> 'OFFICIAL' | 'TRUSTED_PUBLIC' | 'UNVERIFIED' from the lower-cased hostname: OFFICIAL_HOSTS (with or without 'www.'), or suffix .gov.in/.nic.in; then TRUSTED_PUBLIC_HOSTS or TRUSTED_PUBLIC_SUFFIXES. Passed to AppHooks as classify_trust.

app.py::_claude_candidate.text: Converts one of Claude's checked proposals (a field, a value and the quoted words it came from) into a fact GovOS can validate. The value is converted into the field's type by fixed rules; anything that will not convert is dropped, never repaired. Claude-read facts get modest confidence.
app.py::_claude_candidate.tech: _claude_candidate(proposal) -> fact dict or None. Maps the field via _CLAUDE_FIELD_MAP; DATE: ISO yyyy-mm-dd validated or parsed with _extract_date; INTEGER via _INT_RE; URL trailing punctuation stripped. evidence = quote, extraction_rule 'claude:EXTRACT_FIELDS[ @ location]', confidence 0.6 typed / 0.5 text. Quote verification happened earlier in the job handler.

app.py::_claude_gateway.text: Gives the rest of app.py the single shared connection point to the Claude assistant.
app.py::_claude_gateway.tech: Returns tools.claude_cli.get_gateway() (the process-wide ClaudeGateway set at import with SqliteAuditSink and DecisionCache).

app.py::_claude_queue.text: Gives app.py the single shared background job queue for Claude work.
app.py::_claude_queue.tech: Returns _CLAUDE_QUEUE, created with the blueprint by create_blueprint(DB_FILE, _CLAUDE_HOOKS) at import.

app.py::_claude_unavailable_response.text: The reply sent when the Claude assistant is switched off or not ready on this server. It says how to set it up, and treats this as a server problem, never as a fact about an exam authority.
app.py::_claude_unavailable_response.tech: _claude_unavailable_response(health) -> 503 {error:'CLAUDE_UNAVAILABLE', available:false, status, message, setup (install, `claude auth login`, GOVOS_CLAUDE_ENABLED=1, restart)}.

app.py::_clean_ocr_text.text: Tidies text read from a scorecard before it is searched: fixes common misreadings ('seore' to 'score'), turns '158,75' or '158:75' into '158.75', and joins digits that were printed with spaces between them.
app.py::_clean_ocr_text.tech: Regex passes: 'seore'->'score', 'catl'->'cat1' (case-insensitive); [,:] between digits -> '.'; whitespace around a dot between digits removed; up to 3 passes joining single digits separated by whitespace; dot spacing removed again. Returns the string.

app.py::_close_request_connections.text: Runs at the end of every web request and closes any database connections that request opened, so a request that crashed cannot leave the database locked.
app.py::_close_request_connections.tech: @app.teardown_request handler: closes every conn in g._govos_conns (swallowing errors), which rolls back uncommitted work, then resets the list.

app.py::_exam_estate.text: Works out an exam's authority 'estate': the main registered domain of its official website (for example upsc.gov.in).
app.py::_exam_estate.tech: _exam_estate(exam): estate_of(bare_host(exam['officialDomain'])) using tools.exam_authoring.sources and tools.exam_builder.source_trust; '' when no officialDomain.

app.py::_exam_registry.text: Gives the one shared store of machine-built exams for this database, creating it the first time.
app.py::_exam_registry.tech: Caches tools.exam_builder.materialize.ExamRegistry(DB_FILE) in _exam_registries keyed by DB_FILE, so its DDL and commit run once rather than per request.

app.py::_extract_date.text: Finds the first proper date in a piece of text and returns it in a standard form along with the exact words it came from. Numeric dates are read day-first, as Indian notices write them; written months like '27 February 2026' or 'February 27, 2026' are also understood.
app.py::_extract_date.tech: _extract_date(text) -> (iso, matched_text) or (None, None). Tries, in order, dd[./-]mm[./-]yy(yy), 'd(st|nd|rd|th)? Month yyyy', 'Month d, yyyy' (month by first three letters via _MONTHS); each validated by _to_iso.

app.py::_extract_facts.text: Reads the text of one research result and picks out possible facts (such as the last date, vacancies or official website) using fixed word cues and patterns, with no AI. A fact is produced only when a cue word appears and a value of the right kind is found near it; it never guesses, and at most one fact per field is taken from each result.
app.py::_extract_facts.tech: _extract_facts(finding) -> list of {field, value_type, value, raw_value, evidence, extraction_rule:'cue:<regex>', confidence}. Text = snippet + extracted_text. For each _FACT_FIELDS entry, the first cue that matches defines a 200-char window: DATE via _extract_date, URL via _URL_RE in window or whole text (falls back to the finding's url for official_website/notification/previous_papers), INTEGER via _INT_RE (commas stripped), TEXT = first sentence/clause of at least 8 chars. De-duplicated by (field, value); confidence 0.4 +0.2 for typed values +0.1 for multi-word cues, capped 0.95.

app.py::_fact_row.text: Turns one stored fact from the database into the format the Trust Panel shows.
app.py::_fact_row.tech: Maps a research_facts row to camelCase keys {id, findingId, runId, examId, examName, field, rawValue, value, valueType, sourceUrl, sourceTitle, sourceType, evidence, extractionRule, confidence, status, validationNotes (JSON list, or [raw] if unparsable), conflictGroup, retrievedAt, reviewedAt}.

app.py::_fact_source_type.text: Translates a source's trust label into the fact layer's labels: official stays official, trusted public becomes high, everything else low.

app.py::_feed_cached.text: The one way GovOS reads any live feed. A fresh saved copy is returned straight away. An out-of-date copy is also returned at once while a refresh runs in the background, so visitors never wait on a slow government site. With no copy yet, or when forced, it fetches now, and a feed that failed recently is not retried for 15 minutes.
app.py::_feed_cached.tech: _feed_cached(key, fetch, *, force=False, in_request=True): fresh and not forced -> cached; forced but younger than FEED_MIN_FORCED_INTERVAL_SECONDS -> cached; not forced and within the failure back-off -> _feed_failed; stale with copy in a request -> _feed_refresh_behind and return the stale copy; else synchronous _feed_refresh.

app.py::_feed_failed.text: When a feed refresh fails, returns the last good copy marked with the error, or an empty result that says why.
app.py::_feed_failed.tech: _feed_failed(cached, error): sets cached['error'] = 'refresh failed: <error>' and returns it; with no cache returns {payload:[], fetchedAt:None, error, stale:True}.

app.py::_feed_fetch.text: Fetches one feed from its website now and saves it. If another fetch has just refreshed it, that result is used. If the fetch fails, the failure is noted and the last good copy is returned.
app.py::_feed_fetch.tech: _feed_fetch(key, fetch, cached): re-reads the cache and returns it if fresh and newer than `cached`; otherwise calls fetch(previous payload). Exception -> _feed_record_failure + _feed_failed. Success -> _cache_put, clears the failure, returns {payload, fetchedAt, error:None, stale:False}.

app.py::_feed_record_failure.text: Notes that a feed just failed so GovOS waits before retrying it, and forgets old failures whose waiting time is over.
app.py::_feed_record_failure.tech: _feed_record_failure(key, error): prunes _feed_failures entries older than FEED_RETRY_AFTER_FAILURE_SECONDS, then stores (time.time(), str(error)) for key.

app.py::_feed_refresh.text: Makes sure only one fetch of a given feed runs at a time; anyone else asking meanwhile waits for and shares that one result.

app.py::_feed_refresh_behind.text: Starts refreshing an out-of-date feed in the background, unless a refresh is already running.
app.py::_feed_refresh_behind.tech: If not _feed_flights.in_flight(key), starts a daemon thread 'govos-feed-<key>' running _feed_refresh.

app.py::_fetch_channel_uploads.text: Fetches the newest videos (up to four) from a YouTube channel's public feed, with no API key. A reply that is not a proper feed counts as a failure.
app.py::_fetch_channel_uploads.tech: _fetch_channel_uploads(channel_id): GET youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id= (timeout 20 s), parses XML; root must be an Atom <feed> else ValueError. Returns up to 4 [{videoId, title, published (yyyy-mm-dd), url}]; entries without a videoId are skipped.

app.py::_fetch_source_text.text: Downloads one research result's document once, safely, and pulls out its readable text, with no AI involved. It refuses documents that are too large, not a PDF or web page, unreadable, or scanned images with no text, and says why.
app.py::_fetch_source_text.tech: _fetch_source_text(url) -> (text, None, None) or (None, failure, reason). Uses tools.claude_cli.discovery.fetch_checked (keep_body, SOURCE_MAX_BYTES, SOURCE_MAX_SECONDS; public address on every hop, TLS verified) and tools.exam_authoring.sources.document_from_bytes. Failures: 'SOURCE_FETCH_FAILURE' (fetch error/TLS, truncated, wrong content type, parse error) or 'SCANNED_DOCUMENT'. Text truncated to MAX_SOURCE_TEXT_CHARS.

app.py::_fetch_ssc_notices.text: Fetches the latest 40 notices from SSC's public notice board, newest first, turning each attachment into a working link and flagging notices about the CGL exam. A reply that does not contain SSC's own list counts as a failure, so the last good copy is kept instead of showing an empty board.
app.py::_fetch_ssc_notices.tech: GET SSC_NOTICE_API with page=1, limit=40, createdAt DESC, attachments, English and the required attributes list (timeout 25 s). Raises ValueError if data['data'] is not a list. Returns [{id, headline (whitespace-collapsed), createdAt (yyyy-mm-dd), files:[{name, url: SSC_ATTACHMENT_BASE+path, sizeKb}], isCgl ('combined graduate level' or 'cgl' in headline)}].

app.py::_fetch_upsc_whatsnew.text: Reads UPSC's 'What's New' page and lists its items, newest first. The page shows no dates, so GovOS records the day it first saw each item and keeps that date across refreshes. Items about the Civil Services exam are flagged. A page without the usual list counts as a failure, not as 'nothing new'.
app.py::_fetch_upsc_whatsnew.tech: _fetch_upsc_whatsnew(previous): GET UPSC_WHATS_NEW_URL (25 s); raises ValueError if 'class="views-row' is absent. Splits on views-row blocks (4000 chars each), takes the first href, strips tags and unescapes, absolutises the URL against www.upsc.gov.in and encodes spaces. id = sha1(url)[:16]; headline (300), kind/examName split on the first ':', isCse by /civil services/i, firstSeen carried from previous by id else today.

app.py::_finding_row_to_dict.text: Turns one stored research result from the database into the format the Trust Panel shows, including what the server itself checked about the source.
app.py::_finding_row_to_dict.tech: Maps a research_findings row to {id, runId, title (falls back to url), url, snippet, trustLevel, score, publishedDate, reviewStatus, hasExtractedText, createdAt, discovery: _loads_or_none(meta_json)}.

app.py::_health_due.text: Lists the links that have never been checked or were last checked more than 12 hours ago.
app.py::_health_due.tech: URLs from _health_rows() with no checkedAt or _age_seconds(checkedAt) > HEALTH_MAX_AGE_SECONDS.

app.py::_health_rows.text: Reads the stored link-check results, for all links or for a given list.
app.py::_health_rows.tech: _health_rows(urls=None) -> [{url, status, httpCode, checkedAt}] from resource_link_health (WHERE url IN (...) when urls is given).

app.py::_ingest_claude_facts.text: Called when a Claude reading job finishes: it takes Claude's quote-checked proposals for one research result and stores them through the same validation as every other fact.
app.py::_ingest_claude_facts.tech: AppHooks.ingest_facts hook: _ingest_claude_facts(finding_id, accepted). Loads the finding and its run; builds candidates via _claude_candidate; _reachability on the finding url; _store_candidates; commit; _read_back_facts. Returns {stored, summary, factIds}, or {stored:0} for an unknown finding. Always closes its connection.

app.py::_int_arg.text: Reads a number from the web address (for example a limit), keeping it within a safe range; if it is not a number, a default is used instead of crashing.
app.py::_int_arg.tech: _int_arg(name, default, lo, hi): int(request.args.get(name) or default), falling back to default on TypeError/ValueError, clamped to [lo, hi].

app.py::_link_limiter.text: Provides the one shared per-visitor rate limiter used by the link-checking routes, creating it the first time it is needed.
app.py::_link_limiter.tech: Lazily creates and caches a module-global _LINK_LIMITER = tools.claude_cli.security.RateLimiter() (detected via NameError) and returns it.

app.py::_link_rate_limited.text: Checks whether this visitor has made too many requests of one kind in the last minute; if so it returns a 'slow down' reply telling them when to try again.
app.py::_link_rate_limited.tech: _link_rate_limited(scope): _link_limiter().allow('<scope>:<remote_addr>', LINK_RATE[scope], 60). Returns None when allowed, else a 429 response {error:'RATE_LIMITED', retryAfter} with a Retry-After header.

app.py::_link_urls_from_request.text: Reads the list of links from a link-check request, drops anything that is not a web address and any repeats, and refuses requests with too many links before doing any work.
app.py::_link_urls_from_request.tech: Returns (urls, None) or (None, error). Body must have a non-empty list 'urls' else 400 'urls[] is required'; more than LINK_MAX_URLS -> 413 {error:'TOO_MANY_URLS', limit, message}. Keeps http(s) strings, de-duplicated in order; empty result -> 400.

app.py::_load_dotenv.text: Reads GovOS's own settings from the local .env file when the server starts. It only picks up settings whose names begin with GOVOS_ (plus PORT), so any other secret in that file is never loaded, and a missing or unreadable file does not stop the server.
app.py::_load_dotenv.tech: Reads BASE_DIR/.env with utf-8-sig (strips a Notepad BOM); skips blank, '#' and '='-less lines; for keys starting 'GOVOS_' or equal to 'PORT' calls os.environ.setdefault with the value stripped of whitespace and quotes (existing env vars win). OSError/UnicodeError are swallowed. Called once at import.

app.py::_load_finding.text: Called by a Claude reading job to get one stored research result and the page text the server itself fetched (never text supplied by Claude).
app.py::_load_finding.tech: AppHooks.load_finding hook: joins research_findings with research_runs; returns {id, url, title, text (extracted_text or ''), trust, examId, examName (run query)} or None.

app.py::_loads_or_none.text: Reads stored structured text back into data, returning nothing if it is empty or damaged.
app.py::_loads_or_none.tech: json.loads(text) if text else None; ValueError -> None.

app.py::_merge_attempt.text: Stores a practice attempt, or updates the one already saved with the same id. A later save may add or correct information but never erase it, and an attempt id already filed under a different exam or user is refused and left alone.
app.py::_merge_attempt.tech: _merge_attempt(cursor, user_id, m, exam_id) -> 'INSERTED' | 'MERGED' | 'CONFLICT'. Casts score/total_marks (float) and count/time fields (int) only when non-None (may raise TypeError/ValueError). New id: INSERT with zero defaults, subject default 'Full Mock', details_json from _attempt_details or NULL. Existing: CONFLICT if user_id differs or stored exam_id (legacy-mapped) differs; else merges details dicts (incoming over stored), updates present numbers, topic_id/subject, and details_json only when changed. Does not commit.

app.py::_now_iso.text: The current local time as standard text, to the second.

app.py::_overlay_row.text: Turns one stored exam fact overlay (a checked correction or addition to an exam's facts) into the format the app uses.
app.py::_overlay_row.tech: Maps an exam_fact_overlays row to {id, examId, cycle, domain, targetId, targetScope, kind, value, provenance, status, supersedesId, previousValue, effectiveDate, conflictNote, createdAt, createdBy, retired}, JSON-decoding the *_json columns.

app.py::_parse_scorecard.text: Reads the text of an uploaded scorecard and picks out what it can: roll number, category, name, exam year, any printed 'qualified' or 'not qualified' statement, and the marks. It recognises UPSC, IBPS and SSC-style scorecards (by the exam chosen or by words in the document) and looks for each one's own marks (for example UPSC Prelims Paper-I, IBPS Prelims, SSC Tier-1). It also offers a list of other plausible numbers so the candidate can pick the right one, and says how confident the reading is. Nothing is final until the candidate confirms it.
app.py::_parse_scorecard.tech: _parse_scorecard(text, exam_id='') -> (fields, confidence, notes). Cleans via _clean_ocr_text. Detects UPSC/IBPS/APPSC from exam_id substrings or regexes (APPSC detection is computed but unused). Common: rollNumber (labelled 6-12 digits, else any 7-11 digits), category (near Cat/Category/Community lines, then whole text; numeric codes map via cat_code_map; UPSC 'General' vs 'UR'), candidateName, examYear, declared QUALIFIED/NOT_QUALIFIED. UPSC branch: upscPrelimsGs1Marks (20-200, also marks), upscPrelimsCsatMarks, upscMainsWrittenMarks (300-1750), upscInterviewMarks (50-275), upscFinalTotalMarks (400-2025), allocatedPost/allocatedService; HIGH if GS1 or Mains found. IBPS branch: ibpsPrelimsMarks (10-100, also marks), ibpsMainsMarks (20-225), ibpsInterviewMarks; HIGH if prelims found. Default SSC branch (examType 'SSC_CGL'): cuts the skill-test and allocation blocks, then tier1Marks, Normalized/Raw marks by several priorities, tier2Marks (direct or the sum of the first two 3-5-decimal figures), marksCandidates (top 8 plausible values in 20-700, excluding roll/year numbers and round totals), allocatedPost, computerKnowledgeMarks (0-60), destMistakesPercent (0-50). Confidence HIGH (marks+category) / MEDIUM / LOW.

app.py::_persist_discovery.text: Called when a Claude research job finishes: it saves the run and each suggested source as a result awaiting review. Each source's trust level is the weaker of where it started and where it finally led, so a redirect can lower trust but never raise it.
app.py::_persist_discovery.tech: AppHooks.persist_discovery hook: _persist_discovery(manifest, mode, exam_id, job_id). INSERTs research_runs (engine 'CLAUDE_DISCOVERY', manifest_json = full manifest); for each candidate with url INSERTs research_findings with trust = lowest of trust/finalTrust by _TRUST_RANK, snippet capped 1200 chars, meta_json of the server's checks (authorityName, documentKind, whyRelevant, reachable, httpStatus, finalUrl, finalTrust, identity, reasons). Commits; returns run_id.

app.py::_present.text: A small check for whether a value actually says something: not missing and not an empty list, text or set of fields.
app.py::_present.tech: Returns value is not None and not (dict/list/str of length 0). Used by _attempt_details and _merge_attempt.

app.py::_public_link.text: Decides whether a web address is a normal public website that GovOS may check. It refuses non-web addresses, addresses with passwords in them, raw IP addresses, local names, unusual ports, and anything that points into a private network. A malformed address is refused rather than crashing.
app.py::_public_link.tech: _public_link(url) -> (bool, reason). Uses validate_url_syntax and resolves_public from tools.claude_cli.discovery; catches ValueError/TypeError/OSError (incl. UnicodeError) and returns (False, 'not a valid web address (...)'). Never raises.

app.py::_reachability.text: Checks in parallel whether each source address opens, before anything is written to the database, so slow checks never hold the database locked.
app.py::_reachability.tech: _reachability(urls) -> {url: bool}: de-duplicates non-empty urls, runs _check_one_link on a ThreadPoolExecutor (max 8), True for HEALTHY/REDIRECT, False on exceptions. Returns {} for no urls.

app.py::_read_back_facts.text: Re-reads the facts just saved so the reply shows their final state, since a later conflict can change an earlier fact's status.
app.py::_read_back_facts.tech: _read_back_facts(cursor, stored, summary): SELECTs each id, converts via _fact_row, increments summary[status]; returns the list.

app.py::_recent_link.text: Looks up whether a link was checked in the last few minutes and, if so, returns that result.
app.py::_recent_link.tech: _recent_link(url): reads _recent_links under lock; returns the stored result if younger than LINK_REUSE_SECONDS (monotonic), else None.

app.py::_recheck_links.text: Checks a list of links and saves the results, making sure only one such sweep runs at a time.
app.py::_recheck_links.tech: _recheck_links(urls) -> bool. Guarded by _health_lock/_health_running (returns False when a sweep is running); _check_links(urls, spend_budget=False) then _store_health; logs; True. The flag is reset in finally.

app.py::_remember_link.text: Stores the result of a link check so it can be reused for a few minutes, discarding the oldest entries if the memory grows too large.
app.py::_remember_link.tech: _remember_link(result): stores (monotonic time, result) under result['url'] in _recent_links; evicts oldest insertion-order entries beyond 4*LINK_MAX_TRACKED; returns result.

app.py::_revision_row.text: Turns one stored syllabus revision into the format the app uses.
app.py::_revision_row.tech: Maps a syllabus_revisions row to {id, examId, kind, topicId, topic (JSON-decoded or None), note, noticeTitle, noticeUrl, noticeDate, appliedAt, appliedBy}.

app.py::_run_row_to_dict.text: Turns one stored research run and its results into the format the Trust Panel shows.
app.py::_run_row_to_dict.tech: _run_row_to_dict(run, findings) -> {id, query, mode, examId, answer, resultCount, createdAt, engine, jobId, findings}.

app.py::_serve_frontend.text: Sends the built GovOS website, and nothing else, to the browser. Real files inside the build folder are sent as they are; any other page address gets the main page so the app can show it; anything that looks like a hidden or repository file (such as .env or the database) gets 'not found'. If the website has not been built yet, it says so.
app.py::_serve_frontend.tech: _serve_frontend(path): 503 {error:'FRONTEND_NOT_BUILT', message} when dist/index.html is missing. Splits path on '/', 404 if any segment starts with '.' or contains ':'. Existing file under DIST_DIR -> send_from_directory; last segment containing '.' but no file -> 404; otherwise dist/index.html (SPA fallback).

app.py::_source_store.text: Gives the one shared store of recorded website walks for this database, creating it the first time.

app.py::_sources_exam_store.text: Gives the source-discovery routes the same exam lookup the background jobs use, so both agree on what an exam is.

app.py::_ssc_notices_cached.text: Reads SSC's notice board through the shared feed cache.

app.py::_start_background_refresh.text: Starts the hourly background refresh routine when the server is launched.
app.py::_start_background_refresh.tech: Starts a daemon thread 'govos-live-refresh' running _background_refresh_loop. Called from __main__.

app.py::_store_candidates.text: Runs every proposed fact from one research result through the validation rules and saves it for human review. Facts from the rule-based reader and from Claude go through the same path. When a conflict is found, earlier facts for the same field are marked conflicting too.
app.py::_store_candidates.tech: _store_candidates(cursor, finding, exam_id, exam_name, candidates, reachable_cache, stored, summary): exam_key = exam_id or exam_name or 'unknown'; sets source_url; _validate_fact; duplicates counted and skipped; on 'conflicting' sets conflict_group '<exam_key>:<field>' and UPDATEs existing pending/validated rivals to conflicting; INSERTs into research_facts (with JSON notes) and appends lastrowid to stored. Logs each decision. Does not commit.

app.py::_store_health.text: Saves link-check results in the database, replacing older results for the same links.
app.py::_store_health.tech: INSERT OR REPLACE into resource_link_health (url, status, http_code, checked_at) for each result; commits.

app.py::_syllabus_watch_items.text: Finds notices on an exam's official board that could change its syllabus and are newer than the date the syllabus was last verified. It works for SSC exams (using SSC's own notice dates) and UPSC exams (using the date GovOS first saw each item, since UPSC prints none); other exams have no board wired yet.
app.py::_syllabus_watch_items.tech: _syllabus_watch_items(exam_id, since): exam_id starting 'exam-ssc' -> cached SSC items with isCgl, createdAt > since and SYLLABUS_CHANGE_WORDS match; 'exam-upsc' -> UPSC items with isCse, firstSeen > since and a match, reshaped into SSC-shaped {id, headline, createdAt: firstSeen, files:[{name, url, sizeKb:0}], isCgl:false} plus a note. Returns {items, fetchedAt, stale, error, source[, note]} or None. Note the SSC branch filters on isCgl for every SSC exam.

app.py::_to_iso.text: Turns a day, month and year into a standard date (like 2026-02-27), treating two-digit years as 2000s; returns nothing for an impossible date.
app.py::_to_iso.tech: _to_iso(day, mon, year): adds 2000 when year < 100; returns datetime(year, mon, day).date().isoformat() or None on ValueError.

app.py::_upsc_whatsnew_cached.text: Reads UPSC's What's New list through the shared feed cache.

app.py::_upsert_profile.text: Saves only the profile details a request actually contains. Earlier versions filled every missing detail with an SSC default, which erased the candidate's choices; this one leaves absent details untouched and translates an old exam code to the current one.
app.py::_upsert_profile.tech: _upsert_profile(cursor, user_id, data): takes non-None keys of _PROFILE_FIELDS (username, target_post_id, target_exam_id, category, qualification, dob), maps target_exam_id through LEGACY_EXAM_ID_ALIASES. New user: INSERT with '' defaults and username 'Candidate'; existing: UPDATE only present fields plus updated_at. Returns sorted list of written field names. Does not commit.

app.py::_valid_url.text: Checks that a text is a well-formed web address starting with http or https.
app.py::_valid_url.tech: _valid_url(url) -> bool: urlparse scheme in (http, https) and non-empty netloc; ValueError -> False.

app.py::_validate_fact.text: Checks one proposed fact against fixed rules before it is stored for review: it must have a value and a valid source, its date or link must be well formed, an identical copy must not already exist, and the source must open. If another source gives a different value, both are kept and marked as conflicting; GovOS never picks a winner.
app.py::_validate_fact.tech: _validate_fact(cursor, fact, exam_key, reachable_cache) -> (status, notes). 'rejected' for missing field/value/source_url, invalid source or URL value, unparsable ISO date. 'duplicate' when same COALESCE(exam_id, exam_name)+field+value+source_url exists. Conflict if a pending/validated/conflicting row has a different value from a different source -> 'conflicting'. Reachability from reachable_cache or _check_one_link (HEALTHY/REDIRECT). 'validated' needs reachable and confidence >= 0.6, else 'pending'.

app.py::build_runtime_exam.text: Starts a background job (administrators only) that builds one exam from its authority's own documents into GovOS's exam store. The caller gives only the exam's name and year, and may allow Claude to review undecided points. Nothing is published unless the existing publication check passes.
app.py::build_runtime_exam.tech: POST /api/exams/build, @admin_required. Body {query|exam (required, 400), year|cycle, claude|useClaude=false}. _admin_rate_limited('exam-build', limit=6) -> 429; with Claude requested and not ready -> 503. Submits 'BUILD_EXAM' {query, year, useClaude} with cycle=year (ValueError -> 400). 202 {jobId, status, deduplicated, pollUrl}.

app.py::clear_user_interactions.text: Deletes all of the candidate's recorded activities.
app.py::clear_user_interactions.tech: DELETE /api/sqlite/interactions?user_id=: deletes the user's user_interactions rows; returns {success:true, cleared_for}.

app.py::exam_discovered_sources.text: Tells an exam's page what the most recent walk of its authority's website found for each section. If the site has never been walked, it says so honestly, as a gap in GovOS rather than a statement about the authority. Results are kept in memory so repeated page loads are quick.
app.py::exam_discovered_sources.tech: GET /api/sources/exam/<exam_id>: unknown exam -> 404. Estate via _exam_estate; latest run via _source_store().latest_id(estate); none -> {examId, state:'NOT_DISCOVERED', estate, note}. Cycle from the exam or the id's year suffix. LRU _projection_memo keyed by (DB_FILE, exam_id, run_id, estate, title, authorityName, officialDomain, cycle); on miss runs authority_discovery.project_for_exam and adds {state:'DISCOVERED', estate}.

app.py::exam_overlays.text: Lists or registers checked fact overlays for one exam. Listing returns only active, verified (or confirmed not-published) overlays, optionally for one cycle or area. Registering is for administrators only, and the server validates the overlay and refuses anything not already verified.
app.py::exam_overlays.tech: GET|POST /api/exams/<exam_id>/overlays. GET ?cycle=&domain=: non-retired rows with status VERIFIED/NOT_PUBLISHED and kind != 'CONFLICT', by created_at -> {overlays}. POST (admin_denied guard): ExamFactOverlay.from_dict (error -> 400), validate_overlay errors -> 400 {details}, status not VERIFIED/NOT_PUBLISHED -> 400; OverlayStore(DB_FILE).record -> 201 {overlay}.

app.py::get_db_connection.text: Opens a connection to the database. If another part of the app is writing at the same moment, it waits up to 30 seconds instead of failing. Connections opened during a web request are remembered so they can be closed automatically when the request ends.
app.py::get_db_connection.tech: sqlite3.connect(DB_FILE, timeout=30) with row_factory=sqlite3.Row. Inside a Flask request context it appends the connection to g._govos_conns so _close_request_connections closes (and rolls back) it at teardown, preventing a raised route from leaving a write lock held.

app.py::get_runtime_exam.text: Returns one automatically built, published exam, optionally for a given cycle (year).
app.py::get_runtime_exam.tech: GET /api/exams/<exam_id>?cycle=: _exam_registry().get(exam_id, cycle); None -> 404 {error, examId}; else {exam, origin:'MACHINE_ACQUIRED', registry: rec.meta()}.

app.py::get_sqlite_status.text: A health check for the database. It reports that the database is reachable, where the file is, how big it is, and how many profiles, completed modules, practice attempts, bookmarks, notes, tracked exams and notifications it holds.
app.py::get_sqlite_status.tech: GET /api/sqlite/status. Runs COUNT(*) on users, study_progress (is_completed=1), mock_attempts, bookmarked_resources, candidate_notes, tracked_exams, candidate_notifications. 200 {status:'connected', db_type, db_file, db_size_kb, stats{users, completed_modules, mock_attempts, bookmarks, notes, tracked_exams, notifications}}; any exception -> 500 {status:'error', message}.

app.py::get_user_interactions.text: Lists the candidate's 100 most recent recorded activities (such as viewing an exam).
app.py::get_user_interactions.tech: GET /api/sqlite/interactions?user_id=: up to 100 user_interactions rows by timestamp DESC, metadata_json decoded (bad JSON -> None). Returns {interactions:[{id, type, targetId, targetType, examId, categoryTag, timestamp, metadata}]}.

app.py::handle_bookmarks.text: Reads or changes the candidate's saved resources (the 'Saved' shelf in the Resource Library).
app.py::handle_bookmarks.tech: GET|POST /api/sqlite/bookmarks?user_id=. GET: {user_id, resource_ids, bookmarks:[{resourceId, title, resourceType, url, bookmarkedAt}]} newest first. POST {resource_id, is_bookmarked=True, title, resource_type, url}: missing resource_id -> 400; INSERT OR IGNORE or DELETE on bookmarked_resources; returns {status:'updated', user_id, resource_ids}.

app.py::handle_mock_attempts.text: Saves and lists the candidate's practice-test results. The list can be limited to one exam, and that filter happens inside the database so another exam's results never leave it. Every saved attempt must say which exam it belongs to; sending the same attempt twice merges it rather than failing.
app.py::handle_mock_attempts.tech: GET /api/sqlite/mock-attempts?user_id=&exam_id=: up to 50 rows newest first (filtered by exam_id in SQL when given), details parsed from details_json; returns {user_id, attempts:[...]}. POST: id defaults to 'mock-<hex>'; missing exam_id -> 400; legacy id mapped; _merge_attempt -> INSERTED (201), MERGED (200), CONFLICT (409 when the id is stored under another exam/user); TypeError/ValueError from bad numbers -> 400. Response {status:'saved', attempt_id, outcome}.

app.py::handle_notification_preferences.text: Reads or saves how the candidate wants to be alerted (channels, contact details, which events, reminder timing). If nothing has been saved yet it says so plainly, instead of returning defaults that the app might mistake for the candidate's choice.
app.py::handle_notification_preferences.tech: GET|POST /api/sqlite/notifications/preferences?user_id=. GET: stored row -> {user_id, channels, contactInfo, eventSubscriptions, reminderSchedule} (JSON-decoded); none -> {user_id, stored:false}. POST: JSON-encodes each field (defaults: inApp-only channels, empty contact, {} subscriptions/schedule) and upserts notification_preferences; returns {status:'saved', user_id}.

app.py::handle_notifications.text: Lists, saves or clears the candidate's in-app alerts. Saving an alert that already exists does nothing, so repeated saves do not create duplicates.
app.py::handle_notifications.tech: GET|POST|DELETE /api/sqlite/notifications?user_id=. GET: up to 100 candidate_notifications newest first as {id, examId, eventType, title, message, channelsDelivered (default ['IN_APP']), actionType (default 'EXAM_DETAIL'), actionPayload, priority, isRead, createdAt}. POST: body {notifications:[...]} or a single item; INSERT OR IGNORE each item with an id, with defaults; returns {status:'saved', inserted_count} (counts attempted inserts, including ignored ones). DELETE: removes all rows for the user, returns {status:'cleared'}.

app.py::handle_profile.text: Reads or saves the candidate's profile (name, target post and exam, category, qualification, date of birth). Saving only changes the details actually sent, so saving one detail never wipes the others.
app.py::handle_profile.tech: GET|POST /api/sqlite/profile?user_id= (default 'default-candidate'). GET: 200 with id, username, target_post_id, target_exam_id, category, qualification, dob from users; missing user -> 404 {id, target_post_id:'post-aso-css'}. POST: JSON body passed to _upsert_profile, commit, 200 {status:'saved', user_id, updated:[field names], target_post_id}.

app.py::handle_progress.text: Reads or saves which study modules the candidate has marked complete.
app.py::handle_progress.tech: GET|POST /api/sqlite/progress?user_id=. GET: {user_id, completed_modules:{module_id: bool}} from study_progress. POST {module_id, is_completed=True, post_id, stage}: upsert on (user_id, module_id) updating is_completed and completed_at; nothing written when module_id is missing. Returns {status:'saved', module_id, is_completed}.

app.py::handle_tracked_exams.text: Reads or changes the list of exams a candidate is following. Sending an exam with 'tracked' on adds it, with it off removes it, and the updated list is returned.
app.py::handle_tracked_exams.tech: GET|POST /api/sqlite/tracked-exams?user_id=. GET: {user_id, tracked_exam_ids} newest first. POST {exam_id, is_tracked=True}: missing exam_id -> 400; INSERT OR IGNORE or DELETE on tracked_exams, then returns {status:'updated', user_id, tracked_exam_ids}.

app.py::init_database.text: Sets up the database when the server starts: creates every table GovOS needs if it is missing, adds newer columns to older tables, and creates a blank default candidate (no exam, post or category is assumed). It also moves practice attempts saved under an old exam code to the current code, and prints a warning for any attempt whose exam cannot be identified, without changing it.
app.py::init_database.tech: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for users, study_progress, mock_attempts, bookmarked_resources, candidate_notes, audit_reports, tracked_exams, notification_preferences, candidate_notifications, research_runs, research_findings, research_facts (+2 indexes), resource_link_health, live_feed_cache, syllabus_revisions, resource_additions, user_interactions (+index), exam_fact_overlays (+index), exam_registry. Adds columns via PRAGMA table_info checks (research_runs.engine/job_id/manifest_json, research_findings.meta_json, resource_additions.exam_id), backfills engine='LEGACY_SEARCH' and resource_additions.exam_id='exam-ssc-cgl-2026' where NULL, calls init_job_tables, init_audit_tables, init_source_tables. Inserts 'default-candidate' with empty fields if absent. Rewrites mock_attempts.exam_id via LEGACY_EXAM_ID_ALIASES and prints '[SQLite] REVIEW:' for exam_ids not starting 'exam-'. Runs at import time, so importing app.py touches the real govos.db.

app.py::list_reports.text: Lists the most recent error reports candidates have submitted about GovOS's data, for the Trust Panel.
app.py::list_reports.tech: GET /api/reports: up to 100 audit_reports rows newest first, returned as {reports:[{id, entityType, entityId, description, status, submittedAt}]}. No admin guard.

app.py::list_runtime_exams.text: Lists the exams GovOS has built automatically from authorities' documents and published (in addition to the hand-written ones in the app).

app.py::list_source_runs.text: Lists recorded website walks for administrators.

app.py::live_channel_uploads.text: Returns the newest videos for up to 16 YouTube channels shown in the Resource Library. Anything that is not a genuine YouTube channel id is ignored.
app.py::live_channel_uploads.tech: GET /api/resources/live/channel-uploads?ids=UC...,UC...&refresh=1. _link_rate_limited('channels') -> 429; more than 16 ids -> 413 TOO_MANY_CHANNELS; keeps ids fully matching _YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID (de-duplicated); none -> {channels:{}}. Else {channels: _channel_uploads_cached(ids, force), intervalHours}.

app.py::live_resources_status.text: Reports when SSC's and UPSC's notice feeds were last fetched, when links were last checked, how many links are on the check list and how many have not been checked yet.
app.py::live_resources_status.tech: GET /api/resources/live/status: reads the 'ssc-notices' and 'upsc-whatsnew' cache rows and resource_link_health. Returns {sscFetchedAt, upscFetchedAt, healthLastRun (max checked_at), healthTracked, healthPending, feedIntervalHours, healthIntervalHours}.

app.py::live_ssc_notices.text: Returns the latest notices from SSC's notice board, by default only those about the CGL exam, with when they were fetched and whether the copy is out of date or the last refresh failed.
app.py::live_ssc_notices.tech: GET /api/resources/live/ssc-notices?scope=cgl|all&limit=(1-40, default 8)&refresh=1. Uses _ssc_notices_cached(force); scope 'cgl' keeps isCgl items. Returns {items, total (unfiltered), scope, fetchedAt, stale, error, source:'https://ssc.gov.in/notice-board', intervalHours}.

app.py::live_upsc_notices.text: Returns the latest items from UPSC's What's New page, by default only those about the Civil Services exam. Because UPSC's page shows no dates, it notes that each item is dated by when GovOS first saw it.
app.py::live_upsc_notices.tech: GET /api/resources/live/upsc-notices?scope=cse|all&limit=(1-40, default 8)&refresh=1. Uses _upsc_whatsnew_cached; scope 'cse' keeps isCse items. Returns {items, total, scope, fetchedAt, stale, error, source: UPSC_WHATS_NEW_URL, intervalHours, note}.

app.py::llm_health_removed.text: An old address for checking a local AI model, which GovOS no longer has. It now answers 'removed' and points to the Claude health check instead.

app.py::mark_notification_read.text: Marks one of the candidate's alerts, or all of them, as read.
app.py::mark_notification_read.tech: POST /api/sqlite/notifications/read?user_id= {notification_id}: 'ALL' updates every row for the user, otherwise the matching id; nothing when absent. Returns {status:'marked_read', user_id, notification_id}.

app.py::parse_result_document.text: Reads an uploaded scorecard (a PDF, or a photo or scan if text-recognition software is installed) and returns the marks and details it found for the candidate to check. The file is read in memory and never stored. It refuses empty, oversized or unsupported files with a clear message, warns that OCR can misread digits, and suggests typing the marks in when the file cannot be read.
app.py::parse_result_document.tech: POST /api/results/parse {contentBase64, filename, examId}. _link_rate_limited('scorecard') -> 429. Decode failure 400 UNREADABLE; empty 400 EMPTY; > MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES 400 TOO_LARGE. Non-PDF: not an image -> 200 NOT_A_PDF; no OCR -> 200 OCR_NOT_INSTALLED; image_header_size + check_image_size, then decode_isolated('image', ocr=True). PDF: preflight_pdf, decode_isolated('pdf', ocr=_ocr_available()); text layer under 30 chars and no OCR -> 200 OCR_NOT_INSTALLED. UploadRejected -> its reason/status; a failed decode -> its status (default 422). Text under 8 chars -> 200 NO_TEXT_FOUND. Otherwise _parse_scorecard and returns {ok:true, method TEXT_LAYER|OCR, fields, confidence, notes (+OCR warning), excerpt (600 chars), storedOnServer:false}. Decoding runs in tools/scorecard_decode (capped, isolated child process).

app.py::queue_authority_discovery.text: Starts a background job (administrators only) that walks an exam authority's own website to map what it publishes. It only starts from an exam GovOS already holds, at its official address; the caller cannot supply an address. Claude may optionally help classify links.
app.py::queue_authority_discovery.tech: POST /api/sources/discover {examId|exam_id, useClaude|claude}, @admin_required. Missing id -> 400; unknown exam -> 404; _admin_rate_limited('source-discovery', 6) -> 429; Claude requested and not ready -> 503. Submits 'DISCOVER_AUTHORITY' {examId[, useClaude:true]} (ValueError -> 400). 202 {jobId, status, deduplicated, pollUrl}.

app.py::research_extract.text: Fetches and saves the readable text of a stored research result so a verifier (or, if asked, Claude) can read the original document. Administrators only, and the server only fetches that result's own address, never one supplied by the caller.
app.py::research_extract.tech: POST /api/research/extract {finding_id}, @admin_required. Non-int id -> 400; unknown -> 404. Calls _fetch_source_text; failure -> 200 {results:[{url, rawContent:'', chars:0, failed:true, failure, reason}]}; success stores research_findings.extracted_text and returns {results:[{url, rawContent: first 20000 chars, chars, failed:false}]}.

app.py::research_facts_extract.text: Turns already-stored research results into checked facts for human review (administrators only). By default a fixed rule-based reader does it immediately; if Claude is requested, one result is read by Claude as a background job and only values whose quotations appear in the page are kept. It publishes nothing.
app.py::research_facts_extract.tech: POST /api/research/facts/extract, @admin_required. Body {finding_id | run_id, claude?, fields?}; neither id -> 400. claude: needs finding_id (400), _admin_rate_limited('research-extract'), Claude ready (503), submits 'EXTRACT_FIELDS' {findingId, fields} -> 202 {jobId, status, deduplicated, pollUrl}. Otherwise loads findings (404 if none), _extract_facts each, _reachability before writes, _store_candidates, commit, returns {facts, summary, count}.

app.py::research_facts_list.text: Lists stored facts for the Trust Panel, optionally filtered by run, status, exam or result, with conflicting facts grouped together first.
app.py::research_facts_list.tech: GET /api/research/facts?run_id=&status=&exam_id=&finding_id=: equality filters; ORDER BY conflict_group IS NULL, conflict_group, field, id. Returns {facts:[_fact_row], count}.

app.py::research_facts_status.text: Lets an administrator set a fact's review status (for example approve or reject it). Approving only makes the fact eligible for the existing promotion step; this route publishes nothing.
app.py::research_facts_status.tech: POST /api/research/facts/<int:fact_id>/status, @admin_required. Body {status} default 'approved'; must be pending|validated|conflicting|rejected|approved else 400; unknown id -> 404. Updates status and reviewed_at. Returns {status:'updated', factId, newStatus}.

app.py::research_finding_detail.text: Shows one research result in full, including any text already fetched from its document.
app.py::research_finding_detail.tech: GET /api/research/findings/<int:finding_id>: 404 if absent; _finding_row_to_dict plus extractedText ('' when none).

app.py::research_finding_status.text: Lets an administrator mark a research result as pending, reviewed, promoted or rejected. This records a decision only; it publishes nothing.
app.py::research_finding_status.tech: POST /api/research/findings/<int:finding_id>/status, @admin_required. Body {status} default 'REVIEWED'; must be PENDING_REVIEW|REVIEWED|PROMOTED|REJECTED else 400. UPDATE research_findings.review_status (no existence check). Returns {status:'updated', finding_id, new_status}.

app.py::research_history.text: Lists recent research runs with their results for the Trust Panel.
app.py::research_history.tech: GET /api/research/history?limit= (default 15, clamped 1-50, bad value -> 15): research_runs newest first, each with its findings via _finding_row_to_dict. Returns {runs:[...]}.

app.py::research_run_detail.text: Shows one research run with all its results, most trustworthy sources first.
app.py::research_run_detail.tech: GET /api/research/runs/<int:run_id>: 404 if absent; findings ordered by id, then sorted by _TRUST_RANK (OFFICIAL, TRUSTED_PUBLIC, UNVERIFIED). Returns {run: _run_row_to_dict(...)}.

app.py::research_search.text: Starts a background research job (administrators only) in which Claude suggests possible sources for a question; the server then checks every suggestion itself. Nothing found here becomes official because Claude said so, and nothing reaches candidates from here.
app.py::research_search.tech: POST /api/research/search, @admin_required. Body {query (required, else 400), mode ('OFFICIAL' default, anything else 'ANY'), max_results=8, exam_id?}. _admin_rate_limited('research-search') -> 429; Claude not ready -> 503 via _claude_unavailable_response. Submits a 'DISCOVER_SOURCES' job on _claude_queue() (ValueError -> 400). 202 {jobId, status, deduplicated, pollUrl:'/api/claude/jobs/<id>'}.

app.py::research_status.text: Reports the state of the Trust Panel's research tool: whether Claude is ready, whether an admin token is required, the official domains list, how many research runs exist and how many results await review.
app.py::research_status.tech: GET /api/research/status: _claude_gateway().health(); counts research_runs and research_findings with review_status PENDING_REVIEW. Returns {available, engine:'CLAUDE_DISCOVERY', claude: health, adminTokenRequired, officialDomains, runCount, pendingReview}.

app.py::resource_additions.text: Lists or adds links that a verifier has added to one exam's Resource Library. Anyone can list them (optionally for one exam); only an administrator can add. An addition must name its exam; one claiming to come from research must come from a result a person promoted and use that result's own link; the label (official or not) is decided by the server; and adding the same link twice to the same exam returns the existing entry. The new link is checked straight away.
app.py::resource_additions.tech: GET|POST /api/resources/additions. GET ?exam_id=: non-retired rows (filtered when given), newest first -> {additions}. POST (admin_denied guard): requires title and http(s) url (400), examId matching [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,120} (400); optional findingId must be an int (400), exist (400), be PROMOTED (409) and have the same url (409). Format: given resourceFormat or DIRECT_PDF for .pdf / OFFICIAL_PORTAL if OFFICIAL / EXTERNAL_PAGE; OFFICIAL_PORTAL is downgraded unless OFFICIAL. Default description depends on kind. BEGIN IMMEDIATE de-dup on (exam_id, url) -> {addition, deduplicated:true, health}; else INSERT, _store_health([_check_one_link(url)]), returns {addition, health}.

app.py::resource_health_recheck.text: Behind the library's 'Verify all links now' button: checks the given links immediately and saves the results for the next visitor. Links checked in the last few minutes reuse that check.
app.py::resource_health_recheck.tech: POST /api/resources/health/recheck {urls}. _link_rate_limited('recheck') -> 429; URL errors 400/413; _check_links None -> 429 OUTBOUND_BUDGET. Stores results without a 'refused' key via _store_health. Returns {results, checked}.

app.py::resource_health_sync.text: Called when the Resource Library loads: it adds the library's links to GovOS's regular check list and returns what is already known about them. New links are checked in the background, and the page asks again a little later. Only valid web addresses are added, up to a fixed limit, and background checks count toward the per-minute allowance.
app.py::resource_health_sync.tech: POST /api/resources/health/sync {urls}. _link_rate_limited('sync') -> 429; _link_urls_from_request errors. INSERT OR IGNORE new URLs as PENDING into resource_link_health while total < LINK_MAX_TRACKED and validate_url_syntax passes. Unchecked URLs start a daemon _recheck_links thread if no sweep is running and _LINK_BUDGET.take(n) succeeds. Returns {results: checked rows only, pending, lastRun, intervalHours}.

app.py::retire_exam_overlay.text: Retires one exam fact overlay so it no longer applies (administrators only).

app.py::retire_resource_addition.text: Hides a verifier-added resource again (administrators only). Nothing is deleted.
app.py::retire_resource_addition.tech: POST /api/resources/additions/<addition_id>/retire, @admin_required: sets retired=1; 404 when no row changed; else {retired: id}.

app.py::retire_syllabus_revision.text: Undoes a syllabus revision by retiring it (administrators only), so the syllabus returns to what it was. Nothing is deleted.
app.py::retire_syllabus_revision.tech: POST /api/syllabus/revisions/<revision_id>/retire, @admin_required: sets retired=1; 404 if no row changed; else {retired: id}.

app.py::save_user_interaction.text: Records one activity of the candidate (for example viewing an exam), with when it happened and what it was about.
app.py::save_user_interaction.tech: POST /api/sqlite/interactions: accepts camelCase or snake_case fields; defaults id 'act-<ms>', type 'VIEW', target_type 'EXAM', timestamp now in ms; user_id from body or query. INSERT OR REPLACE into user_interactions. 201 {success:true, id}.

app.py::serve_index.text: Sends the GovOS website's main page when someone opens the site's home address.

app.py::serve_static_or_fallback.text: Catches every other web address and hands it to the website-serving rule, so links inside the app open the right page.
app.py::serve_static_or_fallback.tech: Route GET '/<path:path>' -> _serve_frontend(path). API routes registered explicitly take precedence.

app.py::source_run_coverage.text: Shows administrators how much of an authority's website one walk actually covered and what it left unread.

app.py::submit_report.text: Receives an error report from a candidate (what it is about and their description) and puts it in the review queue.
app.py::submit_report.tech: POST /api/reports {entityType='Unknown', entityId='', description=''}: INSERT into audit_reports (status defaults PENDING_REVIEW). 201 {status:'success', message, data: echoed body}.

app.py::syllabus_revisions.text: Lists or records verifier changes to an exam's syllabus (add, amend or retire a topic). Anyone can list them; only an administrator can record one. Every change must cite a notice link or give a reason, and an identical active change is not recorded twice.
app.py::syllabus_revisions.tech: GET|POST /api/syllabus/revisions. GET ?exam_id=: non-retired rows by applied_at ASC -> {revisions}. POST (admin_denied guard) {examId, kind ADD|AMEND|RETIRE, topicId, topic, noticeUrl, noticeTitle, noticeDate, note, appliedBy}: 400 for missing exam/kind, missing topicId on AMEND/RETIRE, missing topic on ADD/AMEND, ADD without subject+topicName, non-http(s) noticeUrl, or neither noticeUrl nor note. Topic fields sanitised (lengths, up to 20 subtopics, tier default 'BOTH'). BEGIN IMMEDIATE de-dup on identical active fields -> {revision, deduplicated:true}; else INSERT into syllabus_revisions and return {revision}.

app.py::syllabus_watch.text: The web endpoint behind the Syllabus section's watch banner: lists notices that may have changed the syllabus since it was verified, or says plainly that no live board is wired for this exam.
app.py::syllabus_watch.tech: GET /api/syllabus/watch?exam_id=&since=: returns _syllabus_watch_items(...), or {items:[], fetchedAt:None, stale:false, error:None, source:None, note:'No live notice board is wired for this exam yet.'} when it returns None.

app.py::sync_all.text: Copies everything the browser holds for the candidate (profile, completed modules, practice attempts) into the database in one go. Attempts without an exam are skipped and reported, and attempts that clash with another exam's are reported, rather than guessed.
app.py::sync_all.tech: POST /api/sqlite/sync-all {user_id, profile, completed_modules, mock_attempts}. In one transaction: _upsert_profile if profile is a non-empty dict; upserts study_progress per module; for each attempt dict with id, maps legacy exam ids, skips those with no exam_id, calls _merge_attempt and collects CONFLICTs. 200 {status:'synchronized', db_type, user_id, skippedAttemptsWithoutExamId, conflictingAttempts}; exception -> rollback, 500 {status:'error', message}.

app.py::update_report_status.text: Lets a verifier mark a submitted error report as resolved, rejected or back to pending. Only an administrator may do this.
app.py::update_report_status.tech: POST /api/reports/<int:report_id>/status, @admin_required. Body {status} default 'RESOLVED'; must be PENDING_REVIEW|RESOLVED|REJECTED else 400. UPDATE audit_reports; returns {status:'updated', report_id, new_status} (no check that the id exists).

app.py::verify_resource_links.text: The web endpoint the Resource Library uses to check whether its links open. The server does the checking because browsers are not allowed to test other websites directly. It applies the per-visitor and per-minute limits.
app.py::verify_resource_links.tech: POST /api/resources/verify-links {urls:[...]}. _link_rate_limited('verify') -> 429; _link_urls_from_request errors (400/413); _check_links None -> 429 OUTBOUND_BUDGET. 200 {results:[{url, status, httpCode, checkedAt, ...}], checked}. Results are not stored in the database.

src/data.ts::ALL_EXAMS.text: The list of the seven exams written into GovOS by hand: SSC CGL, UPSC CSE, IBPS PO, APPSC Group-I, APPSC Group-II the Special TG TET 2026-II and JEE (Main) 2026. Automatically built exams from the server are added to these at run time.
src/data.ts::ALL_EXAMS.tech: Exported `Exam[]` = [SSC_CGL_EXAM, UPSC_CSE_EXAM, IBPS_PO_EXAM, APPSC_GROUP1_EXAM, APPSC_GROUP2_EXAM, TG_TET_INSERVICE_2026_II_EXAM, JEE_MAIN_2026_EXAM]; the authored register passed to `getExamUniverse` and exported to exam_data/authored_exams.json.

src/data.ts::ALL_OFFICIAL_QUESTIONS.text: The complete list of real official exam questions GovOS holds, across all exams. Today that is only the eight UPSC essay topics, because the other authorities publish no readable papers.
src/data.ts::ALL_OFFICIAL_QUESTIONS.tech: Module-private `OfficialPaperQuestion[]` = `[...UPSC_OFFICIAL_QUESTIONS]`; must not be read by engines directly, only through `officialQuestionsForExam`.

src/data.ts::ALL_POST_STUDY_PATHS.text: The post-by-post study plans for SSC CGL: seven posts (Assistant Section Officer, Income Tax Inspector, Excise Inspector, Junior Statistical Officer, CBI Sub-Inspector, Tax Assistant and Auditor). Each lists which Tier-1 and Tier-2 study blocks apply, which are excluded, the computer and typing test expectations, and whether physical or medical standards apply.
src/data.ts::ALL_POST_STUDY_PATHS.tech: Exported Record<postId, PostStudyPath> keyed 'post-aso-css', 'post-iti', 'post-excise', 'post-jso', 'post-si-cbi', 'post-tax-assistant-cbdt', 'post-auditor-cag'. Tier-1 uses the four MODULE_TIER1_* blocks; Tier-2 the six Paper-I/CKT/DEST blocks, with post-jso adding Paper-II Statistics and the rest excluding it. computerQualifyingThreshold / destTypingThreshold vary per post; physicalMedical.required is true for excise and CBI SI (colour blindness not allowed). Read via getPostStudyPath and examHasStudyPaths.

src/data.ts::ANTONYM_ITEMS.text: Ten hand-written antonym questions: pick the word opposite in meaning to a given word.
src/data.ts::ANTONYM_ITEMS.tech: CuratedItem[10] mapped from [word, answer, wrong[3], why] tuples, GovOS-authored citation. Concatenated after VOCAB_ITEMS to form genSynonym.

src/data.ts::APG1_AUTHORITY.text: The name of the authority that runs APPSC Group-I, written once so every Group-I citation names it the same way.
src/data.ts::APG1_AUTHORITY.tech: 'Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC)' — authorityName on every apg1() provenance and the record's authorityName.

src/data.ts::APG1_CHECK.text: The day GovOS read the Group-I notification, stamped on every Group-I citation as its check date.
src/data.ts::APG1_CHECK.tech: '2026-10-07' — verifiedDate and the verifiedBy wording of apg1().

src/data.ts::APG1_LANGUAGE_QUALIFYING.text: What the notice says about the Mains Telugu and English papers: they must be passed (40% / 35% / 30% by category) but are not counted for merit.
src/data.ts::APG1_LANGUAGE_QUALIFYING.tech: ExamPatternNode['qualifying'] {asPrinted (para 12.8), qualifyingOnly: true, countsTowardsMerit: false} — shared by the two language-paper nodes; the study plan gives them the average share for it.

src/data.ts::APG1_MAINS.text: The words GovOS uses for the second stage of Group-I, the descriptive Main examination.
src/data.ts::APG1_MAINS.tech: 'Main Examination' — stage tier and syllabus topic tier for the Main examination rows.

src/data.ts::APG1_NOTICE.text: The one document the Group-I record is read from: APPSC Notification No. 07/2026, dated 06/10/2026 — its title, address and publication date.
src/data.ts::APG1_NOTICE.tech: {title, url (psc.ap.gov.in/Documents/NotificationDocuments/Group_I_07_2026.pdf), published '2026-10-06'} as const; documentTitle / officialUrl / publishedDate of apg1().

src/data.ts::APG1_PAPERS.text: The papers of Group-I as Annexure-II prints their headings — the Screening Test’s two papers and the Main examination’s Telugu, English and Papers I–V — with their marks and pages.
src/data.ts::APG1_PAPERS.tech: Record<'S-I'|'S-II'|'M-T'|'M-E'|'M-I'…'M-V', {title, marks, page}>; titles are the syllabus headings, used for the tree's paper nodes and each topic's clauseNumber.

src/data.ts::APG1_SCREENING.text: The words GovOS uses for the first stage of Group-I, the objective Screening Test, so the stage, its syllabus topics and its date all name it alike.
src/data.ts::APG1_SCREENING.tech: 'Screening Test' — stage tier, syllabus topic tier for Annexure-II's Screening Test rows, and a date's stageLabel. Results pathways match topics to stages by this tier string.

src/data.ts::APG1_SITE.text: The Commission’s own website, where candidates register (OTPR), apply, and download Hall Tickets.
src/data.ts::APG1_SITE.tech: 'https://psc.ap.gov.in' — officialDomain, every portal link and every OTR step's portalUrl in APPSC_GROUP1_EXAM.

src/data.ts::APG1_SYLLABUS_ROWS.text: Annexure-II’s syllabus, item by item: 32 Screening Test items (History, Polity, Economy, Geography; Mental Ability, Science and Technology, Current Events) and 54 Main examination items (the two language papers, the essay and Papers II–V). Each keeps the notice’s opening words for its citation and GovOS’s split of the item into sub-topics.
src/data.ts::APG1_SYLLABUS_ROWS.tech: Apg1SyllabusRow[] (86 rows, pp. 27–39). Subjects are shared across the two stages (History & Culture, Polity & Governance, Economy, Geography, Science & Technology) plus Mental & Psychological Abilities, Current Affairs, Telugu/English (Qualifying), General Essay and Ethics & Law. No weightage: APPSC prints none.

src/data.ts::APG1_SYLLABUS_TOPICS.text: The Group-I syllabus as the list the Syllabus section, the tick-boxes, the tree map and the study plan all read: one topic per row, each citing the page it is printed on, with no invented weightage.
src/data.ts::APG1_SYLLABUS_TOPICS.tech: APG1_SYLLABUS_ROWS.map → SyllabusTopic {id 'syl-appsc1-<slug>', subject, tier APG1_SCREENING|APG1_MAINS, topicName, subtopics, weightagePercentage 0, avgQuestions 0, isHighYield false, officialProvenance apg1(…)}.

src/data.ts::APG1_SYLLABUS_TREE.text: The same syllabus in the notice’s own layout — stage, then paper, then part (where the paper has parts), then item — for the Official Syllabus view.
src/data.ts::APG1_SYLLABUS_TREE.tech: Built from APG1_SYLLABUS_ROWS: two Stage nodes (Screening Test, Main Examination) → Paper nodes (APG1_PAPERS titles) → Part nodes only where the paper prints parts → Item nodes with the sub-topics as their note and the topic's own provenance. Ids are unique by construction.

src/data.ts::APPSC_GROUP1_EXAM.text: The APPSC Group-I Services exam, read on 2026-10-07 from the Commission’s Notification No. 07/2026: 166 vacancies in 13 posts with their age bands and pay scales, the application window (06–27 October 2026), the corrections window, the Screening Test on 24 January 2027, the three stages (an objective Screening Test that only shortlists, a descriptive Mains with qualifying Telugu and English papers, an interview), the full syllabus, the fee and its exemptions, age relaxations, certificates, Hall Ticket rules, exam-day rules, and 14 FAQs — every value cited to its page. It replaced a record with invented dates, vacancies, a cut-off and a practice question. Its eligibility cards include the minimum qualifying marks (40% / 35% / 30%), so 'what are the qualifying marks' is answered from the notice. Its library links 21 study resources.
src/data.ts::APPSC_GROUP1_EXAM.tech: Exam {id 'exam-appsc-group1-2026', posts via apg1Post (Post Code 04 carries a B.E./B.Tech. branch rule), dates (no Mains date: 'announced later'), ageRelaxations (SC/ST/BC/EWS 5, PBD 10, service-based ones as conditions), stages Screening Test / Main Examination (meritMarks 750) / INTERVIEW, patternTree, admitCardEvents (release rule only), syllabus APG1_SYLLABUS_TOPICS + syllabusTree, cutoffsHistory [], applicationGuide with certificateRules (BC NCL, EWS) and fee rules, examDayChecklist, eligibilityHighlights, officialLinks}. Keeps the resource library added on 2026-10-06.

src/data.ts::APPSC_GROUP2_EXAM.text: GovOS's short placeholder record of the Andhra Pradesh PSC Group-II Services Exam 2026, for posts such as Municipal Commissioner Grade-III, Sub-Registrar and Secretariat ASO. It holds three posts, four dates, two stages, two syllabus topics and an application guide, none of them read from an APPSC document yet, so every fact on it shows as not verified. It is a separate exam from Group-I. Its library links 20 study resources, and the syllabus page, old papers and keys sit in their own sections.
