src/data.ts::APPSC_GROUP2_EXAM.tech: `Exam` id 'exam-appsc-group2-2026', categoryTag STATE_PSC, vacanciesTotal '897 (Executive & Non-Executive)'. posts (3), dates (4), stages (2), syllabus (2), practiceQuestions, cutoffsHistory, faqs, applicationGuide, roadmapTracks; the record's own facts cite `appscProvenance` (a placeholder: no URL, no quote, UNDER_VERIFICATION). resources: entries built with openResource / coachingSource, filtered to Group-II; the apsdps.ap.gov.in and cse.ap.gov.in cards were removed on 2026-10-07 because those hosts stopped answering.

src/data.ts::Apg1SyllabusRow.text: The shape of one line of the Group-I syllabus as GovOS stores it: which stage and paper it belongs to, its subject, a short name, the page, the notice’s opening words and its sub-topics.
src/data.ts::Apg1SyllabusRow.tech: [slug, stage S|M, paper key (APG1_PAPERS), part heading, subject, topic name, page, excerpt as printed, subtopics[]] — a tuple type read by APG1_SYLLABUS_TOPICS and APG1_SYLLABUS_TREE.

src/data.ts::CHECK_DATE.text: The date (9 September 2026) on which GovOS checked that its library links were working; it is stamped on those links' source records.
src/data.ts::CHECK_DATE.tech: Module-private string '2026-09-09', used as publishedDate and verifiedDate by `officialSource`, `communitySource` and `pendingSource`.

src/data.ts::CLASSIFICATION_CONFIRMED.text: A list of SSC CGL posts whose Group (B or C) is actually printed in SSC's notice, each with the quoted line from the post table. GovOS uses it to show a post's group as SSC's own word only where SSC printed it.
src/data.ts::CLASSIFICATION_CONFIRMED.tech: Exported `Record<string, DataProvenance>` keyed by post id, about 40 SSC entries built with `sscNotice` from Para 2.1-2.5 (pages 2-4). ui.tsx's `classificationIsConfirmed` checks membership, and the post card prints 'Classification printed in <documentTitle>'; absence means the record's reading, not a contradiction.

src/data.ts::COMPUTER_ITEMS.text: Ten hand-written computer basics questions, such as what CPU stands for or which shortcut undoes an action.
src/data.ts::COMPUTER_ITEMS.tech: CuratedItem[10] from [question, answer, wrong[3], why] tuples, GovOS-authored citation. Served by genComputer.

src/data.ts::COMPUTER_TEMPLATES.text: The computer-awareness question bank for the fixed papers. It holds one GovOS-written question about an Excel lookup function, which the computer mock repeats.
src/data.ts::COMPUTER_TEMPLATES.tech: Exported array with one govosSource template ('MS Office & Excel Formulas', Tier-2 Section-III pattern). sub-computer-full builds its 20 questions by cycling it, so all 20 are the same item.

src/data.ts::CONSTITUTION_PDF.text: The web address of the official text of the Constitution of India, published by the government's Legislative Department.
src/data.ts::CONSTITUTION_PDF.tech: Constant URL on legislative.gov.in. Used by constitutionSource() as the url of every Constitution-based general-awareness question.

src/data.ts::CuratedItem.text: The shape of one hand-written practice question for English or computers, with its choices, answer, explanation pieces and a note saying GovOS wrote it.
src/data.ts::CuratedItem.tech: Interface {topic, text, options[], correct, exp, simple, concept, steps[], takeaway, citation}. The six curated sets are built as CuratedItem[] and served through curatedGenerator().

src/data.ts::CustomTestConfig.text: The settings for a custom practice test a candidate asks for: an optional title, which subjects and topics, how many questions, the difficulty, an optional goal (general, weak areas, speed, pre-exam) and an optional time limit.
src/data.ts::CustomTestConfig.tech: Exported interface: title?, selectedSubjects: string[], selectedTopics: string[], numQuestions, difficulty (EASY|MEDIUM|HARD|ADAPTIVE), focusGoal? ('GENERAL'|'WEAK_AREAS'|'SPEED_BOOSTER'|'PRE_EXAM'), durationMinutes? (overrides calibration). Input to `generateCustomMockTest`.

src/data.ts::ENGLISH_TEMPLATES.text: The English practice question bank used by the fixed papers. It holds just one GovOS-written question (a subject-verb agreement error-spotting item), so papers that cycle it repeat that same question.
src/data.ts::ENGLISH_TEMPLATES.tech: Exported array with a single govosSource template ('Grammar: Subject-Verb Agreement'). buildFullPaperQuestions, sub-english-full and drill-eng-grammar cycle it with i % 1, so every English slot in those papers is the same item.

src/data.ts::EXCLUDED_STATISTICS.text: A note used in study plans to say the Statistics paper is not needed for this post, because it only counts for the Junior Statistical Officer post.
src/data.ts::EXCLUDED_STATISTICS.tech: Exported ExcludedModule {moduleId 'mod-t2-p2-stats', moduleName, reason, applicableOnlyTo 'Junior Statistical Officer (JSO) — MoSPI'}. Listed in tier2.excludedModules of every non-JSO study path.

src/data.ts::GA_TEMPLATES.text: The general-awareness practice questions (14 of them). Eleven were written from the official Constitution of India and three from SSC's CGL 2026 notice; each links to that document and carries a full explanation.
src/data.ts::GA_TEMPLATES.tech: Exported array of 14 template items (same shape as REASONING_TEMPLATES); 11 use constitutionSource(), 3 use sscNoticeSource(), so their provenance is FACT / OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED. Cycled into full papers, the GA sectional and the polity drill, and matched to catalogue topics (polity, ssc-notice) by ownerOf().

src/data.ts::GRAMMAR_ITEMS.text: Ten hand-written error-spotting questions: a sentence is split into four parts and the candidate picks the part with the grammar mistake. Each explains the rule broken.
src/data.ts::GRAMMAR_ITEMS.tech: CuratedItem[10] mapped from rows [partA, partB, partC, partD, errorIndex, why, rule]; options '(A) …'–'(D) …', topic 'Grammar: Error Spotting', concept and takeaway = rule. Served by genGrammar.

src/data.ts::IBPS_APPLICATION_SIMULATOR.text: A practice version of IBPS's online PO application form, built from IBPS's own notification. It follows the four steps the notice sets out and has 18 traps for common mistakes, using the notice's own figures (photo size, Rs 850 / Rs 175 fees, the birth-date limit). Nothing is sent to IBPS.
src/data.ts::IBPS_APPLICATION_SIMULATOR.tech: `ApplicationSimulatorSpec` with examId 'exam-ibps-po-2026', portal ibps.in, source `IBPS_NOTICE_TITLE`/`URL`, modelled-on and clean-submission notes, provenance `ibpsNotice('prov-ibps-appsim', ..., 22, ...)`, `modules` (4) and `traps` (18 declarative rules). Rendered by `ExamApplicationSimulator`.

src/data.ts::IBPS_NOTICE_TITLE.text: The official name of IBPS's detailed notification for the Probationary Officer/Management Trainee recruitment (CRP PO/MT-XVI).
src/data.ts::IBPS_NOTICE_TITLE.tech: Module-private string; documentTitle of `ibpsNotice` and `sourceDocumentTitle` of `IBPS_APPLICATION_SIMULATOR`.

src/data.ts::IBPS_NOTICE_URL.text: The web address of that IBPS notification PDF (dated 30 June 2026) on ibps.in.
src/data.ts::IBPS_NOTICE_URL.tech: Module-private string; officialUrl of `ibpsNotice` and `sourceDocumentUrl` of the IBPS simulator.

src/data.ts::IBPS_PO_EXAM.text: GovOS's record of the IBPS Probationary Officer exam 2026 (CRP PO/MT-XVI), a thinner record than SSC or UPSC. It holds one post, nine dates, the eligibility rules, the exam pattern and two stages (Prelims and Mains), two admit-card events and two scheduled results, two syllabus topics, one practice question, two years of cut-offs, one resource, one FAQ, an application guide and a roadmap. Its library now links 37 study resources — RBI and Finance Ministry pages, NIOS lessons, NCERT maths on DIKSHA and labelled coaching channels.
src/data.ts::IBPS_PO_EXAM.tech: `Exam` id 'exam-ibps-po-2026' (lines 18168-19153), categoryTag BANKING, vacanciesTotal '4,455 (Tentative)'. Fields: `posts` (1), `dates` (9, all citing `ibpsProvenance`), `globalRuleGroup`, `patternTree`, `stages` (2), `admitCardEvents` (2), `resultDeclarations` (2, SCHEDULED), `syllabus` (2), `practiceQuestions` (1, labelled 'Memory Based' OFFICIAL_PYQ), `corrigendums` [], `cutoffsHistory` (2023 and 2024 UR), `resources` (1), `faqs` (1), `applicationGuide`, `roadmapTracks`. Third entry of `ALL_EXAMS`. resources: + 39 entries built with openResource / coachingSource (the IBPS notification and PO/MT page go to Official Links).

src/data.ts::IDIOM_ITEMS.text: Ten hand-written questions asking what a common English idiom means, such as 'once in a blue moon'.
src/data.ts::IDIOM_ITEMS.tech: CuratedItem[10] built from [idiom, meaning, wrong[3]] tuples, GovOS-authored citation. Served by genIdiom.

src/data.ts::JEE_APPLICATION_SIMULATOR.text: The practice application form for JEE (Main): NTA’s three steps (registration, the application form with live photograph and uploads, the fee) with fifteen traps that each quote the bulletin or FAQ — for example Class XII passed in 2023, registering twice, assuming Session 1 covers Session 2, a photo over 200 kb, more than four cities, or the wrong fee.
src/data.ts::JEE_APPLICATION_SIMULATOR.tech: ApplicationSimulatorSpec for JEE_EXAM_ID: 3 modules (registration, application form, fee payment) and 15 traps (VALUE_IN, VALUE_IN_ALL, DATE_OUTSIDE 2025-10-31..2025-11-27 for Session 1), each officialClause a jeeP_* excerpt.

src/data.ts::JEE_AUTHORITY.text: Who conducts JEE (Main): the National Testing Agency (NTA).
src/data.ts::JEE_AUTHORITY.tech: 'National Testing Agency (NTA)' — the authorityName on the record and on every JEE provenance; displays use the part before the bracket.

src/data.ts::JEE_CHECK.text: The day NTA’s JEE (Main) documents were read for GovOS: 6 October 2026.
src/data.ts::JEE_CHECK.tech: '2026-10-06' — the verifiedDate on every JEE provenance and the linkVerifiedDate of its resources.

src/data.ts::JEE_EXAM_ID.text: The id that names JEE (Main) 2026 everywhere in GovOS (practice records, alerts, links).
src/data.ts::JEE_EXAM_ID.tech: 'exam-jee-main-2026' — the stable id; never derived from the title.

src/data.ts::JEE_FILES.text: The address of NTA’s file store, where the JEE (Main) website keeps its PDFs.
src/data.ts::JEE_FILES.tech: 'https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/…/uploads/' — joined with each file's path in JEE_SOURCES and the resources.

src/data.ts::JEE_MAIN_2026_EXAM.text: The whole record of JEE (Main) 2026, read from NTA’s own documents: the three papers and their pattern, the two sessions’ dates, eligibility (no age limit; Class XII in 2024, 2025 or 2026), the fee, the application steps and practice form, the admit-card rule, the declared Paper 1 result and the JEE (Advanced) cut-offs, the 64-topic syllabus, exam-day rules, FAQs, NTA’s nine question papers and answer keys, and official links. It is an admission test, so it has no posts, vacancies or pay. Its library links 43 study resources: NCERT books on DIKSHA, SATHEE (Ministry of Education with IIT Kanpur), NTA’s mock tests, IIT-PAL lecture channels, Khan Academy and labelled coaching channels. SATHEE's lesson channel on YouTube is run by Prutor Ai, so it is listed as linked from SATHEE but not as a government channel.
src/data.ts::JEE_MAIN_2026_EXAM.tech: Exam with examNature 'ADMISSION_TEST', posts [], minimumQualification CLASS_12, careerFields ['Engineering & Technology'], one stage (all papers' sections; Paper 1's totals), patternTree (examination → Paper 1 / 2A / 2B → subjects/parts → sections), 12 dates (ranges and months via displayWhen), admitCardEvents (city slips and the '03-04 days before' rule per session), resultDeclarations (Paper 1, 20 April 2026, with cut-offs), cutoffsHistory (6 value-only percentile rows), applicationGuide with fee and simulator, 16 role-tagged resources, 12 FAQs, examDayChecklist (11), eligibilityHighlights (5), officialLinks (9). resources: + 43 entries built with openResource / coachingSource; subjects Physics / Chemistry / Mathematics / Architecture & Planning Aptitude.

src/data.ts::JEE_SITE.text: NTA’s JEE (Main) website, where candidates apply and download the city slip, admit card and score card.
src/data.ts::JEE_SITE.tech: 'https://jeemain.nta.nic.in' — the record's officialDomain and application portal.

src/data.ts::JEE_SOURCES.text: The five official sources the JEE (Main) record was read from: the Information Bulletin, the syllabus, the FAQ, the result press release and the website’s own listing, each with its title, link and (where printed) publication date.
src/data.ts::JEE_SOURCES.tech: Object IB / SYL / FAQ / RES / SITE → {title, url, published, how}. Only RES prints a date (2026-04-20); the others carry '' rather than the day GovOS read them.

src/data.ts::JEE_SYLLABUS_TOPICS.text: The JEE (Main) syllabus as 64 topics: Paper 1’s 14 Mathematics, 20 Physics and 20 Chemistry units, and the Mathematics, Aptitude, Drawing and Planning parts of Papers 2A and 2B, each with its printed sub-topics.
src/data.ts::JEE_SYLLABUS_TOPICS.tech: SyllabusTopic[] generated from NTA's syllabus PDF (unit titles located in order, bodies split on ';' and sentence ends); formulae the text layer lost (the integral types, dy/dx + p(x)y = q(x), ψ and ψ², α, the ion lists) were read from the page images. Subjects 'Paper 1 · Mathematics' etc., tier 'JEE (Main)'.

src/data.ts::JEE_SYLLABUS_TREE.text: The same JEE (Main) syllabus as a tree: Paper 1 → Mathematics / Physics / Chemistry (by branch) → units, and Papers 2A and 2B → Parts I–III → units, in NTA’s own headings.
src/data.ts::JEE_SYLLABUS_TREE.tech: ExamSyllabusNode[] with scope PAPER per root; Chemistry splits into Physical / Inorganic / Organic branches; Paper 2 Mathematics lists the 14 unit titles with the note "As in Paper 1".

src/data.ts::LEGACY_POST_ID_ALIASES.text: A lookup that maps older or equivalent SSC post ids to the post whose study plan they share, for example several Assistant Section Officer posts all use the ASO plan.
src/data.ts::LEGACY_POST_ID_ALIASES.tech: Record<string, string> of 15 entries: three legacy ids (post-cbi-si, post-tax-asst, post-auditor) and twelve equivalent posts mapped to an authored path (ASO variants to post-aso-css, preventive officer/examiner to post-excise, NIA SI to post-si-cbi, statistical investigator to post-jso, etc.).

src/data.ts::MODULE_TIER2_PAPER1_GA.text: The study-plan block for the general awareness part of SSC CGL Tier-2 Paper-I: 25 questions, 75 marks, one mark lost per wrong answer.
src/data.ts::MODULE_TIER2_PAPER1_GA.tech: Exported StudyModuleRequirement 'mod-t2-p1-ga', TIER_2, Section II, 25 Qs / 75 marks / -1.00; provenance sscGazetteProvenance.

src/data.ts::MODULE_TIER2_PAPER1_MATH.text: The study-plan block for the maths part of SSC CGL Tier-2 Paper-I: 30 questions, 90 marks, one mark lost per wrong answer.
src/data.ts::MODULE_TIER2_PAPER1_MATH.tech: Exported StudyModuleRequirement 'mod-t2-p1-math', TIER_2, clause 'Section 13.2 (Session I Section I)', 30 Qs / 90 marks / '-1.00 per wrong answer', GovOS topic list and tip, provenance sscGazetteProvenance. In every post's tier2.commonModules.

src/data.ts::MODULE_TIER2_PAPER1_REASONI.text: The study-plan block for the reasoning part of SSC CGL Tier-2 Paper-I: 30 questions, 90 marks, one mark lost per wrong answer.

src/data.ts::MODULE_TIER2_PAPER2_STATIST.tech: Exported StudyModuleRequirement 'mod-t2-p2-stats', subject 'Statistics', TIER_2, 'Section 13.3 (Paper-II)', 100 Qs / 200 marks / -0.50; provenance sscGazetteProvenance. Appears only in post-jso's tier2.additionalModules.

src/data.ts::MockPaper.text: The shape of one practice test in GovOS: its title and kind (full shift paper, subject test, topic drill, sectional or custom), tier, question count, marks, time limit, difficulty, description, the questions themselves, and how it is marked. Custom tests can also carry notes on how they were put together.
src/data.ts::MockPaper.tech: Exported interface: id, title, category ('FULL_SHIFT'|'SUBJECT_TEST'|'TOPIC_DRILL'|'SECTIONAL_MOCK'|'CUSTOM_AI'), examTier ('Tier-1'|'Tier-2'), optional subject/topic/year/shiftDate, totalQuestions, totalMarks, durationMinutes, difficulty (EASY|MEDIUM|HARD|ADAPTIVE), description, provenanceTag, questions: PracticeQuestion[], optional generationNotes[] and requestSummary, and required `marking: PaperMarking` (no default).

src/data.ts::NCERT_X_MATHS.text: The web address of NCERT's own copy of the Class 10 Maths Exemplar book on the Internet Archive, in the page-viewer form. It is used because ncert.nic.in does not open on many Indian networks.
src/data.ts::NCERT_X_MATHS.tech: Constant 'https://archive.org/details/ncert-jeep2/'. ncertSource() appends a chapter file code (without .pdf) to it to build the question's citation URL.

src/data.ts::NCERT_X_MATHS_CANONICAL.text: The original address of the Class 10 Maths Exemplar files on NCERT's own website, kept so the citation names the official home of the file.
src/data.ts::NCERT_X_MATHS_CANONICAL.tech: Constant for the ncert.nic.in exemplar folder. Only quoted in ncertSource()'s publisher text as the canonical file location; it is not the link the user opens.

src/data.ts::NCERT_X_MATHS_PDF.text: The direct-download address of the same NCERT Class 10 Maths Exemplar files on the Internet Archive.
src/data.ts::NCERT_X_MATHS_PDF.tech: Constant 'https://archive.org/download/ncert-jeep2/'. Only quoted inside the publisher text of ncertSource() as the direct PDF link.

src/data.ts::NEW_DISCOVERED_PAPERS.text: Two more full-length GovOS practice papers (numbers 11 and 12), built the same way as the first ten and labelled the same way: not SSC papers.
src/data.ts::NEW_DISCOVERED_PAPERS.tech: Exported MockPaper[2] ('paper-cgl-2024-s6', 'paper-cgl-2024-t2'), identical shape to OFFICIAL_10_MOCK_PAPERS (FULL_SHIFT, 100 Qs, 200 marks, 60 min, SSC_TIER1_MARKING, buildFullPaperQuestions). The comment's 'discovered from verified repositories' wording does not reflect their content.

src/data.ts::OFFICIAL_10_MOCK_PAPERS.text: Ten full-length SSC CGL Tier-1 style practice papers (100 questions, 200 marks, 60 minutes each). Despite the variable name, they are GovOS practice papers, and each one says it is not an SSC question paper and has no official answer key.
src/data.ts::OFFICIAL_10_MOCK_PAPERS.tech: Exported MockPaper[10], ids 'paper-cgl-202x-…', titled 'Full-length practice paper 1–10 (Tier-1 pattern)', category FULL_SHIFT, difficulty ADAPTIVE, marking SSC_TIER1_MARKING, questions from buildFullPaperQuestions(). All share the same template-cycled item set and difficulty mix, so none may claim to be harder than another.

src/data.ts::PRACTICE_BANK_EXAM_ID.text: Names the one exam (SSC CGL 2026) that GovOS's own practice question bank, shift papers and drills are written for.
src/data.ts::PRACTICE_BANK_EXAM_ID.tech: Exported string 'exam-ssc-cgl-2026'; `PracticeEngine` offers its papers, sectionals and drills only for this exam id.

src/data.ts::PaperMarking.text: How a practice paper is scored: marks for a right answer, marks taken off for a wrong one, and the rule that says so.
src/data.ts::PaperMarking.tech: Exported interface `{ correct: number; wrong: number; clause: string }`; required on every `MockPaper`.

src/data.ts::ParsedTestRequest.text: What the test builder understood from a chat message: which subjects and topics, how many questions, how hard, how long, whether it targets weak areas, any words it could not match, and any typos it corrected.
src/data.ts::ParsedTestRequest.tech: Interface {subjects[], topics: TopicSpec[], numQuestions, difficulty, durationMinutes?, focusGoal ('GENERAL' | 'WEAK_AREAS' etc.), unrecognised: string[], corrections: {typed, readAs}[]}. Returned by parseTestRequest.

src/data.ts::QUANT_TEMPLATES.text: The maths practice questions (15 of them), each written from an exercise in NCERT's Class 10 Maths Exemplar book (triangles, trigonometry, surface areas and volumes). Each links to the chapter and includes worked steps.
src/data.ts::QUANT_TEMPLATES.tech: Exported array of 15 template items, all with ncertSource(chapter, citation) and kind OFFICIAL_EXERCISE. Cycled into full papers, the quant sectional and both quant drills (the second starts at offset 5), and matched to geometry / trigonometry / mensuration topics by ownerOf().

src/data.ts::QuestionSource.text: A short note attached to a practice question saying where it came from: a name for the source, a web link, who published it, and whether GovOS wrote the question itself or wrote it from an official document.
src/data.ts::QuestionSource.tech: Interface {label, url, publisher, kind} where kind is 'OFFICIAL_EXERCISE' | 'OFFICIAL_DOCUMENT' | 'GOVOS_AUTHORED'. Carried as the optional `source` on every question template and turned into a DataProvenance by provenanceForSource().

src/data.ts::REASONING_TEMPLATES.text: The hand-written reasoning practice questions (4 of them) used to fill SSC CGL practice papers. Each has options, the right answer, and a long step-by-step explanation in plain words. All were written by GovOS, not taken from past papers.
src/data.ts::REASONING_TEMPLATES.tech: Exported array of 4 items {topic, text, options[], correct (index), exp, detailedExp: DetailedExplanation, source?}; every source is govosSource(...). Cycled with i % length by buildFullPaperQuestions, SUBJECT_MOCK_TESTS, TOPIC_DRILL_TESTS and drawn per topic by generateCustomMockTest via bankFor/ownerOf.

src/data.ts::RELATIVE_DIFFICULTY_CLAIM.text: A list of words like 'harder' or 'easier' that a practice paper is not allowed to use about itself compared with other papers.
src/data.ts::RELATIVE_DIFFICULTY_CLAIM.tech: Module-private case-insensitive regex matching harder/hardest/easier/easiest/tougher/toughest/stiffer/more difficult/less difficult/harder mix/easier mix as whole words; checked against title + description in `mockPaperProblems`.

src/data.ts::RESOURCE_CHECK.text: The day the new resource links for IBPS PO, APPSC, TG TET and JEE were checked: 6 October 2026.
src/data.ts::RESOURCE_CHECK.tech: '2026-10-06' — the verifiedDate and linkVerifiedDate of every resource built with openResource or coachingSource.

src/data.ts::SSC_BOARD.text: The base web address of SSC's notice-board files; each later SSC notice's address is this plus its file name.
src/data.ts::SSC_BOARD.tech: Module-private string 'https://ssc.gov.in/api/attachment/uploads/masterData/NoticeBoards/', prefixed to the `file` argument in `sscDocument`.

src/data.ts::SSC_CGL_EXAM.text: GovOS's complete, hand-checked record of the SSC Combined Graduate Level Exam 2026, the platform's reference ('Golden Journey') exam. Nearly every fact quotes the SSC document and page it came from, read from SSC's own PDFs and checked on 29 September 2026.
src/data.ts::SSC_CGL_EXAM.tech: `Exam` with id 'exam-ssc-cgl-2026' (data.ts lines 183-3808). Top-level fields: identity/overview, `vacanciesTotal` '10,731 (tentative, as on 24.09.2026)', `factEvidence`, `ageRelaxations` (6), `posts` (40), `dates` (12, 4 SUPERSEDED), `globalRuleGroup`, `patternTree`, `stages` (4), `syllabusTree`, `answerKeys` (8, prior-cycle 2025 notices), `syllabus` (22 topics with `sscProvenanceWeightage`), `applicationGuide`, `roadmapTracks` (3), `practiceQuestions`, `corrigendums` (reopen, Tier-I schedule, vacancy list), `cutoffsHistory` (37 rows, CGLE 2025 Tier-I by list and Tier-II sections/CKT), `resources` (38), `admitCardDetails`, `admitCardEvents` (CITY_INTIMATION and ADMIT_CARD), `syllabusSourceNote`, `eligibilityHighlights`, `officialLinks`, `faqs` (6). src/data.ts::SUBJECT_ALIASES.text: A list of everyday words people use for each subject, such as 'maths' or 'gk', so the test builder knows which subject a chat message is asking for.
src/data.ts::SUBJECT_ALIASES.tech: Array of {subject, aliases[]} for the five subjects (e.g. quant: quant, maths, arithmetic…; GA: gk, ga, general studies, gs…). parseTestRequest matches them on word boundaries, then fuzzily if nothing matched.

src/data.ts::SUBJECT_COMP.text: The fixed name 'Computer Proficiency' used for the computer subject in the test builder.
src/data.ts::SUBJECT_COMP.tech: Constant 'Computer Proficiency'; subject key for computer topics and bankFor's COMPUTER_TEMPLATES branch. Not part of the four-section Tier-1 mix.

src/data.ts::SUBJECT_ENG.text: The fixed name 'English Comprehension' used for the English subject in the test builder.
src/data.ts::SUBJECT_ENG.tech: Constant 'English Comprehension'; subject key for English topics. bankFor returns ENGLISH_TEMPLATES for it (and for any unknown subject).

src/data.ts::SUBJECT_GA.text: The fixed name 'General Awareness' used for the general-knowledge subject in the test builder.
src/data.ts::SUBJECT_GA.tech: Constant 'General Awareness'; subject key for GA topics and bankFor's GA_TEMPLATES branch. Tests made only of GA/English get a shorter per-question time.

src/data.ts::SUBJECT_MOCK_TESTS.text: Five single-subject practice tests: maths, reasoning, English and general awareness (25 questions each) and a 20-question Tier-2 computer test. Each is filled by repeating that subject's small question bank.
src/data.ts::SUBJECT_MOCK_TESTS.tech: Exported MockPaper[5], category SUBJECT_TEST, ids sub-quant/reasoning/english/ga/computer-full. Tier-1 ones use SSC_TIER1_MARKING (50 marks); the computer one is Tier-2 with its own marking {correct 3, wrong 1} citing Para 13.9 / 13.9.8 (60 marks). Questions are Array.from cycles of the matching *_TEMPLATES, questionType SECTIONAL_MOCK.

src/data.ts::SUBJECT_QUANT.text: The fixed name 'Quantitative Aptitude' used for the maths subject in the test builder.
src/data.ts::SUBJECT_QUANT.tech: Constant 'Quantitative Aptitude'; the subject key used by TOPIC_CATALOG, SUBJECT_ALIASES, bankFor and the default fallbacks in generateCustomMockTest.

src/data.ts::SUBJECT_REAS.text: The fixed name 'Reasoning & General Intelligence' used for the reasoning subject in the test builder.
src/data.ts::SUBJECT_REAS.tech: Constant 'Reasoning & General Intelligence'; subject key for reasoning topics and bankFor's REASONING_TEMPLATES branch.

src/data.ts::Supplier.text: An internal record used while building a test: one topic, its bank questions, and counters for how far through the bank and the generator it has got.
src/data.ts::Supplier.tech: Interface {topic: TopicSpec, bank: TemplateQuestion[], cursor, genIndex}. Created by makeSupplier, consumed by drawFrom.

src/data.ts::TGTET_APPLICATION_SIMULATOR.text: The practice application form for TG TET: the portal’s two steps (pay the fee to get a Journal Number, then submit the application) with eleven traps that each quote the notification or bulletin — for example applying when not an in-service teacher, using the pass for direct recruitment, paying the wrong fee, or uploading a non-JPEG photo.

src/data.ts::TG_TET_INSERVICE_2026_II_EX.text: The whole record of the Special TG TET 2026-II for in-service teachers, read from the Department’s own documents: who may appear, the two papers and their pattern, the 78-topic syllabus, the dates, the fee, the application steps and practice form, the hall ticket, the scheduled result, the exam-day rules, FAQs and official links. It is an eligibility test, so it has no posts, vacancies or pay. Its library links T-SAT’s official TG TET 2026 playlists for every paper and subject, NIOS D.El.Ed material, DIKSHA Telangana and labelled coaching channels.
src/data.ts::TG_TET_INSERVICE_2026_II_EX.tech: Exam with examNature 'ELIGIBILITY_TEST', posts [], careerFields ['Teaching & Education'], one CBT stage (both papers' sections), patternTree (CBT → Paper-I / Paper-II → subjects), syllabus (78 topics) and syllabusTree (91 entries), 7 dates (ranges via displayWhen), admitCardEvents, resultDeclarations (SCHEDULED), applicationGuide with fee and simulator, examDayChecklist (9), eligibilityHighlights (5), officialLinks (7), 4 role-tagged resources. resources: + 33 entries (SCERT Telangana’s textbook PDFs were left out: the host dropped most connections when checked).

src/data.ts::TOPIC_CATALOG.text: The master list of the 47 topics a candidate can ask the test builder for, with the words that recognise each one. 34 are in the SSC CGL syllabus; 13 (such as matrices, programming or law) are listed only so GovOS can say they are outside the syllabus. Some topics have a question maker; others can only use the existing question bank.
src/data.ts::TOPIC_CATALOG.tech: Exported TopicSpec[47]: quant 14, reasoning 7, English 5, GA 7, computer 1 in syllabus, plus 13 inSyllabus:false topics with no generator. 'calculus' is also inSyllabus:false but has genCalculus. 17 topics carry a generator (12 procedural, 5 curated). Used by parseTestRequest, ownerOf, matchTopicByName, suppliersForSubject and generateCustomMockTest; it is SSC's catalogue and must stay inside SSC's practice boundary.

src/data.ts::TOPIC_DRILL_TESTS.text: Five short 15-question drills on one area each: geometry, trigonometry and mensuration, polity, syllogisms and English grammar. They reuse the same small question banks, so some questions repeat inside a drill.
src/data.ts::TOPIC_DRILL_TESTS.tech: Exported MockPaper[5], category TOPIC_DRILL, 30 marks each, SSC_TIER1_MARKING. drill-quant-geom and drill-quant-algebra cycle QUANT_TEMPLATES (the latter from offset 5), drill-ga-polity cycles GA_TEMPLATES, drill-reas-syllogism REASONING_TEMPLATES (4 items) and drill-eng-grammar ENGLISH_TEMPLATES (1 item); questionType TOPIC_DRILL.

src/data.ts::TemplateQuestion.text: The common shape of one question before it is placed in a test: the topic, the question, the four choices, which one is right, a short and a detailed explanation, and where it came from.
src/data.ts::TemplateQuestion.tech: Type {topic, text, options: string[], correct: number, exp, detailedExp: DetailedExplanation, source?: QuestionSource}. The bank templates and every generator's output share it; generateCustomMockTest turns each into a PracticeQuestion.

src/data.ts::TopicSpec.text: The description of one topic a candidate can ask to practise: its id, display name, subject, the words that recognise it, whether it is in the SSC CGL syllabus, and optionally a function that can make new questions on it.
src/data.ts::TopicSpec.tech: Interface {key, label, subject, aliases: string[], inSyllabus: boolean, generate?: (difficulty, rng, index) => TemplateQuestion}. TOPIC_CATALOG is an array of these; a topic without `generate` can only be served from the bank.

src/data.ts::UPSC_APPLICATION_SIMULATOR.text: A practice version of UPSC's real online application form, built entirely from the 2026 notice. It walks through the portal's four cards (account, universal registration, common application form, exam module) and has 15 'traps': common mistakes such as using an e-mail you do not control or a date of birth outside the allowed band, each quoting the notice clause it breaks. Nothing is sent to UPSC.
src/data.ts::UPSC_APPLICATION_SIMULATOR.tech: `ApplicationSimulatorSpec` with examId 'exam-upsc-cse-2026', portal upsconline.nic.in, source = the notice, `modelledOnNote`, `cleanSubmissionNote`, provenance `upscNotice('prov-upsc-appsim', ...)`, `modules` (4 cards with their fields) and `traps` (15, rules of kind VALUE_IN / VALUE_IN_ALL / DATE_OUTSIDE, each with severity, explanation, officialClause and noticeReference; e.g. DOB outside 1994-08-02..2005-08-01). Rendered by `ExamApplicationSimulator`.

src/data.ts::UPSC_CSE_EXAM.text: GovOS's full record of the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2026, written from UPSC's own notice, press notes, calendar and cut-off sheets. src/data.ts::apg1Post.tech: (code, id, postName, department, vacancies, minAge, maxAge, pay, row, extra?) → PostRequirement: postName as printed + '(Post Code NN)', payLevel/payScale from the printed scale, classification 'Group-I Services', provenance apg1('prov-apg1-post-NN', 1, …, row); postConditions lead with the vacancies (PostRequirement has no vacancy field) then extra's; extra adds physical standards or a post's own ruleGroup (Post Code 04's branch rule).

src/data.ts::appscProvenance.text: The placeholder source note behind APPSC Group-II's facts. It says plainly that no APPSC Group-II notification has been read yet, so the facts citing it show 'No official source on record — not verified' and carry no Evidence button. It used to name an invented notification and verifier and claim to be officially verified.
src/data.ts::appscProvenance.tech: `DataProvenance` 'prov-appsc-01': documentTitle 'No APPSC Group-II notification read yet (placeholder record)', officialUrl '', no page, no excerpt, publishedDate/verifiedDate '', verifiedBy saying it is not verified, FACT / UNDER_VERIFICATION. provenanceHasEvidence is false for it, so factVerification gives UNVERIFIED. Referenced throughout `APPSC_GROUP2_EXAM`.

src/data.ts::bankFor.text: Returns the fixed question bank for a subject (maths, reasoning, general awareness, computers, or English for anything else).
src/data.ts::bankFor.tech: (subject) => TemplateQuestion[]: QUANT/REASONING/GA/COMPUTER_TEMPLATES by subject constant, defaulting to ENGLISH_TEMPLATES.

src/data.ts::bankMatches.text: Lists the bank questions that belong to a given topic.

src/data.ts::between.text: Picks a random whole number between a low and a high value, both included.
src/data.ts::between.tech: between(rng, lo, hi) => lo + floor(rng()*(hi-lo+1)). Used by the generators to choose the numbers in a question.

src/data.ts::buildFullPaperQuestions.text: Builds one 100-question practice paper: 25 reasoning, 25 general awareness, 25 maths and 25 English questions. Because the question banks are small, it repeats them in rotation, so every full paper contains the same underlying questions.
src/data.ts::buildFullPaperQuestions.tech: (paperId, shiftInfo, year) => PracticeQuestion[100]. Four loops of 25 cycling REASONING/GA/QUANT/ENGLISH_TEMPLATES with i % length; ids '<paperId>-q<n>', tier TIER_1, questionType GOVOS_CREATED, difficulty HARD when i%3==0, else MEDIUM when i even, else EASY; provenance via provenanceForSource. Used by OFFICIAL_10_MOCK_PAPERS and NEW_DISCOVERED_PAPERS.

src/data.ts::coachingSource.text: Builds the label for a free coaching YouTube channel: not official, listed because many candidates follow it, never fact-checked by GovOS — and the exam’s own authority wins wherever a lesson disagrees.
src/data.ts::coachingSource.tech: (id, channelTitle, url, subscribers, examAuthority) → DataProvenance: RECOMMENDATION, UNDER_VERIFICATION, the subscriber count read from the channel’s own page as the stated basis. The SSC-worded communitySource stays for SSC’s channels.

src/data.ts::collapseRepeats.text: Squashes doubled letters into one (so 'workk' becomes 'work'), to help forgive typos.

src/data.ts::communitySource.text: Builds the source record for a free coaching resource (such as a popular YouTube channel) that is not a government publication. It records how big its audience was when checked, says GovOS does not endorse or fact-check it, and that the official notice wins if they disagree.
src/data.ts::communitySource.tech: `(id, documentTitle, url, audience) => DataProvenance`: RECOMMENDATION / UNDER_VERIFICATION, dates `CHECK_DATE`, verifiedBy 'channel reachable and identity confirmed', excerpt with the audience string and the disclaimer. Used about 16 times for coaching channels.

src/data.ts::constitutionSource.text: A helper that builds the source note for a question written from the Constitution of India, pointing to the official text.
src/data.ts::constitutionSource.tech: (citation) => QuestionSource {label: citation, url: CONSTITUTION_PDF, publisher: 'Legislative Department, Ministry of Law & Justice', kind: 'OFFICIAL_DOCUMENT'}. Used by 11 of the GA_TEMPLATES.

src/data.ts::containsAlias.text: Checks whether a recognising word appears in a message as a whole word (allowing a plural ending), so 'Framework' is not mistaken for 'work'.
src/data.ts::containsAlias.tech: (text, alias) => boolean: case-insensitive regex with non-letter boundaries and optional s/es suffix, alias regex-escaped. Used by parseTestRequest, ownerOf and matchTopicByName.

src/data.ts::containsAliasFuzzy.text: A typo-forgiving version of the topic-word check: it looks for the words of a topic name in order in the message, accepting near-misses, and reports which words it had to correct.
src/data.ts::containsAliasFuzzy.tech: (text, alias) => {typed, readAs}[] | null. Tokenises both, scans for an adjacent run where each word is equal, a plural form, or fuzzyWordEq; returns the list of corrections (possibly empty) or null. Used by parseTestRequest only when exact matching found nothing.

src/data.ts::curatedGenerator.text: Lets a fixed list of hand-written questions be used like a question generator: it hands them out in turn and shuffles the answer choices each time.
src/data.ts::curatedGenerator.tech: curatedGenerator(items) => generate(difficulty, rng, index): takes items[index % length], shuffles options with rng, recomputes the correct index, and returns a TemplateQuestion with a GOVOS_AUTHORED source (url ssc.gov.in) and explain(simple, concept, steps, takeaway). Difficulty is ignored.

src/data.ts::drawFrom.text: Takes the next question from a supplier that has not already been used in this test: first from the bank, then by generating new ones (trying up to 25 times to get something different).
src/data.ts::drawFrom.tech: (sup, difficulty, rng, used: Set<text>) => {q, generated} | null. Advances sup.cursor through the bank skipping used texts, then calls sup.topic.generate with an increasing genIndex up to 25 attempts; null if nothing new.

src/data.ts::editDistance.text: Counts how many single-letter changes it takes to turn one word into another, counting a swapped pair of letters as one change. Used to forgive small spelling mistakes.
src/data.ts::editDistance.tech: Optimal-string-alignment Levenshtein distance (insert, delete, substitute, adjacent transposition) via a DP table. Used by fuzzyWordEq.

src/data.ts::examHasStudyPaths.text: Says whether an exam has any post-by-post study plan. Today only SSC CGL does, so only it shows the Post Study Plan view.
src/data.ts::examHasStudyPaths.tech: Exported (exam) => exam.posts.some(p => ALL_POST_STUDY_PATHS[p.id] || LEGACY_POST_ID_ALIASES[p.id]). Used by the syllabus section to decide whether to offer and default to the Post Study Plan view.

src/data.ts::explain.text: A helper that packs a plain explanation, the key idea, the steps, the main lesson and an optional shortcut into the detailed-explanation format the solution cards show.
src/data.ts::explain.tech: explain(simple, core, steps[], takeaway, trick?, trickName?) => DetailedExplanation; when `trick` is given it adds shortcutTrick {name (default 'One-line method'), trickSteps and explanation = trick, timeSaved 'Saves the full working'}. Used by generators and curatedGenerator.

src/data.ts::fmt.text: Writes a number for display: whole numbers as they are, others rounded to two decimal places.
src/data.ts::fmt.tech: fmt(n) => String(n) when integer, else String(Math.round(n*100)/100). Used for options and explanation text in generated questions.

src/data.ts::fuzzyWordEq.text: Decides whether a typed word is close enough to a known word to count as the same: exact, the same once doubled letters are removed, or off by one letter (two for long words). Very short words must match exactly.
src/data.ts::fuzzyWordEq.tech: Exported (typed, want) => boolean: true if equal; false if want < 4 letters; true if collapseRepeats matches; false if want < 5; else within tolerance 1 (2 for 9+ letters) on both length difference and editDistance.

src/data.ts::genAlgebra.text: Makes algebra questions: solving a simple equation for x, or finding the sum of the two solutions of a quadratic equation.
src/data.ts::genAlgebra.tech: Generator: even index = linear equation ax + b = c solved for x; odd = quadratic x² − (r1+r2)x + r1·r2 = 0, answer the sum of roots.

src/data.ts::genAverage.text: Makes average questions: either the new average after one number is added to a group, or the average of a listed set of numbers.
src/data.ts::genAverage.tech: Generator: even index = 'Adding a New Member' (new average from n, avg and an added value chosen so the result stays clean); odd = 'Mean of a Set' over 4–9 random numbers. HARD raises n and the average range.

src/data.ts::genCalculus.text: Makes new calculus questions with random numbers: slope of a curve at a point, a simple area-under-a-line integral, a limit solved by factoring, the power rule, and the maximum of a curve. It works out the answer, wrong choices and steps itself. Calculus is outside the SSC CGL syllabus, so it is only made when asked for.
src/data.ts::genCalculus.tech: TopicSpec generator; variant = index % 5 picks derivative at a point, definite integral of a linear function, removable-discontinuity limit, power rule, or maximum of −x²+bx+c. HARD widens the number ranges. Returns a TemplateQuestion with numericOptions(), generatedSource('Calculus', …) and explain(). Attached to the 'calculus' topic (inSyllabus false).

src/data.ts::genCoding.text: Makes code-language puzzles: a word is written by moving each letter a few places along the alphabet, and the candidate must write another word the same way.
src/data.ts::genCoding.tech: Generator: picks a word from a fixed list and a shift k (1–3, up to 5 when HARD), shows the Caesar-shifted form, asks for another same-length word under the same shift; distractors are shifts of k+1, −k and k+2, shuffled with rng.

src/data.ts::genComputer.text: The question maker for computer basics, serving the hand-written computer questions.
src/data.ts::genComputer.tech: curatedGenerator(COMPUTER_ITEMS), 10 items; attached to the 'computer-basics' topic.

src/data.ts::genDirection.text: Makes direction puzzles: a person walks some distance north or south, then east or west, and the question asks how far they are from the start.
src/data.ts::genDirection.tech: Generator using Pythagorean triples ((3,4,5) etc.; only the first three unless HARD); the answer is the hypotenuse c in km, distractors a+b, |a−b|, c+1, a·b.

src/data.ts::genGrammar.text: The question maker for grammar practice, serving the hand-written error-spotting questions.
src/data.ts::genGrammar.tech: curatedGenerator(GRAMMAR_ITEMS), 10 items; attached to the 'grammar' topic.

src/data.ts::genIdiom.text: The question maker for idioms and phrases, serving the hand-written idiom questions.
src/data.ts::genIdiom.tech: curatedGenerator(IDIOM_ITEMS), 10 items; attached to the 'idioms' topic.

src/data.ts::genInterest.text: Makes interest questions: simple interest over a few years, or compound interest over two years compounded yearly.
src/data.ts::genInterest.tech: Generator with random principal (multiples of 500): even index = simple interest PRT/100 with R in {4,5,6,8,10,12}, T 2–5; odd = two-year compound interest P(1+R/100)² − P with R in {5,10,20}.

src/data.ts::genPercentage.text: Makes new percentage questions with random numbers: a percentage of a number, the percentage increase between two values, and how much to cut use when a price rises so spending stays the same.
src/data.ts::genPercentage.tech: Generator with index % 3 choosing 'Value of a Percentage', 'Percentage Change' or 'Price Rise & Consumption' (100p/(100+p)). HARD uses harder percentages and bigger bases. Answers computed; options via numericOptions (with '%' unit where relevant).

src/data.ts::genProfitLoss.text: Makes profit questions: the selling price for a given profit percentage, or the profit percentage from a cost and selling price.
src/data.ts::genProfitLoss.tech: Generator: random cost price (multiples of 50) and profit % in {5,10,12,15,20,25}; even index asks SP = CP(1+p/100), odd asks profit % (distractors include profit as a share of SP).

src/data.ts::genRatio.text: Makes questions about splitting a sum of money between two people in a given ratio, asking for one person's share.
src/data.ts::genRatio.tech: Generator: random ratio a:b (b>a) and unit value, total = (a+b)*unit; even index asks A's share, odd B's. Distractors include the other share, half the total, one part and the total.

src/data.ts::genSeries.text: Makes 'find the next number' questions using three patterns: adding the same amount each time, multiplying by the same amount, or square numbers plus one.
src/data.ts::genSeries.tech: Generator: index % 3 selects arithmetic progression, geometric progression (ratio 2 or 3) or n²+1. Answer and distractors computed; topic labels 'Number Series: …'.

src/data.ts::genSpeed.text: Makes speed-and-distance questions: how long a train takes to pass a pole, or how far a car goes at a speed for some hours.
src/data.ts::genSpeed.tech: Generator: even index = train of length len at speed km/h crossing a pole (converted ×5/18, answer in seconds); odd = distance = speed × time in km.

src/data.ts::genSynonym.text: The question maker for vocabulary practice, serving the hand-written synonym and antonym questions.

src/data.ts::genTimeWork.text: Makes time-and-work questions: how long two people take working together, either from their separate times or when one works several times faster than the other.
src/data.ts::genTimeWork.tech: Generator: odd index = 'Relative Efficiency' (B k times as efficient, answer a/(k+1) days); even = 'Working Together' from a fixed list of (a,b) day pairs, answer ab/(a+b). Units ' days'.

src/data.ts::genVoice.text: The question maker for active and passive voice, serving the hand-written voice questions.
src/data.ts::genVoice.tech: curatedGenerator(VOICE_ITEMS), 6 items; attached to the 'voice-narration' topic.

src/data.ts::generateCustomMockTest.text: Builds a custom practice test from the candidate's request. It takes questions for the requested topics first from the bank, then makes new ones; if those run out it widens to the same subject, then to other Tier-1 sections, and finally stops short rather than repeat a question. Every decision is written into notes the chat shows, and the test is marked with SSC CGL Tier-1 marking.
src/data.ts::generateCustomMockTest.tech: Exported (config: CustomTestConfig) => MockPaper. Suppliers from explicit topics (notes for empty or off-syllabus ones; falls back to subject fills), else named subjects, else the four Tier-1 subjects (rotateStart). Seeds mulberry32, draws round-robin with drawFrom and a used-text set, widens twice, breaks when exhausted. Questions are CUSTOM_AI_GENERATED with provenanceForSource; duration from config or seconds per question by difficulty (×0.6 for GA/English only). Returns category CUSTOM_AI, marking SSC_TIER1_MARKING, description with on-topic count, generationNotes and requestSummary.

src/data.ts::generatedSource.text: Builds the source note for a question the GovOS generator made on the spot, saying it was generated for this request and that its answer was computed when it was made.
src/data.ts::generatedSource.tech: (topicLabel, detail) => QuestionSource {label 'Generated by GovOS for this request — <topic> (<detail>)', url 'https://ssc.gov.in', publisher 'GovOS question generator; answer computed…', kind 'GOVOS_AUTHORED'}. Used by every procedural generator.

src/data.ts::getPostStudyPath.text: Finds the study plan for a post id, checking the post itself first and then its known equivalent. If nothing matches it falls back to the Assistant Section Officer plan.
src/data.ts::getPostStudyPath.tech: Exported (postId) => PostStudyPath: ALL_POST_STUDY_PATHS[postId] || ALL_POST_STUDY_PATHS[LEGACY_POST_ID_ALIASES[postId]] || ALL_POST_STUDY_PATHS['post-aso-css']. Note the unconditional ASO fallback.

src/data.ts::govosSource.text: A helper that marks a question as written by GovOS itself, following SSC's syllabus and paper style, not copied from a real exam paper.
src/data.ts::govosSource.tech: (citation) => QuestionSource with url SSC_NOTICE_URL (the notice whose scheme it follows), publisher 'GovOS Preparation Team ...' and kind 'GOVOS_AUTHORED'. Used by the reasoning, English and computer templates; provenanceForSource() turns such a source into RECOMMENDATION / UNDER_VERIFICATION provenance.

src/data.ts::ibpsNotice.text: Builds a source record for one clause of IBPS's PO notification, with the page and quoted words.
src/data.ts::ibpsNotice.tech: `(id, clause, page, excerpt) => DataProvenance`, publishedDate '2026-06-30', verifiedDate '2026-09-22', FACT / OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED. Its only use in data.ts is the IBPS simulator's top-level provenance.

src/data.ts::ibpsProvenance.text: The placeholder source note behind IBPS PO's facts. It says plainly that no IBPS document has been read yet, so the dates, the post and the cut-offs citing it show 'No official source on record — not verified' and carry no Evidence button. It used to name an advertisement page and a verifier that did not exist and claim to be officially verified.
src/data.ts::ibpsProvenance.tech: `DataProvenance` 'prov-ibps-01': documentTitle 'No IBPS document read yet (placeholder record)', officialUrl '', no page, no excerpt, publishedDate/verifiedDate '', FACT / UNDER_VERIFICATION. provenanceHasEvidence is false, so factVerification gives UNVERIFIED and the exam badge reads '0 of N facts officially verified'. Referenced about 22 times in `IBPS_PO_EXAM`.

src/data.ts::jee.text: Builds one JEE (Main) citation: which NTA document, which page and clause, and the exact words quoted from it.
src/data.ts::jee.tech: (id, doc, pageNumber, clauseNumber, excerptText, taxonomyType='FACT') → DataProvenance: OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED, publishedDate from JEE_SOURCES, verifiedBy naming how it was read (text layer or page image).

src/data.ts::jeeCut.text: Builds the citation for one row of the JEE (Advanced) eligibility cut-off table in NTA’s 20 April 2026 press release.
src/data.ts::jeeCut.tech: (n, category, from, to, candidates) → jee('prov-jee-cutoff-n', 'RES', 3, …) quoting the row as printed: number, category, percentile range and candidate count.

src/data.ts::jeeMathsPart.text: Builds a 25-question, 100-mark subject of the JEE pattern with its two sections: 20 multiple-choice questions and 5 numerical-value questions answered as an integer.
src/data.ts::jeeMathsPart.tech: (id, name, provenance) → ExamPatternNode SUBJECT with SECTION children 'Section A' (20, MCQ) and 'Section B' (5, numerical value, cited to jeeP_rounding).

src/data.ts::jeePaperNode.text: Builds one paper (Paper 1, 2A or 2B) of the JEE (Main) pattern: its questions, marks, 3 hours, +4 / −1 marking and the longer time for candidates eligible for a scribe.
src/data.ts::jeePaperNode.tech: (id, code, name, order, questions, marks, provenance, children, extra?) → ExamPatternNode level PAPER, durationMinutes 180, marksPerQuestion 4, negativeMarkPerWrong 1, durationVariants (240 min PwD/PwBD); extra overrides fields.

src/data.ts::makeSupplier.text: Creates a fresh supplier for a topic with its bank questions and counters at zero.

src/data.ts::matchTopicByName.text: Given any topic name written in words, finds the catalogue topic it most likely belongs to (the one with the longest matching recognising word).
src/data.ts::matchTopicByName.tech: Exported (name) => TopicSpec | undefined, same longest-alias rule as ownerOf. Used to tally a candidate's past answers by topic for 'test my weak areas'.

src/data.ts::mockPaperProblems.text: Checks that a practice paper only claims what its own questions support: it states its marking rule, its question and mark totals add up, no question is repeated, it does not call itself harder or easier than others, and its stated difficulty matches most of its questions. It returns a list of any problems found.
src/data.ts::mockPaperProblems.tech: Exported `(paper: MockPaper) => string[]` (empty = consistent). Flags missing/invalid marking or clause; `totalQuestions !== questions.length`; `totalMarks !== questions.length x marking.correct`; duplicate question ids; a `RELATIVE_DIFFICULTY_CLAIM` match; and, unless ADAPTIVE, a `difficulty` that is not the most common question difficulty. Used by the paper checks over every exam's papers.

src/data.ts::mulberry32.text: A small random-number maker that, given a starting number, always produces the same sequence. It lets generated questions vary while still being reproducible.
src/data.ts::mulberry32.tech: mulberry32(seed) => () => number in [0,1): the standard Mulberry32 PRNG. generateCustomMockTest seeds it with (Date.now() % 1000003) + count*7919 and passes it to every generator and option shuffle.

src/data.ts::ncertSource.text: A small helper that builds the 'where this came from' note for a maths question written from an NCERT Exemplar chapter. The link opens NCERT's own upload on the Internet Archive.
src/data.ts::ncertSource.tech: (chapterPdf, citation) => QuestionSource with label = citation, url = NCERT_X_MATHS + chapter code (.pdf stripped), a publisher string naming NCERT plus the direct and canonical PDF addresses, and kind 'OFFICIAL_EXERCISE'. Used by all 15 QUANT_TEMPLATES.

src/data.ts::numericOptions.text: Makes the four answer choices for a generated maths question: the right answer plus three different wrong ones (preferring the typical mistakes it is given), then shuffles them and remembers where the right one ended up.
src/data.ts::numericOptions.tech: (rng, correct, distractors[], unit='') => {options: string[4], correct: index}. Takes up to 3 distinct finite distractors, pads with correct ± multiples of ~10% if short, formats with fmt()+unit, shuffles with rng and returns the correct value's new position.

src/data.ts::officialQuestionsForExam.text: Gives a practice screen the official questions for its own exam only, so one exam's paper can never appear in another's.
src/data.ts::officialQuestionsForExam.tech: `(examId) => OfficialPaperQuestion[]`: `ALL_OFFICIAL_QUESTIONS.filter(q => q.examId === examId)` on the exact id.

src/data.ts::officialSource.text: Builds the source record for a link to an official government site in the Resource Library, saying the link answered when it was checked on 9 September 2026 and that GovOS links to it rather than copying it.
src/data.ts::officialSource.tech: `(id, documentTitle, officialUrl, httpCode, taxonomyType='FACT') => DataProvenance` with published/verified date `CHECK_DATE`, verifiedBy naming the HTTP code, OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED, and a generic excerpt saying the source is reachable and maintained by the issuing authority. Used about 47 times in data.ts for resource entries.

src/data.ts::openResource.text: Builds the citation for a free learning resource an official body publishes (an RBI page, an NCERT book on DIKSHA, a T-SAT playlist): it names the publisher and quotes the page’s own title.
src/data.ts::openResource.tech: (id, title, url, owner) → DataProvenance: FACT, OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED, excerptText = the page title as published, verifiedBy naming the HTTP check and the publisher, no publication date (a link check is not a publication).

src/data.ts::ownerOf.text: Works out which single topic a bank question belongs to, by finding the longest topic word in the question's topic name. This stops, for example, a trigonometry 'heights and distances' question being used in a speed-and-distance drill.
src/data.ts::ownerOf.tech: (template) => topic key | undefined. On first call builds templateOwner over all five *_TEMPLATES: for each template, the TOPIC_CATALOG entry whose label or alias (3+ chars) is the longest containsAlias match in its topic wins. Used by bankMatches.

src/data.ts::parseTestRequest.text: Reads a chat message like '12 hard questions on percentage in 10 minutes' and works out the topics, subjects, number of questions (15 if not stated), difficulty, time limit and whether it is about weak areas. It forgives typos, ignores pace words like 'speed drill', and notes any topic words it could not recognise.
src/data.ts::parseTestRequest.tech: Exported (query) => ParsedTestRequest. Strips pace phrases, matches TOPIC_CATALOG aliases (longest first) and SUBJECT_ALIASES with containsAlias, falls back to containsAliasFuzzy recording corrections, drops a topic whose alias is contained in a longer off-syllabus match ('hindi grammar'). Count from 'N questions' / 'of N' / a bare number not followed by a unit (1–100); difficulty from keywords (simple/speed deliberately excluded); duration from 'N min' clamped 1–180; unrecognised words extracted when nothing matched.

src/data.ts::pendingSource.text: A helper for building the source record of an official link that timed out from GovOS's own machine but was confirmed working another way. Nothing in the file uses it at present.
src/data.ts::pendingSource.tech: `(id, documentTitle, officialUrl) => DataProvenance`: FACT / OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED, dates `CHECK_DATE`, excerpt explaining the independent check and suggesting a re-check. No call sites remain in data.ts (the NCERT links it served were moved to reachable hosts).

src/data.ts::pick.text: Picks one item at random from a list, using the given random-number maker.
src/data.ts::pick.tech: pick(rng, arr) => arr[floor(rng()*arr.length)]. Used throughout the procedural generators.

src/data.ts::provenanceForSource.text: Turns a question's source note into the full 'evidence' record the app shows. A question written from an official document is shown as officially sourced; a GovOS-written one is plainly labelled as GovOS practice, not official.
src/data.ts::provenanceForSource.tech: (source?) => DataProvenance. No source: returns sscProvenance (GovOS practice, UNDER_VERIFICATION, no URL). Otherwise builds id 'prov-q-<slug>', documentTitle/officialUrl from the source, dates = CHECK_DATE, and for GOVOS_AUTHORED: RECOMMENDATION / UNDER_VERIFICATION with a 'not reproduced from a past paper' excerpt; else FACT / OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED with a 'written from ... not redistributed' excerpt.

src/data.ts::rotateStart.text: Starts a list from a random position (wrapping around), so a mixed test does not always open on the same topic.
src/data.ts::rotateStart.tech: Generic (arr) => rotated copy starting at a Math.random index; unchanged for fewer than 2 items. Used on subject and Tier-1 mixed supplier lists.

src/data.ts::sscDocument.text: Builds a source record for a quote from another SSC PDF (a later notice, the vacancy list, a result write-up), naming the document, its date, page and paragraph.

src/data.ts::sscGazetteProvenance.text: The citation used by the SSC CGL study modules: paragraphs 13.9.2–13.9.3 on page 27 of SSC's notice, which say Tier-II Paper-I is for all posts and Paper-II only for Junior Statistical Officer candidates.
src/data.ts::sscGazetteProvenance.tech: DataProvenance built with sscNotice('prov-ssc-cgl-scheme-sec13', 'Para 13.9.2–13.9.3 …', 27, quoted excerpt). Assigned as `provenance` on every MODULE_* constant.

src/data.ts::sscNotice.text: Builds a source record for one clause of SSC's CGL 2026 notice: which paragraph and page it is on and the exact words quoted from it, marked as officially verified.
src/data.ts::sscNotice.tech: `(id, clauseNumber, pageNumber, excerptText, taxonomyType='FACT') => DataProvenance` with `SSC_NOTICE_TITLE`/`SSC_NOTICE_URL`, publishedDate '2026-05-21', verifiedDate `SSC_CHECK`, OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED, authorityName 'Staff Selection Commission'. The main citation builder of the SSC record (about 170 uses, including `CLASSIFICATION_CONFIRMED`).

src/data.ts::sscNoticeSource.text: A helper that builds the source note for a question written from SSC's own CGL 2026 notice.
src/data.ts::sscNoticeSource.tech: (citation) => QuestionSource {label, url: SSC_NOTICE_2026, publisher: 'Staff Selection Commission (SSC)', kind: 'OFFICIAL_DOCUMENT'}. Used by 3 of the GA_TEMPLATES.

src/data.ts::sscProvenanceWeightage.text: The source note attached to SSC topic weightage figures. It says plainly that SSC does not publish how many questions come from each topic, so these numbers are GovOS's own rough estimate with no documented basis.
src/data.ts::sscProvenanceWeightage.tech: `DataProvenance` 'prov-ssc-weightage', no URL or dates, RECOMMENDATION / UNDER_VERIFICATION; set as `weightageProvenance` on the SSC syllabus topics (about 22 uses).

src/data.ts::sscReplaced.text: Links a later SSC statement to the earlier one it replaced, so the Evidence panel can show both: the new one says what it replaced, and the old one is marked as superseded and says what replaced it.
src/data.ts::sscReplaced.tech: `(newer, older) => [DataProvenance, DataProvenance]`: returns [newer with evidenceType RECONCILED and `supersedes: [older as SUPERSEDED]`, older with verificationLevel SUPERSEDED, RECONCILED and `supersededBy: newer`]. Used five times to pair the notice's dates/vacancy with the reopening, schedule and vacancy-list documents.

src/data.ts::sscSyllabusSource.text: The shared source details (the CGL 2026 notice, its link and verification) used by every item in SSC's official syllabus tree; each item adds its own page, paragraph and quote.
src/data.ts::sscSyllabusSource.tech: `Omit<DataProvenance, 'id'|'clauseNumber'|'excerptText'>` with SSC notice title/URL, publishedDate '2026-05-21', verifiedDate SSC_CHECK, FACT / OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED; spread into each `syllabusTree` node's provenance (about 60 nodes).

src/data.ts::suppliersForSubject.text: Gathers every in-syllabus topic of a subject that has questions to offer, plus one extra bucket for any bank questions of that subject not owned by a topic.
src/data.ts::suppliersForSubject.tech: (subject) => Supplier[]: TOPIC_CATALOG topics of that subject with inSyllabus true and a bank or generator, plus a synthetic '<subject>-other' supplier holding unclaimed bank items. Off-syllabus topics are excluded, so subject fills never include calculus.

src/data.ts::templateOwner.text: A remembered table saying which catalogue topic each bank question belongs to, worked out once and then reused.
src/data.ts::templateOwner.tech: Module-level Map<TemplateQuestion, string> | null, lazily filled by ownerOf() on first call.

src/data.ts::tgtet.text: Builds one TG TET citation: which document, which page and clause, and the exact words quoted from it.
src/data.ts::tgtet.tech: (id, doc, pageNumber, clauseNumber, excerptText, taxonomyType='FACT') → DataProvenance: OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED, publishedDate from TGTET_SOURCES, verifiedBy naming the page-image reading, authorityName TGTET_AUTHORITY.

src/data.ts::tgtetPaperNode.text: Builds one paper (Paper-I or Paper-II) of the TG TET pattern: 150 one-mark questions, 150 minutes, no negative marking, with the pass marks as printed.
src/data.ts::tgtetPaperNode.tech: (id, code, name, order, provenance, children) → ExamPatternNode level PAPER with questions/marks/durationMinutes 150, marksPerQuestion 1, negativeMarkPerWrong 0 and qualifying.asPrinted.

src/data.ts::tgtetSubject.text: Builds one subject inside a TG TET paper, with its number of questions and a note on what it covers.
src/data.ts::tgtetSubject.tech: (id, name, order, questions, note, provenance, languages?) → ExamPatternNode level SUBJECT, marks = questions (one mark each).

src/data.ts::tgtetTelugu.text: Builds the citation for a Telugu-language syllabus entry: the Telugu words are quoted as printed, but the English rendering shown beside them is GovOS’s own, so it is marked as pending verification.
src/data.ts::tgtetTelugu.tech: tgtet(id, doc, 2, …, 'INTERPRETATION') with verificationLevel UNDER_VERIFICATION and a verifiedBy that says the English is GovOS's; used by the Language-I (Telugu) topics.

src/data.ts::topicHasSupply.text: Says whether GovOS can actually provide questions for a topic, either from its bank or by generating them.
src/data.ts::topicHasSupply.tech: Exported (topic) => !!topic.generate || bankMatches(topic).length > 0. The chat uses it to refuse a topic with nothing to serve instead of substituting another.

src/data.ts::upscCutoff.text: Builds the source record for one year's UPSC Civil Services minimum qualifying marks sheet.
src/data.ts::upscCutoff.tech: `(year, url, publishedDate, excerptText) => DataProvenance` via `upscDocument` with id `prov-upsc-cutoff-<year>`, title '... <year>: minimum qualifying marks (official sheet)' and a fixed table clause.

src/data.ts::upscCutoff2021.text: Source record for UPSC's 2021 cut-off sheet (published 30 May 2022). There is no 2024 sheet because it was not on UPSC's cut-off page.

src/data.ts::upscCutoff2022.text: Source record for UPSC's 2022 cut-off sheet (published 23 May 2023).

src/data.ts::upscCutoff2023.text: Source record for UPSC's 2023 cut-off sheet (published 18 April 2024).

src/data.ts::upscCutoff2025.text: Source record for UPSC's 2025 cut-off sheet (published 9 March 2026), quoting Prelims, Mains and Final marks by category; Prelims is based on GS Paper-I only.

src/data.ts::upscDocument.text: Builds a source record for a UPSC document other than the notice, such as a press note, the exam calendar or a cut-off sheet, with its title, link, date and quoted words.
src/data.ts::upscDocument.tech: `(id, documentTitle, officialUrl, publishedDate, excerptText, clauseNumber='Whole document') => DataProvenance`, pageNumber 1, verifiedDate `UPSC_CHECK`, FACT / OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED. Used by the press-note provenances and `upscCutoff`.

src/data.ts::upscEssayProvenance.text: Builds the source record for one page of UPSC's 2026 Mains Essay paper PDF. It is marked 'under verification' because the text was read by machine (OCR) and still needs a person to check it against the page.
src/data.ts::upscEssayProvenance.tech: `(page) => DataProvenance` id `prov-upsc-essay-p<page>`, URL QP-CSM-26-010926-ESSAY.pdf, published 2026-09-01, verified 2026-09-15, FACT / UNDER_VERIFICATION, excerpt of the paper's instruction line. Used by `UPSC_OFFICIAL_QUESTIONS`.

src/data.ts::upscGroupA.text: A shortcut for writing one Group A UPSC service (such as the IAS) in the record: entry pay level 10, pay Rs 56,100-1,77,500, age 21-32, and physical standards where they apply.
src/data.ts::upscGroupA.tech: `(id, postName, department, ministry, natureOfWork, physical=false) => PostRequirement` with payLevel 'Pay Level 10 (entry)', classification 'Group A (Gazetted)', minAge 21, maxAge 32, optional physicalRequired + `UPSC_PHYSICAL_NOTE`, provenance `upscPayProvenance`.

src/data.ts::upscGroupB.text: A shortcut for writing one Group B UPSC service in the record: entry pay level 7 or 8 depending on the service's rules, age 21-32, and physical standards where they apply.
src/data.ts::upscGroupB.tech: `(id, postName, department, ministry, natureOfWork, physical=false) => PostRequirement` with payLevel 'Pay Level 7 / 8 (entry, per service rules)', both pay ranges in payScale, classification 'Group B (Gazetted)', ages 21-32, provenance `upscPayProvenance`.

src/data.ts::upscNotice.text: Builds a source record for one clause of UPSC's 2026 Civil Services notice, giving the section, page and quoted words, marked as officially verified.
src/data.ts::upscNotice.tech: `(id, clauseNumber, pageNumber, excerptText, taxonomyType='FACT') => DataProvenance` with `UPSC_NOTICE_TITLE`/`UPSC_NOTICE_URL`, publishedDate '2026-02-04', verifiedDate `UPSC_CHECK`, OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED. Used for the upscProvenance* constants and the simulator.

src/data.ts::upscPayProvenance.text: The source note for pay figures on UPSC services. Pay is not in the exam notice; it comes from each service's own rules on the 7th Pay Commission scale, so it is marked as GovOS's interpretation, still to be confirmed.
src/data.ts::upscPayProvenance.tech: `DataProvenance` 'prov-upsc-pay' pointing at doe.gov.in, INTERPRETATION / UNDER_VERIFICATION; the `provenance` of every post built by `upscGroupA`/`upscGroupB`.

src/data.ts::upscProvenance.text: Source record for the notice's cover: Examination Notice No. 05/2026-CSE of 4 February 2026, with the printed last date of 24 February 2026.
src/data.ts::upscProvenance.tech: `upscNotice('prov-upsc-01', 'Cover and Section I', 1, ...)`; used by the notification date row of `UPSC_CSE_EXAM`.

src/data.ts::upscProvenanceAdmit.text: Source record for the notice's admit-card rule: e-Admit Cards go online on the last working day of the week before the exam and are never posted or emailed.

src/data.ts::upscProvenanceApply.text: Source record for how to apply: online only at upsconline.nic.in, through a portal with four cards (account, universal registration, common application form, and the exam's own module).

src/data.ts::upscProvenanceCalendar2027.text: Source record from UPSC's 2027 exam calendar giving next year's dates: notification 13 January, last date 2 February, Prelims 23 May and Mains from 20 August 2027.

src/data.ts::upscProvenanceCentres.text: Source record for exam centres: 83 Prelims and 27 Mains centres, which the Commission may change at its discretion.

src/data.ts::upscProvenanceEAdmit.text: Source record from UPSC's 15 May 2026 press note that e-Admit Cards for the 24 May Prelims were uploaded and no paper admit card would be issued.

src/data.ts::upscProvenanceEligibility.text: Source record for the age rule: 21 to 32 years on 1 August 2026, meaning born between 2 August 1994 and 1 August 2005.

src/data.ts::upscProvenanceFee.text: Source record for fees: Rs 100 for Prelims (women, SC, ST and PwBD exempt) and a further Rs 200 for those admitted to Mains.

src/data.ts::upscProvenanceLastDate.text: Source record for the real application deadline: UPSC's examination page shows 27 February 2026, 6 pm, three days later than the date printed in the notice. Because the page is newer, it outranks the notice on this point.
src/data.ts::upscProvenanceLastDate.tech: `DataProvenance` 'prov-upsc-lastdate' citing `UPSC_CSE_PAGE_URL`'s details table, verified 2026-09-15, FACT / OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED; cites the operative 27 Feb close while the notice's 24 Feb date is kept as SUPERSEDED.

src/data.ts::upscProvenanceMains.text: Source record from UPSC's 19 August 2026 press note: Mains on 21-23 and 29-30 August 2026, with the question-paper representation portal open 31 August to 4 September.

src/data.ts::upscProvenancePrelimsResult.text: Source record from UPSC's 18 June 2026 press note on the Prelims result: 13,343 candidates shortlisted for Mains against 1,016 vacancies, and a 19-28 June window to submit details.

src/data.ts::upscProvenanceQP2026.text: Source record from the 2026 Prelims question booklets' back covers: GS Paper-I has 100 questions, Paper-II (CSAT) 80, each two hours and 200 marks, with one-third of a question's marks taken off for a wrong answer.

src/data.ts::upscProvenanceScheme.text: Source record for the exam's scheme: two 200-mark Prelims papers, a 1,750-mark written Mains, a 275-mark interview and 2,025 marks in total.
src/data.ts::upscProvenanceScheme.tech: `upscNotice('prov-upsc-scheme', 'Section III — Part A and Part B', 25, ...)`.

src/data.ts::upscProvenanceSyllabus.text: Source record for the syllabus, quoting the start of General Studies Paper I: current events, history, geography, polity, economy, environment and general science.

src/data.ts::upscProvenanceVacancy.text: Source record for the notice's vacancy estimate: about 933, including 33 for persons with disabilities, which may change later.
src/data.ts::upscProvenanceVacancy.tech: `upscNotice('prov-upsc-vac', 'Section I — Services and Posts', 2, ...)`; the later 1,016 figure comes from `upscProvenancePrelimsResult`.

src/data.ts::upscSyllabusSource.text: The shared source details used by every item in UPSC's official syllabus tree: the 2026 notice PDF, read by GovOS's exam builder on 22 September 2026 with the hierarchy as UPSC printed it.
src/data.ts::upscSyllabusSource.tech: `Omit<DataProvenance, 'id'|'clauseNumber'|'excerptText'>` with the notice title/URL, pageNumber 1, empty publishedDate, verifiedDate '2026-09-22', FACT / OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED; spread into the provenance of each `UPSC_CSE_EXAM.syllabusTree` node (about 1,000 uses).

src/data.ts::upscWeightageProvenance.text: The source note for UPSC topic weightage. UPSC publishes none, so these shares are GovOS's own count from the official 2021-2026 Prelims papers, meant only as rough guidance.
src/data.ts::upscWeightageProvenance.tech: `DataProvenance` 'prov-upsc-weightage' citing UPSC's previous-question-papers page, INTERPRETATION / UNDER_VERIFICATION; attached to the UPSC syllabus topics' weightage.

src/main.tsx::App.text: The whole GovOS app in one place: it decides which screen is showing (home, an exam's page, compare, timeline, Ask AI, Trust Panel and so on), remembers which exam the candidate is working on, and holds the pop-up windows that every screen shares (evidence, report-an-error, notifications, notification settings, the resource reader). Every 'go to' button in the app ends up here. It also loads the candidate's tracked exams, alert settings and alerts when the app opens, rebuilds the alerts once the server's exams arrive, and keeps the exam's syllabus up to date with any changes a verifier has approved.
src/main.tsx::App.tech: Root React component (no router): a single activeTab state switches the main views, and navigate() is the one navigation entry point passed to Header, ExamFinder, AIAssistant etc. It holds selectedExam (restored from storageService.getCurrentExamId()), merges authored ALL_EXAMS with registry exams into examUniverse, and derives liveExam = applyExamOverlays(applySyllabusRevisions(selectedExam, revisions), overlays), which every exam-scoped view receives. An effect on examUniverse regenerates notifications once registry exams have loaded. It mounts ClubIntro, PageWipe, Header, the unresolved-exam banner (data-exam-notice='unresolved'), ExamDetailView keyed by selectedExam.id (which turns to its own part 09 for practice), the safety-net PLANNER/PRACTICE/RESOURCES renders, and the global modals (EvidencePanel overlay, report modal, NotificationCenterModal, NotificationPreferencesModal, ResourceReaderModal).

src/main.tsx::App > EXAM_SCOPED_TABS.text: A small lookup that sends the old 'Practice', 'Resources' and 'Study Roadmap' screens to the matching part of the exam's page, since those features now live inside each exam.
src/main.tsx::App > EXAM_SCOPED_TABS.tech: Partial<Record<GovOSTab, number>> = { PRACTICE: 9, RESOURCES: 8, PLANNER: 7 }. navigate() uses it to translate those tab ids into activeTab 'EXAM_DETAIL' at that section (or the section the caller passed).

src/main.tsx::App > activeTab.text: Which main screen is currently on show, for example the home page, an exam's page or the Trust Panel. The app starts on the home page.
src/main.tsx::App > activeTab.tech: useState<GovOSTab>('FINDER'). Read by the view switch in <main>, passed to Header, used as the PageWipe token and as the key for useReplayOnChange's 'view-enter' animation; also a dependency of the syllabus-revision and overlay reload effects.

src/main.tsx::App > examNotice.text: A warning message shown at the top of the page when a link, alert or the saved session points at an exam GovOS does not have. GovOS shows this message instead of opening a different exam.
src/main.tsx::App > examNotice.tech: useState<string | null>. Set by the registry effect (saved exam missing or server FAILED), navigate() (assistantDestination returned null) and handleNotificationAction (notificationDestination returned null). Rendered as a role='alert' banner with data-exam-notice='unresolved' and a Dismiss button that clears it.

src/main.tsx::App > examOverlays.text: Official corrections to the current exam's facts that are stored on the server and laid over the exam's built-in record.
src/main.tsx::App > examOverlays.tech: useState<ExamFactOverlay[]>([]), set from examOverlayService.getOverlaysOrNull(selectedExam.id) when the reply is non-null; applied by applyExamOverlays in liveExam.

src/main.tsx::App > examSection.text: Which part of an exam's page should open, such as Overview, Syllabus or Practice. Buttons, alerts and the assistant set it to jump straight to the right part.
src/main.tsx::App > examSection.tech: useState<number>(1); the stable section id passed as ExamDetailView's initialSection. Set by navigate() (explicit section, or EXAM_SCOPED_TABS mapping) and reset to 1 by handleSelectExam.

src/main.tsx::App > examUniverse.text: The full list of exams GovOS knows about: the ones written into the app plus the ones the server has added.
src/main.tsx::App > examUniverse.tech: useMemo(() => getExamUniverse(ALL_EXAMS, registryExams), [registryExams]). Passed to ExamFinder and MyExams and used by assistantDestination / notificationDestination to resolve an exam id.

src/main.tsx::App > handleAssistantNavig.text: The function behind the Ask AI chat's 'take me there' buttons. It is the same as the app's main 'go to' function.
src/main.tsx::App > handleAssistantNavig.tech: A plain alias: const handleAssistantNavigate = navigate; passed to AIAssistant as onNavigate.

src/main.tsx::App > handleClearAllNotifi.text: Clears every alert from the candidate's list.
src/main.tsx::App > handleClearAllNotifi.tech: async: awaits storageService.clearAllNotifications() and sets notifications to [].

src/main.tsx::App > handleDispatchTestAl.text: Adds a sample alert to the top of the alerts list, so the candidate can see what an alert looks like from the settings window.
src/main.tsx::App > handleDispatchTestAl.tech: (testNotif): prepends it to storageService.getNotifications(), persists with storageService.saveNotifications(updated) and sets notifications.

src/main.tsx::App > handleMarkNotificati.tech: async (id): awaits storageService.markNotificationAsRead(id), then reloads notifications from storageService.getNotifications().

src/main.tsx::App > handleNotificationAc.text: What happens when the candidate clicks an alert: it closes the alerts window and opens the exam the alert is about at the right part of its page. If GovOS no longer has that exam, it shows a warning and opens nothing.
src/main.tsx::App > handleNotificationAc.tech: (notif): notificationDestination(notif, examUniverse); closes the notifications modal; on null sets examNotice naming notif.examId; otherwise sets selectedExam, storageService.setCurrentExamId, and calls navigate('EXAM_DETAIL', destination.section, destination.exam.id).

src/main.tsx::App > handleOpenProvenance.text: Opens the Evidence window for a fact, showing where that fact came from.
src/main.tsx::App > handleOpenProvenance.tech: (provenance) => setProvenanceModalData(provenance). Passed as onOpenProvenanceModal to most views.

src/main.tsx::App > handleOpenReport.text: Opens the 'report incorrect information' window for a particular item, with an empty form.
src/main.tsx::App > handleOpenReport.tech: (entityType, entityId): sets reportModalData {open: true, entityType, entityId}, reportSubmitted false and reportDescription ''. Passed to ExamDetailView as onOpenReportModal.

src/main.tsx::App > handleSavePreference.text: Saves the candidate's alert settings and rebuilds the alerts to follow them, for every exam GovOS holds, including those loaded from the server.
src/main.tsx::App > handleSavePreference.tech: async (newPrefs): awaits storageService.saveNotificationPreferences, sets notificationPreferences, then sets notifications from generatePersonalizedNotificationsForTrackedExams(examUniverse).

src/main.tsx::App > handleSelectExam.text: Opens an exam's page at its Overview, remembers it as the current exam, and notes the visit so recommendations can learn from it.
src/main.tsx::App > handleSelectExam.tech: (exam): setSelectedExam, storageService.setCurrentExamId(exam.id), setExamSection(1), setActiveTab('EXAM_DETAIL'), storageService.recordInteraction({type: 'VIEW', examId}). Unlike navigate() it does not scroll to the top.
