src/main.tsx::App > handleSendReport.text: Sends the candidate's error report once (ignoring repeat clicks), shows whether it reached the server or was saved for later, and closes the window after about two seconds.
src/main.tsx::App > handleSendReport.tech: async: returns if no reportModalData or reportSendingRef is set; calls storageService.submitReport({entityType, entityId, description}) under the ref guard; sets reportDelivered from result.delivered and reportSubmitted true; setTimeout 2200 ms clears reportModalData.

src/main.tsx::App > handleToggleTrackExa.text: Starts or stops tracking an exam, then rebuilds the candidate's alerts so they match what is now tracked, including exams loaded from the server.
src/main.tsx::App > handleToggleTrackExa.tech: async (examId): awaits storageService.toggleTrackExam(examId), sets trackedExamIds to the result, then sets notifications from generatePersonalizedNotificationsForTrackedExams(examUniverse).

src/main.tsx::App > isNotificationsModal.text: Whether the alerts window is open.
src/main.tsx::App > isNotificationsModal.tech: useState<boolean>(false); opened by Header's bell (onOpenNotifications), closed by the modal, by switching to preferences, or by handleNotificationAction.

src/main.tsx::App > isPreferencesModalOp.text: Whether the alert-settings window is open.
src/main.tsx::App > isPreferencesModalOp.tech: useState<boolean>(false); opened from the notification center or ExamCalendar's onOpenPreferences, closed by NotificationPreferencesModal's onClose.

src/main.tsx::App > liveExam.text: The exam as candidates should see it: the built-in record with approved syllabus changes and stored fact corrections applied. Every exam screen is given this version.
src/main.tsx::App > liveExam.tech: useMemo over [selectedExam, syllabusRevisions, examOverlays]: applyExamOverlays(applySyllabusRevisions(selectedExam, syllabusRevisions), examOverlays). Passed to ExamDetailView, EligibilityCalculator, PreparationPlanner, ExamPracticeRouter, ResourceLibrary and AIAssistant.

src/main.tsx::App > navigate.text: The single 'go to' function used by every button, assistant answer and alert. It opens the exam the request is about (or refuses and shows a warning if GovOS does not hold it), switches to the right screen and part of the page, and scrolls back to the top.
src/main.tsx::App > navigate.tech: navigate(tab, section?, examId?): resolves assistantDestination({tab, section, examId}, selectedExam, examUniverse); on null it console.warns and sets examNotice and returns. If the destination exam differs it sets selectedExam and storageService.setCurrentExamId. Tabs in EXAM_SCOPED_TABS become EXAM_DETAIL with examSection = section || mapped number; other tabs set examSection only if a section is given, then setActiveTab(tab). Ends with window.scrollTo({top: 0, behavior: 'smooth'}).

src/main.tsx::App > notificationPreferen.text: The candidate's choices about which alerts they want and when.
src/main.tsx::App > notificationPreferen.tech: useState<NotificationPreference> initialised from storageService.getNotificationPreferences(), replaced by loadNotificationPreferencesFromSQLite() on mount and by handleSavePreferences; passed to NotificationPreferencesModal.

src/main.tsx::App > notifications.text: The candidate's alerts (reminders about tracked exams' dates), shown in the bell menu.
src/main.tsx::App > notifications.tech: useState<CandidateNotification[]> initialised from storageService.getNotifications(); replaced by generatePersonalizedNotificationsForTrackedExams() on mount, after tracking or preference changes, and updated by mark-read, clear-all and test alerts. unreadCount is derived from it.

src/main.tsx::App > provenanceModalData.text: The source record currently shown in the Evidence window (where a fact came from), or nothing if the window is closed.
src/main.tsx::App > provenanceModalData.tech: useState<DataProvenance | null>(null), set by handleOpenProvenance; when non-null a modal overlay renders EvidencePanel, and clicking the overlay or Close resets it to null.

src/main.tsx::App > registryExams.text: Extra exams that the GovOS server has read from authorities' websites, on top of the exams written into the app itself.
src/main.tsx::App > registryExams.tech: useState<Exam[]>([]), filled by the registry effect from examRegistryService.loadWithStatus(); combined with ALL_EXAMS into examUniverse.

src/main.tsx::App > reportDelivered.text: Whether the last error report actually reached the server. If not, the window says the report is saved on this device and will be sent later.
src/main.tsx::App > reportDelivered.tech: useState<boolean>(true); set from submitReport's result.delivered; switches the confirmation icon colour and text between 'Report Submitted to Admin Queue' and 'Report Saved — Will Sync Shortly'.

src/main.tsx::App > reportDescription.text: The text the candidate types to describe what is wrong in their error report.
src/main.tsx::App > reportDescription.tech: useState<string>(''), bound to the report modal's textarea; cleared by handleOpenReport; the submit button is disabled while it is blank after trim; sent as description to submitReport.

src/main.tsx::App > reportModalData.text: Details of the 'report incorrect information' window: whether it is open and which item on the page is being reported.
src/main.tsx::App > reportModalData.tech: useState<{open, entityType, entityId} | null>(null). Set by handleOpenReport; non-null renders the report modal; cleared by Cancel, the X, an overlay click, or 2.2 s after a send.

src/main.tsx::App > reportSendingRef.text: A guard that stops a report from being sent twice if the button is clicked again while it is still sending.
src/main.tsx::App > reportSendingRef.tech: useRef<boolean>(false); handleSendReport returns early while it is true, sets it before awaiting storageService.submitReport and clears it in finally.

src/main.tsx::App > reportSubmitted.text: Whether the candidate has just sent their error report, so the window can show a thank-you message instead of the form.
src/main.tsx::App > reportSubmitted.tech: useState<boolean>(false); reset by handleOpenReport, set true by handleSendReport after submitReport resolves.

src/main.tsx::App > resourceForReader.text: The study resource (a PDF or video) currently open in the reader window, or nothing if the reader is closed.
src/main.tsx::App > resourceForReader.tech: useState<ResourceItem | null>(null). Set by the RESOURCES safety-net tab's onOpenResource; when non-null, ResourceReaderModal is rendered and onClose resets it to null.

src/main.tsx::App > selectedExam.text: The exam the candidate is working inside. Every exam-specific screen reads it. It is restored from last time, and falls back to SSC CGL when nothing was saved.
src/main.tsx::App > selectedExam.tech: useState<Exam> initialised from storageService.getCurrentExamId() looked up in ALL_EXAMS, else SSC_CGL_EXAM (the registry effect may later replace it with a registry exam). Updated by navigate(), handleNotificationAction and handleSelectExam, each of which also calls storageService.setCurrentExamId().

src/main.tsx::App > syllabusReadCount.text: A counter that goes up each time the candidate opens the Syllabus part of an exam, so the app re-checks for newly approved syllabus changes.
src/main.tsx::App > syllabusReadCount.tech: useState<number>(0); incremented by ExamDetailView's onSyllabusOpened; it is a dependency of the syllabus-revisions effect, forcing a re-read.

src/main.tsx::App > syllabusRevisions.text: Changes to the current exam's syllabus that a verifier has approved, fetched from the server and applied on top of the original syllabus.
src/main.tsx::App > syllabusRevisions.tech: useState<SyllabusRevision[]>([]), set by the revisions effect from syllabusLiveService.revisionsOrNull(selectedExam.id) (only on a non-null reply); consumed by applySyllabusRevisions in liveExam.

src/main.tsx::App > trackedExamIds.text: The list of exams the candidate has chosen to track for date reminders.
src/main.tsx::App > trackedExamIds.tech: useState<string[]> initialised from storageService.getTrackedExams(), replaced by loadTrackedExamsFromSQLite() on mount and by toggleTrackExam() results. Feeds Header's count, ExamFinder, MyExams, ExamCalendar and ExamDetailView's isTracked.

src/main.tsx::App > unreadCount.text: How many alerts the candidate has not read yet; shown as the number on the bell.
src/main.tsx::App > unreadCount.tech: Derived value (not a handler): notifications.filter(n => !n.isRead).length, passed to Header, which caps the badge display at '9+'.

src/main.tsx::App > useEffect.text: Five background jobs the app runs. When the app opens it switches on the gentle card reveal and smooth mouse-wheel scrolling, asks the server for any extra exams it holds (and, if the exam the candidate last opened is missing, says so instead of opening another one), and loads the candidate's tracked exams, alert settings and alerts. Whenever the exam or screen changes, it re-reads verifier-approved syllabus changes and official fact corrections for that exam.
src/main.tsx::App > useEffect.tech: This key covers five effects in App. (1) Mount: installRevealObserver(#root) and installSmoothWheel(), both cleaned up on unmount. (2) Mount: examRegistryService.loadWithStatus(); ignores SUPERSEDED; sets registryExams; if the saved current exam id is not in ALL_EXAMS it restores it from the registry or sets examNotice (different text for status FAILED vs missing). (3) [selectedExam.id, activeTab, syllabusReadCount]: syllabusLiveService.revisionsOrNull(); a null (failed) read keeps the previous revisions. (4) [selectedExam.id, activeTab]: examOverlayService.getOverlaysOrNull(), same keep-on-failure rule. (5) Mount: loadTrackedExamsFromSQLite, loadNotificationPreferencesFromSQLite, generatePersonalizedNotificationsForTrackedExams(getExamUniverse(ALL_EXAMS)) and flushPendingReports(). Effects 2-4 use a cancelled flag to drop late replies.

src/main.tsx::App > viewRef.text: A handle on the main content area so the app can replay a short entrance animation whenever the screen changes.
src/main.tsx::App > viewRef.tech: useRef<HTMLElement> attached to <main>; passed to useReplayOnChange(viewRef, activeTab, 'view-enter'), which re-adds the CSS class on each tab change without remounting children.

src/services.ts::ADMIN_TOKEN_KEY.text: The name under which the Trust Panel's admin password-like token is kept for the current browser tab.
src/services.ts::ADMIN_TOKEN_KEY.tech: String constant 'govos_admin_token', the sessionStorage key read and written by `adminToken`.

src/services.ts::AttemptSaveResult.text: The outcome of saving one practice attempt: whether it was kept in this browser, and the id it was kept under (saving the same attempt again replaces it rather than making a copy).
src/services.ts::AttemptSaveResult.tech: Exported interface {local: boolean; id: string}, returned by storageService.saveMockAttempt.

src/services.ts::AttemptSyncPlan.text: The plan for uploading attempts: groups of attempts to send together, and a list of attempts too large to send at all (reported, never silently dropped).
src/services.ts::AttemptSyncPlan.tech: Exported interface {batches: Record<string, unknown>[][]; oversized: string[]} (ids of attempts over the per-request limit).

src/services.ts::CATEGORY_WORDINGS.text: A word list matching the reservation category a candidate picks (OBC, SC, ST, PwBD, EWS, General) to the different ways authorities write it, such as 'Scheduled Castes' or 'UR'. It holds no numbers; every figure comes from the exam's own notice.
src/services.ts::CATEGORY_WORDINGS.tech: Record<string, string[]> of lower-case wordings for OBC, SC, ST, PwBD, EWS and GENERAL ('general', 'unreserved', 'ur'); 'sc/st' appears under both SC and ST. Used by findAgeRelaxation and categoryCodesOf.

src/services.ts::CHAT_HISTORY_KEY.text: The name under which recent chat conversations are saved in the browser.
src/services.ts::CHAT_HISTORY_KEY.tech: String constant 'govos_chat_history', the localStorage key for the `ChatHistoryStore`.

src/services.ts::CandidateProfile.text: The shape of a basic candidate profile record: username, chosen post, chosen exam, category and qualification.
src/services.ts::CandidateProfile.tech: Exported interface {username, target_post_id, target_exam_id, category, qualification: string}, snake_case to mirror the server's profile fields.

src/services.ts::ChatHistoryStore.text: The shape of the saved chat history: a list of recent messages for each of GovOS's chats.

src/services.ts::CutoffMatch.text: The possible outcomes when GovOS looks for the cut-off row that matches a candidate's category: a match (and how it matched), no category given, no cut-offs at all, no row for that category, or more than one possible row.
src/services.ts::CutoffMatch.tech: Discriminated union: {status: 'MATCHED', row, how: 'EXACT_LABEL' | 'SAME_CATEGORY'} | {status: 'NO_CATEGORY'} | {status: 'NO_CUTOFFS'} | {status: 'NO_ROW_FOR_CATEGORY', recorded: string[]} | {status: 'AMBIGUOUS', recorded: string[]}.

src/services.ts::DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_PR.text: The starting notification settings: in-app alerts on and browser, email and WhatsApp off; no contact details; alerts on for every kind of event (application opening, deadlines, correction windows, admit cards, exam dates, results); and every reminder (7, 3 and 1 day before, and on the last day) switched on.
src/services.ts::DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_PR.tech: Exported NotificationPreference: channels {inApp: true, browserPush/email/whatsapp: false}, contactInfo {email: '', phone: '', whatsappVerified: false}, eventSubscriptions all true, reminderSchedule {sevenDaysBefore, threeDaysBefore, oneDayBefore, lastDayHoursBefore} all true.

src/services.ts::DISCOVERY_CATEGORIES.text: The six candidate categories (General, OBC, SC, ST, PwBD, EWS) GovOS tries in turn to see whether a student's category would change their age result.
src/services.ts::DISCOVERY_CATEGORIES.tech: `UserProfile['category'][]` = ['GENERAL','OBC','SC','ST','PwBD','EWS']; the probe values for the 'category' field in `discoveryPost`.

src/services.ts::DetailedAge.text: The shape of a candidate's age broken into years, months and days, plus a ready-to-show text version.
src/services.ts::DetailedAge.tech: Interface {years, months, days: number; formatted: string}, returned by calculateDetailedAge.

src/services.ts::ExamDayChecklistStatus.text: The three possible states of an exam's exam-day checklist: fully verified from official sources, present but not fully verified, or not available.

src/services.ts::INTERACTION_HALF_LIVES_.text: How quickly each kind of action stops mattering for exam suggestions. A search fades by half in a day, a view in three days, opening resources in two weeks, reading a syllabus in three weeks, a bookmark in two months and following an exam in six months.
src/services.ts::INTERACTION_HALF_LIVES_.tech: `Record<UserInteractionType, number>` of half-lives in hours: SEARCH 24, VIEW 72, RESOURCE_ACCESS 336, SYLLABUS_READ 504, BOOKMARK 1440, FOLLOW 4320. Read by `calculateTimeDecay` when no custom half-life is passed.

src/services.ts::INTERACTION_WEIGHTS.text: A small table saying how much each kind of candidate action counts when GovOS guesses which exams they are interested in. Reading a syllabus counts most (5), following an exam or opening its resources 4, bookmarking 3.5, viewing a guide 2.5 and searching 1.5.
src/services.ts::INTERACTION_WEIGHTS.tech: `Record<UserInteractionType, number>`: FOLLOW 4.0, BOOKMARK 3.5, SYLLABUS_READ 5.0, RESOURCE_ACCESS 4.0, VIEW 2.5, SEARCH 1.5. Base weight per event in `computePersonalizedRecommendations`; an event whose type is missing from this table is skipped.

src/services.ts::LEGACY_ATTEMPT_EXAM_IDS.text: A small lookup that translates an old, short exam id written by an earlier version of GovOS ('ssc-cgl-2026') into the current id, so old practice attempts still appear under the right exam. Only known cases are listed; unknown ones are never guessed.

src/services.ts::LEVEL_RANK.text: Puts the education levels in order (Class 10 lowest, then Class 12, graduation, post-graduation) so a higher qualification can count for a lower requirement.
src/services.ts::LEVEL_RANK.tech: Record<ExamQualificationLevel, number>: CLASS_10 1, CLASS_12 2, GRADUATION 3, POST_GRADUATION 4.

src/services.ts::MAX_TURNS_PER_CHANNEL.text: Each chat keeps only its 12 most recent messages.
src/services.ts::MAX_TURNS_PER_CHANNEL.tech: Number constant 12; `conversationService.append` slices each channel's history to the last 12 turns.

src/services.ts::MockAttemptRecord.text: The shape of one saved practice test attempt: which exam and subject it was for, the score and total, how many were right, wrong or skipped, the time taken, when it was taken, and optionally the answers and the paper itself.
src/services.ts::MockAttemptRecord.tech: Exported interface {id, exam_id, topic_id?, subject, score, total_marks, correct_count, incorrect_count, unattempted_count, time_taken_seconds, attempted_at?, userAnswers?, paperData?, details?: {userAnswers?, paperData?, [key]: any}}.

src/services.ts::NETWORK_ERROR.text: The standard message shown when the GovOS server cannot be reached at all.
src/services.ts::NETWORK_ERROR.tech: `(e) => string` producing 'GovOS server unreachable: <e.message or "network error">'; used in catch blocks of researchService and claudeService._post.

src/services.ts::QUALIFICATION_LEVEL_WOR.text: The plain wording used in eligibility messages for each education level, such as 'Class 12 pass' or 'a Bachelor's degree'.
src/services.ts::QUALIFICATION_LEVEL_WOR.tech: Exported Record<ExamQualificationLevel, string>: CLASS_10 'Class 10 pass', CLASS_12 'Class 12 pass', GRADUATION "a Bachelor's degree", POST_GRADUATION "a Master's degree".

src/services.ts::QUALIFICATION_RULES.text: The kinds of eligibility rule that concern education: a required degree level, a required subject, a minimum percentage, and a condition stated in words.
src/services.ts::QUALIFICATION_RULES.tech: Constant array of EligibilityRule ruleTypes: DEGREE_REQUIRED, BRANCH_SPECIALIZATION, PERCENTAGE_MIN, STATED_CONDITION.

src/services.ts::QualOutcome.text: The result of checking a qualification rule: met, not met, or cannot be decided, with the reasons in words.

src/services.ts::QualificationLevel.text: The education levels GovOS can recognise: the exam levels (Class 10, Class 12, graduation, post-graduation) plus 'in the final year of a degree' and 'has not passed Class 12'.

src/services.ts::RECOMMENDATION_HALF_LIF.text: A fallback fading time of 48 hours, used for an action whose kind has no fading time of its own.
src/services.ts::RECOMMENDATION_HALF_LIF.tech: Number constant 48, kept for backwards compatibility. `calculateTimeDecay` falls back to it when neither a custom half-life nor a known `INTERACTION_HALF_LIVES_HOURS` entry applies.

src/services.ts::SIGNAL_STRENGTH_MULTIPL.text: An extra boost for actions that show real commitment. Following an exam or reading its syllabus is multiplied by 1.6, a bookmark by 1.4, opening resources by 1.3, while a plain view or search stays at 1.
src/services.ts::SIGNAL_STRENGTH_MULTIPL.tech: `Record<UserInteractionType, number>`: FOLLOW 1.6, BOOKMARK 1.4, SYLLABUS_READ 1.6, RESOURCE_ACCESS 1.3, VIEW 1.0, SEARCH 1.0. Multiplied into each event's score (weight x decay x multiplier) in `computePersonalizedRecommendations`.

src/services.ts::STORAGE_KEYS.text: The names under which GovOS saves things in the browser: the current exam, target post, daily study hours, result entry, completed modules, practice attempts, profile, bookmarks, tracked exams, notification settings and alerts, ticked syllabus topics, roadmap goals, pending error reports and usage events. It also names where the study-plan choices are kept.
src/services.ts::STORAGE_KEYS.tech: Constant map of localStorage keys: CURRENT_EXAM 'govos_current_exam_id', TARGET_POST 'govos_target_post_id', DAILY_HOURS 'govos_daily_study_hours', RESULT_ENTRY 'govos_result_entry', COMPLETED_MODULES, MOCK_ATTEMPTS, PROFILE 'govos_candidate_profile', BOOKMARKS 'govos_bookmarked_resources', TRACKED_EXAMS, NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCES, NOTIFICATIONS 'govos_candidate_notifications', COMPLETED_TOPICS 'govos_completed_syllabus_topics', ROADMAP_GOALS, PENDING_REPORTS, USER_INTERACTIONS 'govos_user_interactions'. + STUDY_PLAN: 'govos_study_plan'.

src/services.ts::SYNC_BATCH_BUDGET_BYTES.text: The target size of each batch when sending saved attempts to the server: 4 megabytes, so a long history goes in several small uploads.
src/services.ts::SYNC_BATCH_BUDGET_BYTES.tech: Exported constant 4 * 1024 * 1024: default batch budget in planAttemptSyncBatches, measured on the serialised JSON.

src/services.ts::SYNC_REQUEST_LIMIT_BYTE.text: The largest single upload the GovOS server accepts: 16 megabytes.
src/services.ts::SYNC_REQUEST_LIMIT_BYTE.tech: Exported constant 16 * 1024 * 1024, mirroring app.py's MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH; planAttemptSyncBatches uses it minus 64 KiB as the per-attempt hard limit.

src/services.ts::StorageService.text: The single place where GovOS remembers what a candidate has done: their chosen post, current exam, tracked and bookmarked exams, practice test attempts, ticked syllabus topics, roadmap goals, alerts, saved resources, profile and recent activity. It writes everything to the browser first (so the app works offline) and then sends a copy to the GovOS server's database when it can. It also builds the candidate's date-based alerts and hands scorecard uploads to the server to be read. It also keeps each exam’s study-plan choices.
src/services.ts::StorageService.tech: Class (exported only as the singleton `storageService`) over localStorage keys, with fire-and-forget fetches to `/api/sqlite/*`; userId is fixed to 'default-candidate'. Covers target post, current exam id, result entries, `parseResultDocument` (base64 POST to `/api/results/parse`, mapping 413/non-JSON/offline to typed failures), completed modules, mock attempts (`saveMockAttempt` returns `{local,id}`, `getMockAttempts(examId)` filters by exam, `loadMockAttemptsFromSQLite`), tracked/bookmarked exams, notification preferences and `generatePersonalizedNotificationsForTrackedExams`, completed topics and roadmap goals per exam, queued error reports (`submitReport`/`flushPendingReports`), resource bookmarks, `verifyResourceLinks`, a single-flight `syncAllToSQLite` that batches attempts and reports failed ids, interaction events, the profile, `getPersonalizedRecommendations` (delegates to `computePersonalizedRecommendations`) and `checkSQLiteHealth`. + getStudyPlanPrefs / setStudyPlanPrefs.

src/services.ts::StorageService.checkSQL.text: Asks the GovOS server whether its database is available, and reports 'offline' if the server does not answer.
src/services.ts::StorageService.checkSQL.tech: GETs /api/sqlite/status and returns the parsed JSON on success; returns {status: 'offline'} on a non-OK reply or network error.

src/services.ts::StorageService.clearAll.text: Deletes all of the candidate's alerts, in the browser and on the server.
src/services.ts::StorageService.clearAll.tech: Saves [] to 'govos_candidate_notifications' and awaits DELETE /api/sqlite/notifications; network errors are swallowed.

src/services.ts::StorageService.clearUse.text: Erases the candidate's activity history used for recommendations, in the browser and on the server.
src/services.ts::StorageService.clearUse.tech: Removes localStorage 'govos_user_interactions' and fire-and-forget sends DELETE /api/sqlite/interactions?user_id=default-candidate; errors are ignored or logged.

src/services.ts::StorageService.flushPen.text: Tries again to send any error reports that were queued while the server was unreachable, and keeps the ones that still fail.
src/services.ts::StorageService.flushPen.tech: For each report from getPendingReports(), awaits POST /api/reports in order; OK replies count as sent, non-OK or network failures are kept. Writes the still-pending list back to 'govos_pending_reports' and returns the number sent (0 immediately if the queue is empty).

src/services.ts::StorageService.generate.text: Builds the candidate's alert list from the dates of the exams they follow: applications opening, deadline countdowns, correction windows, admit cards, exam dates, answer keys and results. Each alert appears only while it is actually true right now, and nothing says an event has happened unless its exact, confirmed date has passed.
src/services.ts::StorageService.generate.tech: For each tracked exam (getTrackedExams) and each non-SUPERSEDED date with a parseable dateTimeStr, it emits alerts gated by prefs.eventSubscriptions and reminderSchedule: APPLICATION_OPEN, CORRECTION_WINDOW, ADMIT_CARD, ANSWER_KEY and RESULT only when firm (no displayWhen, not tentative) and past; APPLICATION_CLOSE reminders only for exact dates inside their windows (7d: 7 to 3 days before, 3d: 3 to 1, 1d: last 24 h, lastday: from midnight to the close); EXAM_TIER1 from any time until a day after the date, with a displayWhen-aware message. Ids are stable (notif-<examId>-<kind>, a second same-kind date gets a -YYYY-MM-DD suffix); isRead carries over and a stored createdAt is kept only if it lies inside the alert's window and is not in the future, otherwise stamped with local wall-clock time. Existing 'notif-test-' alerts are kept; the list is sorted unread first, then CRITICAL>HIGH>NORMAL, then newest, saved to 'govos_candidate_notifications', POSTed fire-and-forget to /api/sqlite/notifications {notifications}, and returned. Delivered channels are IN_APP plus PUSH/EMAIL/WHATSAPP where enabled and contact details allow.

src/services.ts::StorageService.getBookm.text: Lists the exams the candidate has bookmarked.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getBookm.tech: Parses localStorage 'govos_bookmarked_resources' (the same key the resource bookmarks use) and returns it if it is an array, else []; parse errors are logged and give [].

src/services.ts::StorageService.getBookm.text: Lists the study resources the candidate has saved for later.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getBookm.tech: Parses localStorage 'govos_bookmarked_resources' and returns it if it is an array, else []; parse errors are logged. The same key also holds exam bookmarks (getBookmarkedExams).

src/services.ts::StorageService.getCompl.text: Lists which study modules the candidate has marked as done. A new candidate gets an empty list, never pretend progress.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getCompl.tech: Returns readStoredJson('govos_completed_modules', isPlainObject, {}) as Record<moduleId, boolean>. Unreadable or non-object data is copied aside to 'govos_completed_modules__corrupt' and {} is returned.

src/services.ts::StorageService.getCompl.text: Reads which syllabus topics the candidate has ticked off for one exam.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getCompl.tech: Reads readStoredJson('govos_completed_syllabus_topics', isPlainObject, {}) and returns the object stored under examId, or {} if missing or not an object.

src/services.ts::StorageService.getCurre.text: Remembers which exam the candidate was last working inside, so GovOS can reopen it. Empty until they open an exam.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getCurre.tech: Returns localStorage 'govos_current_exam_id', or '' when unset or when storage access throws.

src/services.ts::StorageService.getDaily.text: Reads how many hours a day the candidate said they can study. Gives nothing back until they have actually told GovOS, so the plan is never based on a made-up number.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getDaily.tech: Parses localStorage 'govos_daily_study_hours' with parseFloat; returns the number only if finite and > 0, otherwise null (also null when storage throws).

src/services.ts::StorageService.getMockA.text: Lists the practice tests the candidate has taken for one exam, so each exam shows only its own scores. Records that belong to another exam are left out.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getMockA.tech: Reads readStoredJson('govos_mock_attempts', Array.isArray, []) and keeps plain objects with a string id. With examId, returns only attempts whose canonicalExamId(exam_id) equals canonicalExamId(examId) (legacy aliases resolved) and console.debugs how many strays were hidden; without examId returns all (intended only for sync/export).

src/services.ts::StorageService.getNotif.text: Reads the candidate's alert settings (which channels, which events, how far ahead to remind), filling any missing setting with the default.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getNotif.tech: Parses localStorage 'govos_notification_preferences' and deep-merges it over DEFAULT_NOTIFICATION_PREFERENCES for channels, contactInfo, eventSubscriptions and reminderSchedule. Returns a copy of the defaults when nothing is stored or parsing fails (logged).

src/services.ts::StorageService.getNotif.text: Lists the alerts currently held for the candidate in this browser.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getNotif.tech: Returns entries of readStoredJson('govos_candidate_notifications', Array.isArray, []) that are plain objects with a string id; corrupt data is kept aside as '__corrupt' and [] returned.

src/services.ts::StorageService.getPendi.text: Reads the error reports the candidate tried to send while the server was unreachable, which are waiting to be sent again.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getPendi.tech: Private. Parses localStorage 'govos_pending_reports' and returns it if it is an array, else []; parse errors are logged.

src/services.ts::StorageService.getPerso.text: Works out which exams to suggest to the candidate, based on what they have done in GovOS and their profile.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getPerso.tech: Calls computePersonalizedRecommendations(allExams, getUserInteractions(), profile || getProfile() || undefined, referenceTime) and returns its ExamRecommendation[]. Purely local; no network.

src/services.ts::StorageService.getProfi.text: Reads the candidate's saved profile (such as date of birth, degree and category) used for eligibility checks. Gives nothing back if they have not filled it in.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getProfi.tech: Returns the JSON-parsed localStorage 'govos_candidate_profile' as UserProfile, or null when absent or unparseable (parse errors logged). No validation of the shape.

src/services.ts::StorageService.getResul.text: Reads back the marks and category the candidate typed in (or confirmed from their scorecard) for one exam, so the Results section can show them again.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getResul.tech: Reads localStorage 'govos_result_entry_<examId>' (or plain 'govos_result_entry' when no examId is given) and JSON-parses it into a MultiTierResultEntry. Returns null when absent, unparseable or when storage throws.

src/services.ts::StorageService.getRoadm.text: Reads which study-roadmap goals the candidate has ticked off for one exam.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getRoadm.tech: Reads readStoredJson('govos_roadmap_goals', isPlainObject, {}) and returns the object stored under examId, or {}.

src/services.ts::StorageService.getStudy.text: Reads back the study-plan choices the candidate made for one exam.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getStudy.tech: (examId) → StudyPlanPrefs from govos_study_plan[examId]; {} when none or the store is unreadable.

src/services.ts::StorageService.getTarge.text: Tells GovOS which job post the candidate has chosen to aim for. If they have not chosen one, it says so with an empty answer instead of picking one for them.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getTarge.tech: Returns localStorage 'govos_target_post_id', or '' when unset or when storage access throws. Never returns a default post id.

src/services.ts::StorageService.getTrack.text: Lists the exams the candidate has chosen to follow. If they follow none, the list is empty rather than quietly including SSC CGL.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getTrack.tech: Returns string ids from readStoredJson('govos_tracked_exams', Array.isArray, []); non-string entries are dropped. Returns [] when nothing is stored (corrupt data is kept aside as '__corrupt').

src/services.ts::StorageService.getUserI.text: Reads the history of what the candidate has done (such as following or bookmarking exams) that GovOS uses to suggest exams.
src/services.ts::StorageService.getUserI.tech: Parses localStorage 'govos_user_interactions' and returns it if it is an array, else []; parse errors are logged.

src/services.ts::StorageService.hasTarge.text: A yes/no check for whether the candidate has picked a target post yet.
src/services.ts::StorageService.hasTarge.tech: Returns getTargetPost() !== '' (i.e. whether localStorage 'govos_target_post_id' holds a non-empty value).

src/services.ts::StorageService.isBookma.text: A yes/no check for whether the candidate has bookmarked a given exam.

src/services.ts::StorageService.isResour.text: A yes/no check for whether a given resource is on the candidate's saved list.

src/services.ts::StorageService.isTracke.text: A yes/no check for whether the candidate follows a given exam.

src/services.ts::StorageService.loadBook.text: Fetches the candidate's saved resources from the server and combines them with the browser's list, so nothing saved while offline is dropped.
src/services.ts::StorageService.loadBook.tech: GETs /api/sqlite/bookmarks; if data.resource_ids is an array, stores and returns the de-duplicated union of local and server ids in 'govos_bookmarked_resources'. Otherwise, or offline, returns the local list unchanged.

src/services.ts::StorageService.loadInte.text: Fetches the candidate's activity history from the server and combines it with the browser's copy, keeping the 100 most recent.
src/services.ts::StorageService.loadInte.tech: GETs /api/sqlite/interactions?user_id=default-candidate; if data.interactions is an array, adds server events whose ids are not local, sorts newest first, keeps 100, writes 'govos_user_interactions' and returns the result. Otherwise, or offline, returns getUserInteractions().

src/services.ts::StorageService.loadMock.text: Fetches the candidate's saved practice tests from the server and merges them into the browser's copy without losing anything the browser already holds. If the server cannot be reached, it just uses the browser's list.
src/services.ts::StorageService.loadMock.tech: GETs /api/sqlite/mock-attempts (with ?exam_id=<canonical id> when examId is given, so filtering happens in SQL). Each server row gets userAnswers/paperData lifted from details; rows are laid over local records by id (an empty server userAnswers/paperData never replaces a local one), the merged list is written (first 50) to 'govos_mock_attempts', and getMockAttempts(examId) is returned. Network errors, non-OK replies or an empty server list all fall back to getMockAttempts(examId).

src/services.ts::StorageService.loadNoti.text: Fetches the candidate's alert settings from the server, but only if this browser has none saved, so the candidate's own choices are never overwritten by server defaults.
src/services.ts::StorageService.loadNoti.tech: If 'govos_notification_preferences' exists, returns getNotificationPreferences() without a network call. Otherwise GETs /api/sqlite/notifications/preferences, takes data.preferences || data, and adopts it only if stored !== false and it has channels or eventSubscriptions: merged over defaults, written to localStorage and returned. Otherwise, or offline, returns getNotificationPreferences() (the defaults).

src/services.ts::StorageService.loadTrac.text: Reconciles the list of followed exams with the server. The browser's list always wins; the server's list is used only by a browser that has never had one, and otherwise the server is corrected to match the browser.
src/services.ts::StorageService.loadTrac.tech: Checks whether 'govos_tracked_exams' exists, then GETs /api/sqlite/tracked-exams (reads tracked_exam_ids or tracked_exams). With no local key it adopts a non-empty server list via setTrackedExams. With a local key it POSTs /api/sqlite/tracked-exams {exam_id, is_tracked: true} for each local-only id and {is_tracked: false} for each server-only id, one by one, ignoring failures. Always returns getTrackedExams(); offline leaves the local list untouched.

src/services.ts::StorageService.markNoti.text: Marks one alert (or all of them) as read, in the browser and on the server.
src/services.ts::StorageService.markNoti.tech: Sets isRead: true on the notification whose id matches, or on every one when id === 'ALL', saves via saveNotifications, then awaits POST /api/sqlite/notifications/read {notification_id: id}; network errors are swallowed.

src/services.ts::StorageService.parseRes.text: Sends an uploaded scorecard file to the GovOS server to read the marks, category and other details from it. The file is only read, never kept; if anything goes wrong it explains why and suggests typing the marks in.
src/services.ts::StorageService.parseRes.tech: Reads the File into an ArrayBuffer, base64-encodes it in 8 KB chunks and POSTs {filename, contentBase64, examId} to /api/results/parse, returning the server's JSON (ok, reason, message, confidence, method TEXT_LAYER|OCR, fields such as marks/category/rollNumber and exam-specific marks, notes, excerpt). If the reply is not JSON it returns ok:false with reason FILE_TOO_LARGE (HTTP 413) or SERVER_ERROR; a network failure returns ok:false, reason SERVER_UNREACHABLE. Never throws.

src/services.ts::StorageService.recordIn.text: Logs one thing the candidate did (for example following an exam) so recommendations can take it into account. Only the latest 100 are kept.
src/services.ts::StorageService.recordIn.tech: Builds a UserInteractionEvent with defaults targetId = targetId || examId || 'unknown' and targetType 'EXAM', an id 'act-<ms>-<random>' and timestamp Date.now(); prepends it to 'govos_user_interactions' (capped at 100) and fire-and-forget calls syncInteractionToSQLite. Returns the full event; storage errors are logged.

src/services.ts::StorageService.runSyncA.text: Does the actual full copy to the server: the profile, ticked modules, followed exams, alert settings and every practice test, sent in several moderate-sized parts. It then reports exactly which tests were and were not stored.
src/services.ts::StorageService.runSyncA.tech: Private. Splits getMockAttempts() (all exams) with planAttemptSyncBatches into size-bounded batches plus oversized ids. POSTs /api/sqlite/sync-all once per batch, sequentially: the first carries user_id, profile {target_post_id}, completed_modules, tracked_exams, notification_preferences and the first batch; later ones only user_id and their batch (an empty history still sends one request). A failed request's attempt ids (and '(profile and modules)' for an empty first request) go into failedAttemptIds; nothing is retried. Returns {success, message, requests, syncedAttempts, failedAttemptIds}, with an 'offline' message when no request reached the server and a count-of-stored message when some failed.

src/services.ts::StorageService.saveMock.text: Saves a finished practice test in the browser and sends it to the server. Saving the same test twice replaces it rather than making a duplicate, and it reports honestly whether the browser copy was kept.
src/services.ts::StorageService.saveMock.tech: Removes any stored attempt with the same id, prepends the new one, caps at 50 and writes 'govos_mock_attempts' via writeStored. Always fires syncMockAttemptToSQLite (POST /api/sqlite/mock-attempts), even if the local write failed. Returns {local: boolean, id}.

src/services.ts::StorageService.saveNoti.text: Saves the candidate's alert settings in the browser and sends a copy to the server.
src/services.ts::StorageService.saveNoti.tech: Writes prefs JSON to 'govos_notification_preferences', then awaits POST /api/sqlite/notifications/preferences with the prefs as the body. Any storage or network error is caught and logged; returns void.

src/services.ts::StorageService.saveNoti.text: Saves the candidate's list of alerts in this browser.
src/services.ts::StorageService.saveNoti.tech: Writes the CandidateNotification[] as JSON to 'govos_candidate_notifications'; errors are caught and logged. No server call.

src/services.ts::StorageService.saveProf.text: Saves the candidate's profile in the browser and sends their category and qualification to the server as a copy.
src/services.ts::StorageService.saveProf.tech: Writes the full profile JSON to 'govos_candidate_profile', then fire-and-forget calls syncProfileToSQLite({category: profile.category, qualification: profile.degree}) (POST /api/sqlite/profile). Storage errors are logged and skip the sync.

src/services.ts::StorageService.setBookm.text: Saves the list of resources the candidate has saved for later.
src/services.ts::StorageService.setBookm.tech: Private. Writes ids as JSON to 'govos_bookmarked_resources'; errors are caught and logged.

src/services.ts::StorageService.setCompl.text: Marks one study module as done or not done, saves it in the browser and sends a copy to the server.
src/services.ts::StorageService.setCompl.tech: Reads getCompletedModules(), sets current[moduleId] = isCompleted, writes JSON to localStorage 'govos_completed_modules' and fire-and-forget calls syncProgressToSQLite (POST /api/sqlite/progress {module_id, is_completed}). Returns the updated map even if the write threw (error logged, sync skipped).

src/services.ts::StorageService.setCurre.text: Saves which exam the candidate is now looking at, so the next visit starts there.
src/services.ts::StorageService.setCurre.tech: Writes examId to localStorage 'govos_current_exam_id'. A storage error is caught and logged with console.warn; nothing is returned and no server call is made.

src/services.ts::StorageService.setDaily.text: Saves the number of hours a day the candidate says they can study.
src/services.ts::StorageService.setDaily.tech: Writes String(hours) to localStorage 'govos_daily_study_hours'; a storage error is caught and logged. No validation and no server call.

src/services.ts::StorageService.setPendi.text: Saves the queue of error reports still waiting to be sent, keeping at most 50.
src/services.ts::StorageService.setPendi.tech: Private. Writes reports.slice(0, 50) as JSON to 'govos_pending_reports'; errors are caught and logged.

src/services.ts::StorageService.setResul.text: Saves (or clears) the candidate's entered result for one exam in this browser, and reports whether the save actually worked.
src/services.ts::StorageService.setResul.tech: Key is 'govos_result_entry_<examId>' or 'govos_result_entry'. A non-null entry is written via writeStored (returns false and leaves the old value if the browser refuses); null removes the key, returning true, or false if removeItem throws. No server call.

src/services.ts::StorageService.setStudy.text: Saves the candidate’s study-plan choices for one exam, so the plan opens the same way next time.
src/services.ts::StorageService.setStudy.tech: (examId, prefs) → boolean: writes govos_study_plan[examId]; false (and a warning) when the browser refuses the write.

src/services.ts::StorageService.setTarge.text: Saves the job post the candidate wants to aim for, in the browser and also as a copy on the GovOS server.
src/services.ts::StorageService.setTarge.tech: Writes postId to localStorage 'govos_target_post_id', then calls syncProfileToSQLite({target_post_id}) (fire-and-forget POST /api/sqlite/profile, partial update). Storage errors are caught and logged; if setItem throws, the server sync is skipped.

src/services.ts::StorageService.setTrack.text: Saves the list of exams the candidate follows in this browser.
src/services.ts::StorageService.setTrack.tech: Writes JSON of examIds to localStorage 'govos_tracked_exams'; storage errors are caught and logged. No server call.

src/services.ts::StorageService.submitRe.text: Sends a candidate's report that some data looks wrong to the GovOS review queue. If the server cannot be reached, the report is kept in the browser to send later, so it is never lost.
src/services.ts::StorageService.submitRe.tech: POSTs {entityType, entityId, description, createdAt: ISO now} to /api/reports. Returns {delivered: true} on an OK reply; on a non-OK reply or network error it prepends the payload to the pending queue (setPendingReports, capped at 50) and returns {delivered: false}.

src/services.ts::StorageService.syncAllT.text: Copies everything the candidate has saved in the browser to the server. If a copy is already running, a second request waits for that one instead of sending everything twice.
src/services.ts::StorageService.syncAllT.tech: Single-flight wrapper: if no sync is in flight it starts runSyncAll() and stores the promise in syncAllInFlight (cleared in finally); concurrent callers receive the same Promise<SyncAllResult>.

src/services.ts::StorageService.syncInte.text: Sends one logged candidate action to the server as a backup copy.
src/services.ts::StorageService.syncInte.tech: Awaits POST /api/sqlite/interactions with the event plus user_id ('default-candidate'). Network errors are swallowed.

src/services.ts::StorageService.syncMock.text: Sends one finished practice test to the server as a backup copy.
src/services.ts::StorageService.syncMock.tech: Private. Builds the body with attemptSyncPayload(attempt) (top-level userAnswers/paperData folded into details) and awaits POST /api/sqlite/mock-attempts. Network errors are swallowed; the HTTP status is not checked.

src/services.ts::StorageService.syncProf.text: Sends a change to the candidate's profile to the server as a backup copy; the browser copy stays the main one.
src/services.ts::StorageService.syncProf.tech: Private. Awaits POST /api/sqlite/profile with the partial profile (only the fields given, e.g. target_post_id or category/qualification). Network errors are swallowed.

src/services.ts::StorageService.syncProg.text: Sends one done/not-done tick (a study module, syllabus topic or roadmap goal) to the server as a backup copy.
src/services.ts::StorageService.syncProg.tech: Private. Awaits POST /api/sqlite/progress {module_id, is_completed}; module ids may be plain module ids or 'topic:<exam>:<id>' / 'goal:<exam>:<key>'. Network errors are swallowed.

src/services.ts::StorageService.toggleBo.text: Adds or removes an exam from the candidate's bookmarks in this browser; adding one also counts as a signal for recommendations.
src/services.ts::StorageService.toggleBo.tech: Toggles examId in the list from getBookmarkedExams() and writes it to localStorage 'govos_bookmarked_resources' (shared with resource bookmarks). On add it calls recordInteraction({type: 'BOOKMARK', examId}). No bookmark-specific server call. Returns the updated list; write errors are logged.

src/services.ts::StorageService.toggleCo.text: Flips one study module between done and not done.
src/services.ts::StorageService.toggleCo.tech: Computes !current[moduleId] from getCompletedModules() and delegates to setCompletedModule(moduleId, next); returns the updated map.

src/services.ts::StorageService.toggleCo.text: Ticks or unticks one syllabus topic for one exam, saves it in the browser and sends a copy to the server.
src/services.ts::StorageService.toggleCo.tech: Flips topicId in getCompletedTopics(examId), writes the whole per-exam map back to 'govos_completed_syllabus_topics', and fire-and-forget calls syncProgressToSQLite with module id 'topic:<examId>:<topicId>' (POST /api/sqlite/progress). Returns the new map; a write error is logged and skips the sync.

src/services.ts::StorageService.toggleRe.text: Saves or unsaves a study resource for later, in the browser and as a copy on the server.
src/services.ts::StorageService.toggleRe.tech: Toggles resource.id in 'govos_bookmarked_resources' and fire-and-forget POSTs /api/sqlite/bookmarks {resource_id, title, resource_type, url, is_bookmarked}; network errors are ignored. Returns the updated id list.

src/services.ts::StorageService.toggleRo.text: Ticks or unticks one roadmap goal for one exam, saves it in the browser and sends a copy to the server.
src/services.ts::StorageService.toggleRo.tech: Flips goalKey in getRoadmapGoals(examId), writes the per-exam map back to 'govos_roadmap_goals', and fire-and-forget calls syncProgressToSQLite with module id 'goal:<examId>:<goalKey>' (POST /api/sqlite/progress). Returns the new map; write errors are logged.

src/services.ts::StorageService.toggleTr.text: Starts or stops following an exam: updates the browser's list, tells the server, and, when the candidate starts following, records that as a signal for exam recommendations.
src/services.ts::StorageService.toggleTr.tech: Adds or removes examId in 'govos_tracked_exams' via setTrackedExams, then awaits POST /api/sqlite/tracked-exams {exam_id, is_tracked} (network errors swallowed). On a new track it calls recordInteraction({type: 'FOLLOW', examId}). Returns the updated id list.

src/services.ts::StorageService.verifyRe.text: Asks the GovOS server to check whether a list of web links still open, because the browser cannot test other websites directly.
src/services.ts::StorageService.verifyRe.tech: POSTs {urls} to /api/resources/verify-links and returns data.results (ResourceLinkCheck[]) when it is an array. Returns [] on a non-OK reply, bad shape or network error, so the caller shows 'could not verify'.

src/services.ts::StudyPlanPrefs.text: What a candidate chose for an exam’s study plan: how many days, how many hours a day, which paper, and which subjects to leave out.
src/services.ts::StudyPlanPrefs.tech: Interface {days?, hoursPerDay?, track?, excludedSubjects?}; every field optional — absent means not chosen.

src/services.ts::SyncAllResult.text: The outcome of a full sync to the server: whether it worked, a message, how many requests and attempts were sent, and which attempts were not stored.
src/services.ts::SyncAllResult.tech: Exported interface {success, message, requests?, syncedAttempts?, failedAttemptIds?: string[]}.

src/services.ts::_healthCache.text: A short memory of the last check on whether Claude is ready, so GovOS does not ask the server again for every chat message.
src/services.ts::_healthCache.tech: Module-level `{ at: number; value: ClaudeHealth | null } | null`, written by `claudeService.healthCached` and reused while younger than its maxAgeMs (default 30 s).

src/services.ts::additionReads.text: The shared two-minute memory for the extra resources verifiers added to an exam's library; it is cleared whenever a verifier adds or removes one.
src/services.ts::additionReads.tech: `sharedRead<ResourceAddition[]>(120_000)`, keyed by exam id; used by `resourceLiveService.additions(examId)` and cleared by `addResource` / `retireResource`.

src/services.ts::adminHeaders.text: Adds the admin token to a request to the server when the verifier has entered one, so protected Trust Panel actions are allowed.
src/services.ts::adminHeaders.tech: `() => Record<string,string>`: `{ 'X-GovOS-Admin-Token': token }` when `adminToken.get()` is non-empty, else `{}`. Spread into every admin-guarded fetch (research, syllabus revisions, overlays, additions, Claude jobs).

src/services.ts::adminToken.text: Remembers the admin token a verifier typed into the Trust Panel, only for this browser tab, and forgets it when the tab closes. If the browser blocks storage, the token is simply not remembered.
src/services.ts::adminToken.tech: Object with `get(): string` and `set(value)` over sessionStorage key `ADMIN_TOKEN_KEY`; an empty value removes it; every storage access is wrapped in try/catch (get returns '' on failure).

src/services.ts::adminToken.get.text: Reads the administrator password-like code entered in the Trust Panel for this browser tab, if any.
src/services.ts::adminToken.get.tech: Returns sessionStorage 'govos_admin_token' (tab-scoped, not persisted), or '' when unset or when sessionStorage throws.

src/services.ts::adminToken.set.text: Remembers, or forgets, the administrator code for this browser tab only; it is never kept after the tab closes.
src/services.ts::adminToken.set.tech: A non-empty value is written to sessionStorage 'govos_admin_token'; an empty value removes it. Storage errors are silently ignored.

src/services.ts::applyExamOverlays.text: Lays the server's verified fact overlays over an exam record without changing the original. Only overlays for this exact exam and year, not retired, not conflicting and verified (or marked 'not published') are used. They can add, edit or replace dates, posts, age relaxations, syllabus topics, resources, papers, answer keys, admit-card events, results, cut-offs, FAQs, official links, corrigenda, checklists, overview text and roadmaps; a replaced date is kept but marked superseded.
src/services.ts::applyExamOverlays.tech: Pure `(exam, overlays) => Exam`; returns the same object when no overlay is active (`o.examId === exam.id`, cycle matches `getExamCycle` when both set, not retired, kind not CONFLICT, status VERIFIED or NOT_PUBLISHED). Switches on `o.domain`: dates support SUPERSEDE (old row status SUPERSEDED, new row upserted), AMEND and ADD; posts ADD/AMEND/SUPERSEDE (supersede removes the old post); eligibility upserts `ageRelaxations` by category; syllabus ADD/AMEND (sets `officialProvenance`); answerKeys ADD/SUPERSEDE; officialLinks upsert by url or title; overview sets `overviewDescription`/`vacanciesTotal`; the rest ADD via `upsertById`. Shallow-copies each touched array.

src/services.ts::applySyllabusRevisions.text: Takes an exam's official syllabus and lays the verifier's recorded changes on top of it, in the order they were made: adding new topics, editing existing ones, or removing retired ones. Every changed topic is marked as still under verification and cites only the notice the change named. If there are no changes for this exam, the exam is returned untouched.
src/services.ts::applySyllabusRevisions.tech: Pure `(exam, revisions) => Exam`. Filters revisions by `examId === exam.id`; returns the same object when none. RETIRE removes the topic by `topicId`; AMEND merges only the supplied fields; ADD appends a topic with defaults (subject 'General Awareness', tier 'BOTH', name 'Untitled topic', weights 0). Each changed topic gets `revision` metadata and a new provenance (title = noticeTitle or 'Verifier note (no notice cited)', URL/published date only from the revision, verifiedDate = appliedAt day, EXPLANATION / UNDER_VERIFICATION). Returns `{...exam, syllabus}`.

src/services.ts::attemptSyncPayload.text: Prepares one practice attempt for sending to the server, putting the answers and the paper in one place only, so the paper is not sent twice.
src/services.ts::attemptSyncPayload.tech: Exported (att) => Record<string, unknown>: strips top-level userAnswers, paperData and details, then returns the remaining fields plus details = {...other stored detail keys, userAnswers: top-level ?? stored, paperData: top-level ?? stored}.

src/services.ts::buildChatContext.text: Gathers everything a chat needs to answer one message well: the exam on screen, the candidate's chosen post and saved profile, where they are in the exam cycle, days left to apply, and the recent conversation. The practice and resources chats only see past messages about this same exam.
src/services.ts::buildChatContext.tech: `(exam, channel) => ChatContext`: `{channel, exam, targetPost (exam.posts by storageService.getTargetPost()), profile, stage: deriveCandidateStage(exam), daysToApplicationClose, history}`; history is the whole ASSISTANT thread, or for other channels only turns whose `examId === exam.id`.

src/services.ts::calculateAge.text: Works out a candidate's age in completed years on the exam's official reference date, from their date of birth. If either date cannot be read it returns 0.
src/services.ts::calculateAge.tech: Exported (dateOfBirth, referenceDate: 'YYYY-MM-DD') => number. Year difference minus one when the reference month/day falls before the birth month/day; returns 0 for unparseable dates and never below 0. No default reference date.

src/services.ts::calculateDetailedAge.text: Works out a candidate's exact age in years, months and days on the exam's reference date, for display such as '24 yrs, 3 mos, 12 days'.
src/services.ts::calculateDetailedAge.tech: Exported (dateOfBirth, referenceDate) => DetailedAge. Borrows days from the previous month of the reference date and months from the year as needed; each field clamped at 0 (the formatted string uses the unclamped values). Unparseable dates return zeros with formatted '0 yrs'.

src/services.ts::calculateTimeDecay.text: Works out how much an old action still counts, from 1 (just now) falling by half every 'half-life' period. An action with no valid time counts for nothing.
src/services.ts::calculateTimeDecay.tech: `(timestamp, type?, customHalfLife?, referenceTime?) => number`: returns 2^(-elapsedHours / halfLife), with halfLife = customHalfLife, else the type's `INTERACTION_HALF_LIVES_HOURS`, else 48. Returns 0 for a missing, NaN or non-positive timestamp; elapsed time is clamped at 0; `referenceTime` defaults to `Date.now()`.

src/services.ts::canonicalExamId.text: Gives the current id for an exam, translating the one known old id into the new one, so attempts can be matched to the right exam.
src/services.ts::canonicalExamId.tech: Exported (examId?) => string: '' for a missing id, else LEGACY_ATTEMPT_EXAM_IDS[examId] or examId unchanged.

src/services.ts::categoryCodesOf.text: Reads a category label as printed (like 'General (UR)' or 'SC/ST') and works out which standard categories it names. A label it does not recognise, such as a disability sub-category, names none.
src/services.ts::categoryCodesOf.tech: Exported (label) => Set<string>. Adds the label itself if it is a CATEGORY_WORDINGS key; splits the label on , / ( ) & and adds every code whose wording list contains any normalised part exactly (lower-case, collapsed spaces).

src/services.ts::claudeService.text: The browser's link to the server's Claude job queue. It checks whether Claude is ready, sends a candidate's question or a practice-question request as a background job, waits for the answer for a limited time, and lets an admin list, cancel or retry jobs. If anything goes wrong it reports failure quietly, so the page can show GovOS's own non-AI answer instead.
src/services.ts::claudeService.tech: Object: `health()` (GET /api/claude/health, null on failure), `healthCached(maxAgeMs=30000)`, `getJob(id, token?)` (sends admin and X-GovOS-Job-Token headers), `waitForJob(id, {token, intervalMs=1200, timeoutMs=120000, signal, onUpdate})` returning `{ok:true,data:job}` on a terminal status or `{ok:false,status:'TIMEOUT'|'ABORTED',fallback}`, `cancel`, `retry` (POST .../retry), `listJobs(limit=30)`, `ask(examId, question, history)` -> POST /api/claude/ask, `practice(examId, topic, count=3, difficulty='MEDIUM')` -> POST /api/claude/practice, and `_post`, which marks fallback on 503/429, a server `fallback` flag or a network error and passes `retryAfter`.

src/services.ts::claudeService._post.text: The shared helper that sends a request to start a Claude task and turns any failure into a clear message, flagging when GovOS should fall back to its own answer.
src/services.ts::claudeService._post.tech: POSTs JSON with jsonHeaders() (Content-Type plus admin token if set). OK returns {ok: true, data: ticket}. Otherwise returns {ok: false, error: message||error||'Server returned HTTP n', status, fallback: true when the body says so or HTTP 503/429, retryAfter}. A network error returns {ok: false, error: 'GovOS server unreachable: …', fallback: true}.

src/services.ts::claudeService.ask.text: Sends a candidate's question about one exam to the Claude helper as a background task. The server decides which verified facts Claude may use and checks the answer against them.
src/services.ts::claudeService.ask.tech: Delegates to _post('/api/claude/ask', {examId, question, history}) (history defaults to []); returns a ClaudeOutcome<ClaudeJobTicket> to poll with waitForJob.

src/services.ts::claudeService.cancel.text: Asks the server to stop a background Claude task.
src/services.ts::claudeService.cancel.tech: POSTs /api/claude/jobs/<jobId>/cancel with adminHeaders() and an optional X-GovOS-Job-Token; returns the updated ClaudeJob, or null on failure or network error.

src/services.ts::claudeService.getJob.text: Looks up the current state of one background Claude task (queued, running, finished or failed).
src/services.ts::claudeService.getJob.tech: GETs /api/claude/jobs/<jobId> with adminHeaders() plus X-GovOS-Job-Token when a token is given; returns the ClaudeJob JSON, or null on a non-OK reply or network error.

src/services.ts::claudeService.health.text: Asks the GovOS server whether its Claude AI helper is switched on and ready.
src/services.ts::claudeService.health.tech: GETs /api/claude/health and returns the ClaudeHealth JSON on success; returns null on a non-OK reply or network error.

src/services.ts::claudeService.healthCac.text: Same readiness check for the Claude helper, but remembers the answer for a short while (30 seconds by default) so the chat does not ask the server every time.
src/services.ts::claudeService.healthCac.tech: Returns the module-level _healthCache value if younger than maxAgeMs (default 30000); otherwise calls health(), caches {at, value} (including a null result) and returns it.

src/services.ts::claudeService.listJobs.text: For administrators: lists the recent Claude tasks and how many are in each state.
src/services.ts::claudeService.listJobs.tech: GETs /api/claude/jobs?limit=<limit> (default 30) with adminHeaders(); returns {jobs, counts} or null on a non-OK reply or network error.

src/services.ts::claudeService.practice.text: Asks the Claude helper, as a background task, to write a few practice questions on one topic of an exam's syllabus.
src/services.ts::claudeService.practice.tech: Delegates to _post('/api/claude/practice', {examId, topic, count, difficulty}) with defaults count 3 and difficulty 'MEDIUM'; returns a ClaudeOutcome<ClaudeJobTicket>.

src/services.ts::claudeService.retry.text: Asks the server to run a failed Claude task again.
src/services.ts::claudeService.retry.tech: Delegates to _post('/api/claude/jobs/<jobId>/retry', {}), returning a ClaudeOutcome<ClaudeJobTicket>; admin-guarded on the server.

src/services.ts::claudeService.waitForJo.text: Keeps checking a background Claude task until it finishes, but gives up after a time limit (two minutes by default) so a slow answer never holds the candidate up; GovOS then shows its own answer instead.
src/services.ts::claudeService.waitForJo.tech: Polls getJob every intervalMs (default 1200) until the deadline (timeoutMs, default 120000), calling onUpdate with each job and returning {ok: true, data: job} once status is SUCCEEDED, FAILED or CANCELLED. Returns {ok: false, status: 'ABORTED'} if the AbortSignal fires, or {ok: false, status: 'TIMEOUT', fallback: true} at the deadline. A null poll is just retried; the server job is not cancelled.

src/services.ts::clauseOf.text: Adds the notice clause number to an eligibility message, in brackets, when the rule records one.
src/services.ts::clauseOf.tech: (rule) => string: ' (<clauseNumber>)' when rule.provenance.clauseNumber is set, else ''.

src/services.ts::computePersonalizedReco.text: Ranks every exam by how likely it is to interest this candidate, based on what they have recently done in GovOS. Direct actions on an exam count most, interest spreads more weakly to similar exams, and a small profile bonus breaks ties. Each exam gets a 0-100 score, a strength label and plain reasons such as 'Viewed SSC CGL'.
src/services.ts::computePersonalizedReco.tech: `(allExams, interactions, profile?, referenceTime?) => ExamRecommendation[]`. Per event: weight x `calculateTimeDecay` x multiplier credited to the event's exam (examId or EXAM targetId); SEARCH events also credit exams matched by title/code/authority substring or hardcoded keyword clusters (civil/upsc/psc, ssc/cgl, bank/ibps/po). Then transfers 0.65 x directScore x affinity to exams with affinity > 0.3, capped at 80% of the top direct score for exams with no direct hits; adds a profile prior (+1.5 GRADUATION, +0.5 isGoldenJourney) when a profile exists. Normalises to 0-100 (denominator floor 5 or 1), labels STRONG/MODERATE/EXPLORATORY, falls back to category-based reason strings, and sorts by score then direct hits. Returns [] for an empty exam list.

src/services.ts::conversationService.text: Keeps the recent back-and-forth of each GovOS chat so a follow-up like 'and for OBC?' can be understood. It can read a chat's history, add a message, find the last message from the candidate or the assistant, and clear one chat or all of them.
src/services.ts::conversationService.tech: Object over `readHistoryStore`/`writeHistoryStore`: `history(channel)` (oldest first), `append(channel, turn)` (stamps `at` if missing, trims to `MAX_TURNS_PER_CHANNEL`, returns the trimmed list), `last(channel, role)`, `clear(channel)` and `clearAll()`.

src/services.ts::conversationService.app.text: Adds one message to a chat's memory, keeping only the 12 most recent.
src/services.ts::conversationService.app.tech: Appends the turn (at defaults to the current ISO time) to store[channel], trims to the last 12 (MAX_TURNS_PER_CHANNEL), writes 'govos_chat_history' (write failures ignored) and returns the trimmed list.

src/services.ts::conversationService.cle.text: Forgets the messages of one chat.
src/services.ts::conversationService.cle.tech: Deletes store[channel] from 'govos_chat_history' and writes the store back; write failures are ignored.

src/services.ts::conversationService.cle.text: Forgets the messages of every chat, used when switching exams so an earlier 'it' cannot be misread.
src/services.ts::conversationService.cle.tech: Writes {} to localStorage 'govos_chat_history'; write failures are ignored.

src/services.ts::conversationService.his.text: Reads the recent messages of one of GovOS's chats, oldest first, so the chat can understand follow-up questions.
src/services.ts::conversationService.his.tech: Returns readHistoryStore()[channel] || [] from localStorage 'govos_chat_history' (unparseable or unavailable storage gives {}).

src/services.ts::conversationService.las.text: Finds the most recent message in a chat from either the candidate or the assistant.
src/services.ts::conversationService.las.tech: Filters history(channel) by role and returns the last matching ConversationTurn, or undefined if none.

src/services.ts::daysToApplicationClose.text: Counts the whole days left until applications close for an exam, going negative once the date has passed, or nothing when the date is unknown.
src/services.ts::daysToApplicationClose.tech: `(exam, now = new Date()) => number | null`: rounds (close - now) / 86400000 using the APPLICATION_CLOSE `liveDate`; null when absent.

src/services.ts::deriveCandidateStage.text: Works out where a candidate is in an exam's cycle today, using the exam's own dates: before the notice, applications open, applications closed, waiting for the exam, or after the exam. This lets the assistant answer 'what should I do next?'.
src/services.ts::deriveCandidateStage.tech: `(exam, now = new Date()) => CandidateStage`: reads APPLICATION_OPEN, APPLICATION_CLOSE and EXAM_TIER1 via `liveDate`; returns POST_EXAM after tier1, PRE_EXAM (or APPLICATION_CLOSED with no tier1 date) after close, APPLICATION_OPEN on or after open, else BEFORE_NOTIFICATION.

src/services.ts::discoverExams.text: Answers 'which government exams could I consider, and why?' for a student, across every exam GovOS holds, in the order given, with no ranking. The same inputs always give the same answer; it reads nothing else.
src/services.ts::discoverExams.tech: Pure `(profile: DiscoveryProfile, exams: Exam[]) => DiscoveryResult`: `exams.map(discoveryExam)`, plus a copy of the profile, universe counts (authored vs MACHINE_ACQUIRED vs total) and the union of missing fields. Reads no storage, clock or network.

src/services.ts::discoveryEngineInput.text: Fills in a full candidate profile from the little a student has told the exam finder, using neutral blanks for the rest, so the eligibility checker can run. Any result that depends on those blanks is later treated as unknown, not as a verdict.
src/services.ts::discoveryEngineInput.tech: `(p: DiscoveryProfile, overrides?) => UserProfile`: copies dateOfBirth, degree, branch (default ''), the maths/statistics/physical/colour-blind answers and category (default 'GENERAL'); sets percentage 0, gender 'Other', empty domicile/nationality; then applies overrides (used by `discoveryProbe`).

src/services.ts::discoveryExam.text: Checks every post of one exam for the student and sums it up: how many posts they qualify for, fail, need more information on, or cannot be judged on yet. It also writes a short summary (the date age is counted on, any age relaxation for their category) and lists the sources used.
src/services.ts::discoveryExam.tech: `(exam, profile) => DiscoveryExamResult`: maps `discoveryPost` over `exam.posts` with `crucialEligibilityDate`; counts per verdict; exam verdict RULES_NOT_AVAILABLE for no posts, ELIGIBLE if all eligible, CONDITIONAL if some, else INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION, RULES_NOT_AVAILABLE or INELIGIBLE in that order. Collects unique missing fields and provenance (by id), builds `summary[]` lines, and sets `origin` AUTHORED or MACHINE_ACQUIRED and `cycle` from `getExamCycle`.

src/services.ts::discoveryHasValue.text: Checks whether the student actually gave an answer for a field (not left blank).
src/services.ts::discoveryHasValue.tech: `(v: unknown) => boolean`: false for undefined, null or ''; true otherwise (so `false` counts as an answer).

src/services.ts::discoveryPost.text: Checks one post of one exam against what the student has told the exam finder, rule by rule: age, qualification and (where the post has them) physical standards. Each rule passes, fails, or is unknown because the student left something out or the exam record lacks the rule. The post is then marked eligible, not eligible, needing more information, or rules not available, each reason citing its source.
src/services.ts::discoveryPost.tech: `(exam, post, profile, crucialDate) => DiscoveryPostResult`, wrapping `evaluatePostEligibility`. AGE: ruleNotPublished when `post.maxAge` <= 0 or no crucial date; UNKNOWN without dateOfBirth; probes category over `DISCOVERY_CATEGORIES` when missing; cites `findAgeRelaxation`. QUALIFICATION: UNKNOWN without degree; probes statisticsInDegree and mathsIn12thWith60Percent ([true,false]) and branch (['statistics','']) only when the statistics answer is also absent; engine UNKNOWN maps to ruleNotPublished. PHYSICAL only when `post.physicalRequired`, probing physicalFitnessDeclared/colorBlind. Verdict precedence: any FAIL -> INELIGIBLE, any ruleNotPublished -> RULES_NOT_AVAILABLE, any missing field -> INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION, else ELIGIBLE; `engineVerdict` only kept for ELIGIBLE/INELIGIBLE.

src/services.ts::discoveryProbe.text: Finds out whether a missing answer actually matters for one post by running the eligibility check once for every possible answer. If all runs agree, the missing answer is not needed; if they differ, GovOS must ask for it.
src/services.ts::discoveryProbe.tech: `(run, field, values, read) => {settled, verdict}`: runs `run({[field]: val})` per value, compares `read(verdict)` across runs; `settled` is true when all match; `verdict` is the first run's.

src/services.ts::discoveryProfileFromUse.text: Copies the answers a candidate already saved in their profile into the exam finder, so they are not asked the same things twice.
src/services.ts::discoveryProfileFromUse.tech: `(p: UserProfile | null | undefined) => DiscoveryProfile`: {} for no profile; copies dateOfBirth, category, degree and branch when truthy, and the four boolean answers when not undefined.

src/services.ts::discoveryReads.text: The shared two-minute memory for 'what sources did GovOS discover for this exam', so every section of an exam page does not ask the server separately.
src/services.ts::discoveryReads.tech: `sharedRead<DiscoveredSources>(120_000)`, keyed by exam id; used by `sourceDiscoveryService.forExam`.

src/services.ts::discoverySplitReasons.text: Splits the eligibility checker's combined explanation back into separate parts about age, qualification and physical standards.
src/services.ts::discoverySplitReasons.tech: `(verdict: PostVerdict) => Record<DiscoveryRule, string[]>`: splits `verdict.reason` on ' • '; segments starting 'age'/'underage' go to AGE, 'physical'/'medical' to PHYSICAL, everything else to QUALIFICATION.

src/services.ts::evaluateCandidateEligib.text: Another name for the main exam eligibility check; it does exactly the same thing.

src/services.ts::evaluateEligibility.text: The main eligibility check for a whole exam. It works out the candidate's exact age on the exam's own reference date, checks every post, and gives an overall answer: eligible for all posts, eligible for some, not eligible, or cannot be evaluated (for example when the record has no posts or no reference date). It also lists the rules it relied on and a plain-English explanation.
src/services.ts::evaluateEligibility.tech: Exported (exam, profile) => EligibilityDiagnostic. crucialDate = exam.crucialEligibilityDate or ''; detailed age via calculateDetailedAge. legalClauses: the age reckoning date, the category relaxation found (or that none is recorded), and eligibilityHighlights whose title matches qualification/degree/education. postVerdicts via evaluatePostEligibility. Status: NOT_EVALUABLE when no posts or no evaluable post; ELIGIBLE when all eligible; CONDITIONAL when some eligible; NOT_EVALUABLE when none eligible but some undetermined; else INELIGIBLE (explanation mentions the youngest minimum age when the candidate is below it). Returns isEligible (eligibleCount > 0), calculatedAgeOnCutoff, categoryRelaxationApplied ('<category> (+N Year(s) Relaxation Applied)' when N > 0, '<category> (no age relaxation)' when it is 0), counts, legalClauses, explanation and postVerdicts.

src/services.ts::evaluatePostEligibility.text: Checks whether a candidate can apply for one post. It checks their age on the exam's reference date against the post's limits (adding any verified relaxation for their category), their education against the notice's rules, and any physical or colour-blindness requirement. It returns a verdict with plain reasons for each check, and says 'not evaluated' where the record lacks a date or an age limit.
src/services.ts::evaluatePostEligibility.tech: Exported (post, profile, crucialDate, exam?) => PostVerdict. Age via calculateAge when crucialDate is set; relaxation via findAgeRelaxation/getCategoryAgeRelaxation; maxPermissibleAge = post.maxAge + relaxation. ageStatus UNKNOWN when no crucialDate or post.maxAge <= 0, UNDERAGE below minAge, EXCEEDED above the max (reason states whether a published relaxation was applied). qualStatus from evaluateQualification. physicalStatus RESTRICTED when post.physicalRequired and profile.physicalFitnessDeclared === false, or colorBlindnessAllowed === false and profile.colorBlind. eligible requires all three OK; reasons joined with ' • '; officialClause = post.provenance.clauseNumber or 'the notice'.

src/services.ts::evaluateQualification.text: Gives the education verdict for one post, using the post's own rules if it has any, otherwise the exam-wide rules. If the record states no education rule at all, it says the qualification could not be evaluated rather than assuming a degree is needed.
src/services.ts::evaluateQualification.tech: Exported (post, profile, exam?) => QualOutcome. Uses post.ruleGroup if hasQualificationRule, else exam.globalRuleGroup if it has one, else UNKNOWN with a reason naming the post. The APPEARING_ALLOWED rule is looked up in the post's group, then the exam's, and passed to evaluateQualificationGroup.

src/services.ts::evaluateQualificationGr.text: Combines the results of several education rules. For 'any of these' groups, meeting one is enough; for 'all of these' groups, failing one fails the whole. If nothing fails but something cannot be decided, the result is 'cannot be decided'.
src/services.ts::evaluateQualificationGr.tech: (group, profile, appearing?) => QualOutcome. Evaluates qualification rules and child groups containing them. OR: first OK wins (its reasons); else UNKNOWN if any unknown; else DISQUALIFIED with a combined 'none of the alternatives' reason. AND (default): any DISQUALIFIED → DISQUALIFIED; else any UNKNOWN → UNKNOWN; else OK; reasons concatenated.

src/services.ts::evaluateQualificationRu.text: Checks one education rule from the notice against the candidate's profile: whether their degree level is high enough (with special handling for final-year students and those without Class 12), whether their degree subject matches, whether they meet a percentage rule GovOS can answer, or, for a rule only stated in words, that it cannot be checked. Every answer comes with a reason quoting what the rule requires.
src/services.ts::evaluateQualificationRu.tech: (rule, profile, appearing?) => QualOutcome. DEGREE_REQUIRED: lowest recognised level among rule values (UNKNOWN if none); profile.degree read by qualificationLevelOf (UNKNOWN if unreadable); BELOW_CLASS_12 fails a Class 12+ requirement; GRADUATION_APPEARING passes up to Class 12, fails POST_GRADUATION, and passes graduation only when an APPEARING_ALLOWED rule exists (else UNKNOWN); otherwise compares LEVEL_RANK. BRANCH_SPECIALIZATION: stems of profile.branch (+ 'Statistics' if statisticsInDegree) must contain all stems of some value; UNKNOWN with no branch. PERCENTAGE_MIN: answered only for a Maths at CLASS_12 rule via profile.mathsIn12thWith60Percent (true and min <= 60 → OK, false and min >= 60 → DISQUALIFIED), else UNKNOWN. STATED_CONDITION: always UNKNOWN. Other types: OK with no reasons.

src/services.ts::examDayChecklistStatus.text: Checks an exam's exam-day instructions: none recorded, recorded but not all backed by an officially verified source, or all officially verified. This lets the page avoid presenting general advice as the authority's own rules.
src/services.ts::examDayChecklistStatus.tech: Exported (exam) => ExamDayChecklistStatus: 'NONE' when exam.examDayChecklist is empty or missing; 'VERIFIED' when every item's provenance.verificationLevel === 'OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED'; otherwise 'UNVERIFIED'.

src/services.ts::examOverlayService.text: The browser's link to 'fact overlays': verified corrections or additions to an exam's facts kept on the server. It can fetch them for an exam, add one, or retire one.
src/services.ts::examOverlayService.tech: Object: `getOverlays(examId, cycle?, domain?)` ([] fallback) and `getOverlaysOrNull` (GET /api/exams/<id>/overlays with optional cycle/domain query; null when unreadable or the reply has no array), `addOverlay(examId, overlay)` (POST with jsonHeaders, returns the overlay or null) and `retireOverlay(id)` (POST /api/exams/overlays/<id>/retire with admin headers, boolean).

src/services.ts::examOverlayService.addO.text: For verifiers: records a correction or addition to one of an exam's facts.
src/services.ts::examOverlayService.addO.tech: POSTs the partial overlay to /api/exams/<examId>/overlays with jsonHeaders(); returns data.overlay || null, or null on a non-OK reply or network error.

src/services.ts::examOverlayService.getO.text: Gets the corrections and additions verifiers have recorded on top of an exam's facts, or an empty list if none could be read.
