Gets the verifier corrections for an exam's facts, but returns nothing at all if the server could not be read, so the page can keep what it already shows.
src/services.ts::examOverlayService.getO.tech: GETs /api/exams/<examId>/overlays with optional cycle and domain query parameters; returns data.overlays when it is an array, otherwise null (also on a non-OK reply or network error).

src/services.ts::examOverlayService.reti.text: For verifiers: withdraws a previously recorded correction to an exam's fact.
src/services.ts::examOverlayService.reti.tech: POSTs /api/exams/overlays/<overlayId>/retire with adminHeaders(); returns res.ok, or false on a network error.

src/services.ts::examRegistryService.text: Fetches the exams GovOS has built automatically from authorities' documents and published on the server. If a fetch fails, it keeps the last good list rather than leaving the app with no exams, and it can also fetch one such exam by id.
src/services.ts::examRegistryService.tech: Object: `load()` (exams only), `loadWithStatus()` -> GET /api/exams, returns `{exams, status: 'FRESH'|'SUPERSEDED'|'FAILED'}`, tagging each exam `origin: 'MACHINE_ACQUIRED'` and keeping the previous cache on failure, non-array replies or a stale generation; `get(examId, cycle?)` -> GET /api/exams/<id>; `loaded()` returns the cache synchronously.

src/services.ts::examRegistryService.get.text: Fetches one automatically built exam from the server, optionally for a particular year's cycle.
src/services.ts::examRegistryService.get.tech: GETs /api/exams/<examId>[?cycle=…] and returns data.exam tagged origin 'MACHINE_ACQUIRED', or null when the reply is not OK, carries no exam, or on a network error. Does not touch the registry cache.

src/services.ts::examRegistryService.loa.text: Fetches the exams GovOS has built automatically and published on the server, alongside the hand-written ones.
src/services.ts::examRegistryService.loa.tech: Returns (await loadWithStatus()).exams: the runtime exam list, or the last good cached list when the load failed or was superseded.

src/services.ts::examRegistryService.loa.text: Fetches the automatically built exams from the server and also says whether the list is fresh, out of date because a newer request replaced it, or failed. A failed fetch keeps the last good list instead of showing no exams.
src/services.ts::examRegistryService.loa.tech: Increments registryLoadGeneration and GETs /api/exams. A non-OK reply, a body without an exams array or a network error returns {exams: cached list, status: 'FAILED'}; if a newer load started meanwhile returns the cache with 'SUPERSEDED'; otherwise replaces the module cache runtimeRegistryExams with data.exams, each tagged origin 'MACHINE_ACQUIRED', and returns status 'FRESH'.

src/services.ts::examRegistryService.loa.text: Gives back the automatically built exams already fetched, without asking the server again.
src/services.ts::examRegistryService.loa.tech: Synchronously returns the module-level runtimeRegistryExams cache ([] until a load succeeds).

src/services.ts::findAgeRelaxation.text: Finds the age relaxation (extra years allowed) that this exam's own notice publishes for the candidate's category, and for a particular post if the notice has a post-specific rule. If the exam's record has no such rule, it returns nothing rather than a made-up figure.
src/services.ts::findAgeRelaxation.tech: Exported (exam, category, postId?) => AgeRelaxationEntry | null. Returns null when exam.ageRelaxations is empty. Matches entries whose lower-cased category equals or contains any CATEGORY_WORDINGS[category] word (or the category itself), excluding entries tied to a different post. Prefers a post-specific match, then a general one, then the first match.

src/services.ts::findRule.text: Finds the first rule of a given kind inside a set of eligibility rules, searching nested groups too.
src/services.ts::findRule.tech: (g?: RuleGroup, type) => EligibilityRule | undefined: g.rules first, then recursively through childGroups.

src/services.ts::getCategoryAgeRelaxatio.text: Gives the number of extra years to add to an exam's upper age limit for the candidate's category. It only counts a figure the notice states plainly and that GovOS has verified; otherwise it adds nothing.
src/services.ts::getCategoryAgeRelaxatio.tech: Exported (exam, category, postId?) => number. Calls findAgeRelaxation; returns entry.years (or 0) only when entry.status === 'VERIFIED', else 0.

src/services.ts::getExamAffinitySimilari.text: Gives a score from 0 to 1 for how alike two exams are, so interest in one can suggest the other. It adds points when they share a conducting body, are both civil-service or state commission exams, share career fields, need the same qualification, or are both fast computer-based aptitude exams (staff selection or banking).
src/services.ts::getExamAffinitySimilari.tech: `(examA, examB) => number` in [0,1]; 1.0 for the same id. Adds +0.35 same `authorityName`; +0.50 both CIVIL_SERVICES/STATE_PSC with the same `categoryTag` or +0.40 if mixed; +0.15 per shared `careerFields` entry (max 2); +0.05 same `minimumQualification`; +0.40 both STAFF_SELECTION/BANKING. Clamped; used by the transfer pass of `computePersonalizedRecommendations` (threshold > 0.3).

src/services.ts::getExamCycle.text: Reads which year's cycle an exam belongs to (for example '2026') from its id or title, or nothing if no year is written there.
src/services.ts::getExamCycle.tech: `(exam) => string`: first `20\d\d` word match in `exam.id`, else in `exam.title`, else ''.

src/services.ts::getExamUniverse.text: Combines GovOS's hand-written exams with the automatically built ones into one list. If an exam appears in both, the hand-written version wins.
src/services.ts::getExamUniverse.tech: Pure `(authored, runtime?) => Exam[]`: `runtime` defaults to the `runtimeRegistryExams` cache; returns `authored` unchanged when there is nothing extra, otherwise appends runtime exams whose id is not already present.

src/services.ts::hasQualificationRule.text: Checks whether a set of eligibility rules contains any education rule at all, including inside nested groups.
src/services.ts::hasQualificationRule.tech: (g?: RuleGroup) => boolean: true when g has a rule whose ruleType is in QUALIFICATION_RULES or any childGroup does (recursive).

src/services.ts::isPlainObject.text: Checks that a value is an ordinary object (not empty, not a list).
src/services.ts::isPlainObject.tech: Type guard (v) => v is Record<string, any>: truthy, typeof 'object' and not an array.

src/services.ts::isTerminal.text: Tells whether a Claude job has finished, whether it succeeded, failed or was cancelled.
src/services.ts::isTerminal.tech: `(status: string) => boolean`, true for 'SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED' or 'CANCELLED'; used by `claudeService.waitForJob` to stop polling.

src/services.ts::jsonBytes.text: Measures how many bytes a piece of data takes once written out as JSON text.
src/services.ts::jsonBytes.tech: (value) => number: UTF-8 byte length of JSON.stringify(value) via TextEncoder.

src/services.ts::jsonHeaders.text: The standard request headers for sending data to the server: 'this is JSON', plus the admin token if one was entered.
src/services.ts::jsonHeaders.tech: Module-private `() => Record<string,string>` returning `{ 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...adminHeaders() }`; used by POSTs in claudeService, researchService, syllabusLiveService, sourceDiscoveryService, resourceLiveService and examOverlayService.

src/services.ts::liveDate.text: Finds the current date of a given kind of event in an exam (for example the application closing date), preferring one that has not been replaced by a later notice.
src/services.ts::liveDate.tech: `(exam, type) => Date | null`: first `exam.dates` row of that `type` whose status is not SUPERSEDED, else any row of that type, parsed with `parseExamDate`.

src/services.ts::matchCutoffRow.text: Picks the cut-off row that belongs to the candidate's own category, and only that one. It matches the exact label first, then the same category under another name ('UR' and 'General' are the same), preferring a row for that category alone over a shared one. If it cannot be sure, it reports that instead of borrowing another category's figure.
src/services.ts::matchCutoffRow.tech: Exported (rows: CutoffEntry[], category) => CutoffMatch. NO_CUTOFFS if rows is empty; NO_CATEGORY if category is blank. Exact normalised label: one → MATCHED/EXACT_LABEL, several → AMBIGUOUS. Otherwise the category must map to exactly one code via categoryCodesOf, else NO_ROW_FOR_CATEGORY; rows naming that code are filtered, preferring rows naming only that code; one → MATCHED/SAME_CATEGORY, several → AMBIGUOUS, none → NO_ROW_FOR_CATEGORY. 'recorded' lists the distinct row categories.

src/services.ts::normalizeDegree.text: Simplifies a typed degree name: anything that looks like a bachelor's degree (B.Tech, B.Sc, B.A, B.Com, BBA, BCA, 'graduation', 'degree' and so on) becomes 'bachelor'. Anything else is returned in lower case.
src/services.ts::normalizeDegree.tech: Exported (value) => string: lower-cases and trims; returns 'bachelor' when the text includes b.tech, b.e, engineering, b.sc, b.a, b.com, bba, bca, bachelor, graduation or degree (substring checks); otherwise the normalised text.

src/services.ts::parseExamDate.text: Turns a date written in an exam record, such as '2026-06-22 23:00:00', into a real date, or nothing if it cannot be read.
src/services.ts::parseExamDate.tech: `(value?: string) => Date | null`: replaces the first space with 'T' and parses; null for empty or invalid input.

src/services.ts::planAttemptSyncBatches.text: Splits the candidate's saved attempts into upload batches that each stay under a size budget, keeping their order. An attempt too large for the server is listed separately instead of being sent.
src/services.ts::planAttemptSyncBatches.tech: Exported (attempts, budget = SYNC_BATCH_BUDGET_BYTES, limit = SYNC_REQUEST_LIMIT_BYTES - 64 KiB) => AttemptSyncPlan. Greedy in order: each payload from attemptSyncPayload is sized with jsonBytes + 1; over `limit` goes to oversized; a new batch starts when adding would exceed budget and the current batch is non-empty (so a single attempt over budget but under limit travels alone).

src/services.ts::postVerdictState.text: Sums up an eligibility verdict for one post as one of three answers: eligible, not eligible because a stated rule is failed, or not determined because the record does not let GovOS decide.
src/services.ts::postVerdictState.tech: Exported (v: PostVerdict) => 'ELIGIBLE' | 'NOT_ELIGIBLE' | 'NOT_DETERMINED': ELIGIBLE if v.eligible; NOT_ELIGIBLE if ageStatus is EXCEEDED/UNDERAGE, qualStatus DISQUALIFIED or physicalStatus RESTRICTED; otherwise NOT_DETERMINED.

src/services.ts::qualificationLevelOf.text: Reads a written qualification (the candidate's own, or a notice's requirement) and works out its education level, for example 'B.Com' as graduation or 'final year' as still studying. If it cannot tell, it returns nothing rather than guessing.
src/services.ts::qualificationLevelOf.tech: Exported (text) => QualificationLevel | null. Regex checks in order: below/not passed Class 12 → BELOW_CLASS_12; final year/appearing/pursuing/result awaited → GRADUATION_APPEARING; master's/PG/M.A/M.Sc/MBA/M.Tech/MCA/PhD → POST_GRADUATION; bachelor's/graduate/degree/B.A/B.Sc/B.Com/BBA/BCA/B.Tech/B.E/MBBS/LLB/engineering → GRADUATION; 12th/XII/intermediate/higher or senior secondary/10+2/HSC → CLASS_12; 10th/matric/secondary school → CLASS_10; else null.

src/services.ts::qualificationQuestionsF.text: Decides which extra questions the eligibility calculator should ask for an exam: whether the candidate had Maths in Class 12 with 60%, and what subject their degree was in. Each is asked only if one of the exam's rules actually needs the answer.
src/services.ts::qualificationQuestionsF.tech: Exported (exam) => {mathsIn12th, degreeSubject}. Walks exam.globalRuleGroup and every post.ruleGroup (with childGroups); mathsIn12th true when a PERCENTAGE_MIN rule has a /math/i subject at level CLASS_12; degreeSubject true when any BRANCH_SPECIALIZATION rule exists.

src/services.ts::readHistoryStore.text: Reads the saved chat history from the browser, or starts empty if there is none or it cannot be read.
src/services.ts::readHistoryStore.tech: `() => ChatHistoryStore`: JSON-parses localStorage `CHAT_HISTORY_KEY`; returns {} when absent or on any error.

src/services.ts::readStoredJson.text: Safely reads a saved item from the browser. If it is missing or the browser blocks access, it uses a default. If what is saved is damaged or in the wrong shape, it keeps a backup copy under a '__corrupt' name before using the default, so the original is not lost when something new is saved.
src/services.ts::readStoredJson.tech: Exported <T>(key, isValid, fallback) => T. Returns fallback if localStorage.getItem throws or the key is absent; returns the parsed value when JSON.parse succeeds and isValid passes; otherwise copies the raw string to `${key}__corrupt` (ignoring a write failure), logs a console warning and returns fallback.

src/services.ts::registryLoadGeneration.text: A counter that makes sure only the most recent fetch of the exam list is kept, so a slow older fetch cannot overwrite a newer one.
src/services.ts::registryLoadGeneration.tech: Module-level number incremented at the start of every `loadWithStatus()`; a reply whose captured generation is no longer current is reported SUPERSEDED and not written to the cache.

src/services.ts::researchOutcome.text: Turns the server's reply to a research request into a simple success-or-failure result, with a readable error message, setup hints, and a flag saying Claude is unavailable when that is why it failed.
src/services.ts::researchOutcome.tech: Async `researchOutcome<T>(res: Response) => ResearchOutcome<T>`: parses JSON (null on failure); ok -> `{ok:true,data}`; otherwise `{ok:false,error,setup,claudeUnavailable,status}`, where an ADMIN_REQUIRED body yields 'message. hint', else message/detail/error or 'Server returned HTTP n', and `claudeUnavailable` is true only for a 503 with error CLAUDE_UNAVAILABLE.

src/services.ts::researchService.text: The browser's connection to the Trust Panel's Live Source Research tools on the server. It starts a search in which Claude proposes sources and the server checks them, fetches saved runs and findings, asks the server to fetch a finding's page text, pulls facts out of it (by rules or with Claude) and records a reviewer's decisions. Nothing here publishes anything to candidates.
src/services.ts::researchService.tech: Object over `/api/research/*`: `getStatus`, `startSearch(query, mode='OFFICIAL', examId?, maxResults=8)` (queues a DISCOVER_SOURCES job, returns `ResearchOutcome<ClaudeJobTicket>`), `getRun(runId)` (maps to `ResearchSearchResult`), `extract(findingId)`, `history(limit=15)`, `getFinding`, `setFindingStatus`, `extractFacts({runId|findingId})` (rule-based), `extractFactsWithClaude(findingId)` (job, `claude: true`), `listFacts({runId,status,examId})` and `setFactStatus`. Writes use `jsonHeaders()`; reads return null or [] when offline.

src/services.ts::researchService.extract.text: For administrators: asks the server to download and store the text of one found web page. This is done by plain code, not by Claude.
src/services.ts::researchService.extract.tech: POSTs {finding_id} to /api/research/extract with jsonHeaders(); on success returns {ok: true, data: results || []} (ResearchExtractResult[]), otherwise the researchOutcome error. Network errors return {ok: false, error: 'GovOS server unreachable: …'}.

src/services.ts::researchService.extract.text: For administrators: asks the server to pull specific facts (such as dates) out of the stored page text of a search's findings using fixed rules. Nothing is published by this.
src/services.ts::researchService.extract.tech: POSTs {run_id, finding_id} to /api/research/facts/extract with jsonHeaders() (rule-based path); returns data.facts as ResearchFact[] when it is an array, else []; network errors give [].

src/services.ts::researchService.extract.text: For administrators: starts a background task in which Claude reads one found page's text and proposes facts; the server keeps only those whose quoted words really appear on the page.
src/services.ts::researchService.extract.tech: POSTs {finding_id, claude: true} to /api/research/facts/extract with jsonHeaders(); returns researchOutcome<ClaudeJobTicket>. The page text must already have been fetched. Network errors return {ok: false, error: 'GovOS server unreachable: …'}.

src/services.ts::researchService.getFind.text: Fetches the details of one source found by a research search.
src/services.ts::researchService.getFind.tech: GETs /api/research/findings/<id> and returns the ResearchFinding JSON, or null on a non-OK reply or network error.

src/services.ts::researchService.getRun.text: Fetches the saved results of one finished research search.
src/services.ts::researchService.getRun.tech: GETs /api/research/runs/<runId> and maps its run to {runId, query, mode, examId, engine, jobId, results: findings}. Returns null on a non-OK reply or any error.

src/services.ts::researchService.getStat.text: For the Trust Panel: asks the server for the state of the live source research tools (whether Claude is ready, how many runs and items are pending, and so on).
src/services.ts::researchService.getStat.tech: GETs /api/research/status and returns the ResearchStatus JSON, or null on a non-OK reply or network error.

src/services.ts::researchService.history.text: Lists the most recent research searches for the Trust Panel.
src/services.ts::researchService.history.tech: GETs /api/research/history?limit=<limit> (default 15) and returns data.runs when it is an array; [] on failure or network error.

src/services.ts::researchService.listFac.text: Lists the facts pulled from research findings for review in the Trust Panel, optionally narrowed by search, review state or exam.
src/services.ts::researchService.listFac.tech: GETs /api/research/facts with optional run_id, status and exam_id query parameters; returns data.facts when it is an array, else [] (also on network error).

src/services.ts::researchService.setFact.text: For administrators: records a reviewer's decision on one extracted fact. Approving only makes it eligible for the later publishing step; it does not publish it.
src/services.ts::researchService.setFact.tech: POSTs {status} to /api/research/facts/<id>/status with jsonHeaders(); returns res.ok, or false on a network error.

src/services.ts::researchService.setFind.text: For administrators: records a reviewer's decision on a found source (for example promote, reviewed or reject).
src/services.ts::researchService.setFind.tech: POSTs {status} to /api/research/findings/<id>/status with jsonHeaders(); returns res.ok, or false on a network error.

src/services.ts::researchService.startSe.text: For administrators: starts a background search in which Claude suggests possible official sources for a query, and the server checks each one itself.
src/services.ts::researchService.startSe.tech: POSTs {query, mode (default 'OFFICIAL'), exam_id, max_results (default 8)} to /api/research/search with jsonHeaders(); returns researchOutcome<ClaudeJobTicket> (ok with the job ticket, or ok:false with the error, setup hint, claudeUnavailable on 503 CLAUDE_UNAVAILABLE, or an admin-required message). A network error returns {ok: false, error: 'GovOS server unreachable: …'}.

src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.text: The browser's link to the parts of the Resource Library that refresh on the server: link health checks, SSC's and UPSC's live notice boards, the latest videos from YouTube channels, and resources a verifier has added. Every call fails quietly, so the library falls back to its built-in list when the server is down.
src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.tech: Object: `healthSync(urls)` (POST /api/resources/health/sync), `recheck(urls)` (POST .../health/recheck, results[]), `sscNotices(scope='cgl', limit=8)`, `upscNotices(scope='cse', limit=8)` (maps UPSC What's New items into the `SscNoticeFeed` shape with `createdAt = firstSeen`), `channelUploads(ids)`, `additions(examId?)` (per-exam via `additionReads`, all exams when omitted), `addResource(payload)` (POST, clears cache), `retireResource(id)` (admin, clears cache) and `status()`. Errors return null, [] or {}.

src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.add.text: For verifiers: adds a new resource link to one exam's library, and refreshes the shared list so it shows straight away.
src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.add.tech: POSTs the payload {title, url, examId, subject?, resourceFormat?, author?, description?, findingId?, addedFrom?} to /api/resources/additions with jsonHeaders(); on success clears the whole additionReads cache and returns data.addition || null. Returns null on a non-OK reply or network error.

src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.add.text: Gets the extra resources a verifier has added to one exam's library (or to every exam, for the Trust Panel). One exam's list is shared across its page for two minutes.
src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.add.tech: GETs /api/resources/additions?exam_id=<id> (or /api/resources/additions with no exam) and returns data.additions when it is an array. With examId the read goes through the additionReads sharedRead cache (120 s TTL, failures not cached); without, it reads directly. Returns [] on failure.

src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.cha.text: Fetches the newest videos from the listed YouTube channels, as gathered by the GovOS server.
src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.cha.tech: Returns {} immediately for an empty list; otherwise GETs /api/resources/live/channel-uploads?ids=<comma-joined, URL-encoded> and returns data.channels (Record<channelId, ChannelUploadFeed>) or {}; network errors give {}.

src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.hea.text: Tells the server which resource links the library shows, so it can check them on a schedule, and gets back what it currently knows about each link.
src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.hea.tech: POSTs {urls} to /api/resources/health/sync and returns the ResourceHealthSync JSON; null on a non-OK reply or network error (the library then shows its static check dates).

src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.rec.text: Asks the server to check all the given links right now and save the results for the next visitor too.
src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.rec.tech: POSTs {urls} to /api/resources/health/recheck and returns data.results (ResourceLinkCheck[]) when it is an array; [] on failure or network error.

src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.ret.text: For verifiers: hides a previously added resource from the library again.
src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.ret.tech: POSTs /api/resources/additions/<id>/retire with adminHeaders(); clears the additionReads cache on success and returns res.ok, or false on a network error.

src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.ssc.text: Fetches the latest notices from SSC's own notice board (just the CGL ones, or all), as cached by the GovOS server.
src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.ssc.tech: GETs /api/resources/live/ssc-notices?scope=<cgl|all>&limit=<n> (defaults 'cgl', 8) and returns the SscNoticeFeed JSON; null on a non-OK reply or network error.

src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.sta.text: Asks the server how fresh its live resource feeds and link checks are.
src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.sta.tech: GETs /api/resources/live/status and returns the LiveResourceStatus JSON, or null on a non-OK reply or network error.

src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.ups.text: Fetches the latest items from UPSC's What's New page and reshapes them like SSC's notices. UPSC prints no dates there, so each item is dated by when GovOS first saw it.
src/services.ts::resourceLiveService.ups.tech: GETs /api/resources/live/upsc-notices?scope=<cse|all>&limit=<n> (defaults 'cse', 8) and maps items to SscNoticeFeed shape: createdAt = firstSeen, isCgl false, one file {name: kind || 'Open', url, sizeKb: 0}; total, fetchedAt, stale, error, source (default https://www.upsc.gov.in/whats-new), intervalHours (default 6); scope is always set to 'all'. Returns null on a non-OK reply or network error.

src/services.ts::runtimeRegistryExams.text: The list of extra exams GovOS has built automatically and fetched from the server, kept in memory for this page.
src/services.ts::runtimeRegistryExams.tech: Module-level `let runtimeRegistryExams: Exam[] = []`, replaced only by the newest successful `examRegistryService.loadWithStatus()` and read by `getExamUniverse` and `examRegistryService.loaded()`.

src/services.ts::sharedRead.text: A short-term shared memory for server reads that many parts of a page make at once. If one panel is already fetching something, others wait for the same answer, and the answer is reused for a set time; a failed read is not remembered, so the next panel tries again.
src/services.ts::sharedRead.tech: Generic factory `sharedRead<T>(ttlMs)` returning `{ get(key, load, fresh=false): Promise<T|null>, clear(key?) }`. Caches the in-flight or settled promise per key with its start time; returns it while younger than ttlMs unless `fresh`; deletes the entry when the load resolves to null. Instantiated as `discoveryReads` and `additionReads`.

src/services.ts::sourceDiscoveryService.text: The browser's link to authority source discovery: what GovOS found when it walked an exam's official website. Candidates can read the result for their exam; an admin can start a new walk or list past walks. If the server is down, the page simply shows the exam's own entries.
src/services.ts::sourceDiscoveryService.tech: Object: `forExam(examId, {fresh?})` -> GET /api/sources/exam/<id> through `discoveryReads` (null on failure); `discover(examId, useClaude=false)` -> POST /api/sources/discover returning `ResearchOutcome<ClaudeJobTicket>` (admin job); `runs(limit=10)` -> GET /api/sources/runs with admin headers, [] on failure.

src/services.ts::sourceDiscoveryService..text: For administrators: starts a background exploration of an exam's official authority website, optionally letting Claude help label links the rules could not.
src/services.ts::sourceDiscoveryService..tech: POSTs {examId, useClaude (default false)} to /api/sources/discover with jsonHeaders(); returns researchOutcome<ClaudeJobTicket>. A network error returns {ok: false, error: 'Could not reach the GovOS server. Start "python app.py" and try again.'}.

src/services.ts::sourceDiscoveryService..text: Fetches what GovOS found the last time it explored an exam's official authority website (notices, portals, papers and so on), as it applies to that exam. The answer is shared by the page's sections for two minutes.
src/services.ts::sourceDiscoveryService..tech: Goes through the discoveryReads sharedRead cache (120 s TTL, keyed by examId, in-flight reads shared, null results not cached; opts.fresh forces a re-read). The loader GETs /api/sources/exam/<examId> and returns the DiscoveredSources JSON, or null on a non-OK reply or network error.

src/services.ts::sourceDiscoveryService..text: For administrators: lists the recent explorations of authority websites, with summary counts for each.
src/services.ts::sourceDiscoveryService..tech: GETs /api/sources/runs?limit=<limit> (default 10) with adminHeaders(); returns data.runs (id, estate, authorityName, startedAt, endedAt, jobId, nodes, exhaustive, repositories) when it is an array, else [] (also on network error).

src/services.ts::statedWhen.text: Turns a stored exam date into the text a candidate should see: the authority's own wording if it gave only a month or a range, otherwise the day. A time is added only when asked and only if one was really read; a blank midnight time is never shown.
src/services.ts::statedWhen.tech: Exported (d: {dateTimeStr, displayWhen}, withTime = false) => string. Returns d.displayWhen if set; otherwise splits dateTimeStr on a space and returns the day, appending the time only when withTime is true, a time exists and it is not 00:00 or 00:00:00. (The listed span also covers the module's type import block.)

src/services.ts::storageService.text: The one shared copy of GovOS's storage helper that every screen uses to read and save the candidate's data.
src/services.ts::storageService.tech: `export const storageService = new StorageService()`, the app-wide singleton; imported by ui.tsx, main.tsx and other services (e.g. `buildChatContext` reads the target post and profile through it).

src/services.ts::syllabusLiveService.text: The browser's connection to the syllabus watch and syllabus revisions on the server. It asks which newer notices might change an exam's syllabus, fetches the changes a verifier has recorded, and lets a verifier add or withdraw a change.
src/services.ts::syllabusLiveService.tech: Object: `watch(examId, since?)` -> GET /api/syllabus/watch (null offline); `revisions(examId)` (`[]` fallback) and `revisionsOrNull(examId)` (null when unreadable, so callers keep what they applied); `addRevision({examId, kind, topicId?, topic?, note?, noticeTitle?, noticeUrl?, noticeDate?, appliedBy?})` -> POST /api/syllabus/revisions returning `{revision}` or `{error}`; `retireRevision(id)` -> POST .../retire with admin headers, boolean.

src/services.ts::syllabusLiveService.add.text: For verifiers: saves a change to an exam's syllabus (add, amend or retire a topic), citing the official notice it is based on.
src/services.ts::syllabusLiveService.add.tech: POSTs the input {examId, kind, topicId?, topic?, note?, noticeTitle?, noticeUrl?, noticeDate?, appliedBy?} to /api/syllabus/revisions with jsonHeaders(). Returns {revision} when the reply is OK and carries one, otherwise {error: data.error || 'Server answered n'}; a network or parse failure returns {error: 'The GovOS server is not reachable, so the revision was not saved.'}.

src/services.ts::syllabusLiveService.ret.text: For verifiers: undoes a syllabus change so the syllabus goes back to its earlier version.
src/services.ts::syllabusLiveService.ret.tech: POSTs /api/syllabus/revisions/<id>/retire with adminHeaders(); returns res.ok, or false on a network error.

src/services.ts::syllabusLiveService.rev.text: Gets the verifier-approved changes to an exam's syllabus, or an empty list if none could be read.
Gets the verifier-approved syllabus changes for an exam, but returns nothing at all if the server could not be reached, so the page can keep what it already shows.
src/services.ts::syllabusLiveService.rev.tech: GETs /api/syllabus/revisions?exam_id=<id> and returns data.revisions when it is an array; null on a non-OK reply, wrong shape or network error.

src/services.ts::syllabusLiveService.wat.text: Asks the server for official notices that might change an exam's syllabus and were published after a given date, so the Syllabus section can warn the candidate.
src/services.ts::syllabusLiveService.wat.tech: GETs /api/syllabus/watch?exam_id=<id>[&since=YYYY-MM-DD] and returns the SyllabusWatch JSON; null on a non-OK reply or network error (the section then shows the seed syllabus).

src/services.ts::upsertById.text: Puts an item into a list, replacing the existing item with the same id or adding it at the end.
src/services.ts::upsertById.tech: Generic `upsertById<T extends {id?}>(list, item) => T[]`, non-mutating; an item with no id is always appended. Used by `applyExamOverlays`.

src/services.ts::wordsOf.text: Breaks a subject name into rough word stems (the first four letters of each longer word) so 'Statistics' and 'Statistical' can be compared.
src/services.ts::wordsOf.tech: (s) => string[]: lower-cases, splits on non-letters, keeps words of 4+ letters and truncates each to its first 4 characters.

src/services.ts::writeHistoryStore.text: Saves the chat history to the browser; if saving is not possible, the chat still works for the current page.
src/services.ts::writeHistoryStore.tech: `(store) => void`: JSON-stringifies into localStorage `CHAT_HISTORY_KEY`, swallowing storage errors.

src/services.ts::writeStored.text: Saves one item in the browser and reports whether it worked, for example returning false when the browser's storage is full, leaving the old value in place.
src/services.ts::writeStored.tech: Exported (key, value: string) => boolean: localStorage.setItem in try/catch; on failure logs a console warning and returns false.

src/types.ts::AdmitCardDetails.text: The older, single-card summary of an exam's admit card: availability, release date, portal, login details needed, instructions, whether a city slip exists, and regional portals.
src/types.ts::AdmitCardDetails.tech: Interface {status 'AVAILABLE' | 'NOT_YET_ANNOUNCED' | 'EXPIRED', releaseDateStr, officialPortalUrl, loginCredentialsRequired[], instructions[], cityIntimationAvailable, cityIntimationUrl?, regionPortals?[] {regionName, regionCode, statesCovered, portalUrl, status ACTIVE | SOON}}. Exam.admitCardDetails; superseded in purpose by ExamAdmitCardEvent.

src/types.ts::AgeRelaxationEntry.text: One age relaxation exactly as an authority published it: the group it applies to (in the authority's words), either extra years or a new maximum age, any condition, and whether it is verified, needs review, or the notice says that group gets none.
src/types.ts::AgeRelaxationEntry.tech: Interface {category (authority's wording), years?, maximumAge?, condition?, appliesToPostId?, status 'VERIFIED' | 'NEEDS_REVIEW' | 'NOT_PUBLISHED', provenance}. Both printed forms are kept because converting between them needs arithmetic nobody published. Exam.ageRelaxations.

src/types.ts::AnswerVerification.text: How well a whole Claude answer is backed: verified only if every fact it cites is verified, partly verified if some are, otherwise not verified.
src/types.ts::AnswerVerification.tech: Union 'VERIFIED' | 'PARTLY_VERIFIED' | 'NOT_VERIFIED'; ClaudeAnswerResult.verification. Only VERIFIED earns the verified-data badge.

src/types.ts::ApplicationFeeDetails.text: The application fee exactly as the notice printed it: the amounts, the rules for who pays what, accepted payment methods, and exemptions with their wording and source.
src/types.ts::ApplicationFeeDetails.tech: Interface {amounts: string[] (as printed), rules: {scope, amount, isExempt, feeType?, statedAs?}[], acceptedModes[], exemptions: {category, statedAs, exemptedFeeType?, provenance?}[], statedAs?, provenance?}. ApplicationGuideData.fee.

src/types.ts::ApplicationGuideData.text: Everything the Application section shows for one exam: the official portal, an optional practice form, the registration steps, photo and signature rules, certificate rules, common reasons applications get rejected, the required documents, and the fee.
src/types.ts::ApplicationGuideData.tech: Interface {officialPortal, simulator?, otrSteps[], photoRules, signatureRules, certificateRules[], rejectionPitfalls: {pitfall, consequence, prevention}[], requiredDocuments?[], fee?: ApplicationFeeDetails}. Exam.applicationGuide.

src/types.ts::ApplicationRequiredDocumen.text: One document the notice says candidates need, whether it is required, its specifications, and its source.
src/types.ts::ApplicationRequiredDocumen.tech: Interface {id, name, required, specifications[], provenance?}. ApplicationGuideData.requiredDocuments.

src/types.ts::ApplicationSimulatorField.text: One field on a practice application form: its label, input type, a prefilled value, any choices, and what the notice says about it.
src/types.ts::ApplicationSimulatorField.tech: Interface {id, label, kind 'TEXT' | 'DATE' | 'SELECT' | 'RADIO', defaultValue, options?: {value, label}[], noteFromNotice?}. ApplicationSimulatorModule.fields.

src/types.ts::ApplicationSimulatorModule.text: One card or page of a practice application form, named as the real portal names it, with its intro, where the notice describes it, and its fields.
src/types.ts::ApplicationSimulatorModule.tech: Interface {moduleNumber, cardName, title, introduction, noticeReference, fields: ApplicationSimulatorField[]}. ApplicationSimulatorSpec.modules.

src/types.ts::ApplicationSimulatorRule.text: The condition that makes a practice-form mistake appear: choosing an option the notice rules out, a combination the notice rules out (such as claiming a fee exemption your category does not have), or a date outside the window the notice prints.
src/types.ts::ApplicationSimulatorRule.tech: Union {kind 'VALUE_IN', fieldId, values[]} | {kind 'VALUE_IN_ALL', conditions: {fieldId, values[]}[]} | {kind 'DATE_OUTSIDE', fieldId, earliest, latest}. ApplicationSimulatorTrap.rule.

src/types.ts::ApplicationSimulatorSpec.text: A complete practice application form for one exam, built from that exam's own notice: the portal, the source document, the form's cards and fields, the mistakes it checks for, and a message for a clean submission. It belongs to exactly one exam and will not show for any other.
src/types.ts::ApplicationSimulatorSpec.tech: Interface {examId (checked before render, never defaulted), portalName, portalUrl, sourceDocumentTitle, sourceDocumentUrl, modelledOnNote, modules[], traps[], cleanSubmissionNote, provenance}. ApplicationGuideData.simulator; rendered by ExamApplicationSimulator; also built for machine-read exams by runtime_simulator.

src/types.ts::ApplicationSimulatorTrap.text: One mistake the practice form watches for: when it fires, how serious it is, what the problem is, why it matters, a rule to remember, and the notice's own wording and location.
src/types.ts::ApplicationSimulatorTrap.tech: Interface {id, rule: ApplicationSimulatorRule, severity 'CRITICAL' | 'WARNING', title, problem, whyItMatters, rememberRule, officialClause, noticeReference}. ApplicationSimulatorSpec.traps.

src/types.ts::CandidateNotification.text: One alert shown to the candidate: which exam and event, the title and message, how it was delivered, what tapping it opens, its priority, when it was created and scheduled, and whether it has been read.
src/types.ts::CandidateNotification.tech: Interface {id (stable deterministic key), examId, examCode, examTitle, eventType, title, message, channelsDelivered[], actionType ('EXAM_DETAIL' | 'APPLICATION_GUIDE' | 'CALENDAR' | 'TIMELINE' | 'ADMIT_CARD' | 'RESULT'), actionPayload? (e.g. {section}), priority ('CRITICAL' | 'HIGH' | 'NORMAL'), createdAt, scheduledDateStr?, isRead}. Stored under govos_candidate_notifications.

src/types.ts::CandidateStage.text: Where the candidate is in the exam's cycle, worked out from the exam's own dates: before the notice, applications open, applications closed, before the exam, or after it.

src/types.ts::CertificateValidityRule.text: The rules for a category certificate (OBC, EWS, SC/ST, disability or ex-servicemen): who can issue it, which financial year it must be valid for, the key date, the annexure form, and key conditions.
src/types.ts::CertificateValidityRule.tech: Interface {category 'OBC_NCL' | 'EWS' | 'SC_ST' | 'PwBD' | 'ESM', title, issuingAuthority[], financialYearValidity, crucialDate, officialAnnexure, keyConditions[]}. ApplicationGuideData.certificateRules.

src/types.ts::ChannelUpload.text: One recent video from a YouTube channel: its id, title, date and link.
src/types.ts::ChannelUpload.tech: Interface {videoId, title, published (YYYY-MM-DD), url}. From the channel's public Atom feed.

src/types.ts::ChannelUploadFeed.text: The recent videos of a channel as served by GovOS's server, with when they were fetched and any error.

src/types.ts::ChatChannel.text: Which chat a message belongs to: the main assistant, the practice test builder, or the resource finder.
src/types.ts::ChatChannel.tech: Union 'ASSISTANT' | 'PRACTICE' | 'RESOURCES'. History is stored per channel by conversationService; context is shared.

src/types.ts::ChatContext.text: Everything a chat considers before answering: which chat it is, the current exam, the candidate's target post and profile, their stage in the exam cycle, days left to apply, and the recent messages.
src/types.ts::ChatContext.tech: Interface {channel, exam, targetPost?, profile?, stage: CandidateStage, daysToApplicationClose? (negative after close, null unknown), history: ConversationTurn[]}. Built per message by buildChatContext(exam, channel).

src/types.ts::ClaudeAnswerCitation.text: One fact a Claude answer relied on: its id, section, label and text, the exam record's own source for it, what it claims, and its verification state.
src/types.ts::ClaudeAnswerCitation.tech: Interface {id, section, label, text, provenance?, claim?: string[], verification?: FactVerification}. ClaudeAnswerResult.citations; each opens as Evidence.

src/types.ts::ClaudeAnswerResult.text: Claude's answer to a candidate's question about one exam: the answer text, what Claude says it answered from, what GovOS can actually prove, how uncertain it is, where to go next, a follow-up, the facts it cited, and how many facts it was given.
src/types.ts::ClaudeAnswerResult.tech: Interface {answer, basis ('VERIFIED_DATA' | 'NOT_IN_RECORD' | 'NEEDS_CLARIFICATION'; not a verification), verification?, uncertainty ('NONE' | 'PARTIAL' | 'UNKNOWN'), navigateTo, followUp, citations[], label, engine, examId, factsSupplied, factsTruncated}. Result of POST /api/claude/ask.

src/types.ts::ClaudeHealth.text: What the server reports about the Claude assistant on this machine: whether it is enabled, installed, signed in, ready and busy, its version, a status and message. It never reveals paths or account details.
src/types.ts::ClaudeHealth.tech: Interface {enabled, installed, authenticated: boolean | null, ready, version, busy, status (infrastructure state like CLAUDE_DISABLED), message, adminTokenRequired?}. GET /api/claude/health; also nested in ResearchStatus.

src/types.ts::ClaudeJob.text: One background job that uses Claude: what operation it runs, for which exam, its state and progress, its result, any error category and message, timing, retry counts, and audit details.
src/types.ts::ClaudeJob.tech: Generic interface ClaudeJob<R> {jobId, operation, examId?, cycle?, status, stage, result: R | null, errorCategory (infrastructure/validation, never an exam verdict), errorMessage, templateVersion?, createdAt?/startedAt?/finishedAt?, retryCount?, maxRetries?, cancelRequested?, evidenceLinks?, audit?, requestedBy?}. GET /api/claude/jobs/<id>.

src/types.ts::ClaudeJobStatus.text: The state of a background Claude job: queued, running, succeeded, failed, or cancelled.

src/types.ts::ClaudeJobTicket.text: The receipt returned when a Claude job is started: the job id, its state, whether an identical job already existed, where to check on it, and for a candidate a one-time token to read it back.
src/types.ts::ClaudeJobTicket.tech: Interface {jobId, status, deduplicated, pollUrl, token?}. Returned by the job-creating endpoints (ask, practice, discovery).

src/types.ts::ClaudeOutcome.text: The wrapper around Claude-related calls: success with data, or failure with an error, an optional status, whether to fall back to GovOS's own answer, and when to retry.
src/types.ts::ClaudeOutcome.tech: Generic union {ok: true; data: T} | {ok: false; error; status?; fallback?; retryAfter?}. Returned by claudeService so features can fall back deterministically.

src/types.ts::ClaudePracticeQuestion.text: One practice question written by Claude: topic, question, choices, the right answer, an explanation, and whether a second independent check agreed on the answer.
src/types.ts::ClaudePracticeQuestion.tech: Interface {topic, stem, options[], correct_index, explanation, answerCheck? (e.g. INDEPENDENT_SOLVE_AGREED)}. ClaudePracticeResult.questions.

src/types.ts::ClaudePracticeResult.text: A set of practice questions Claude wrote for one verified syllabus topic, with the ones dropped by the answer check. It is always labelled as GovOS-authored and never as an official past question.
src/types.ts::ClaudePracticeResult.tech: Interface {questions[], dropped[], examId, topic, source: 'GOVOS_AUTHORED', generatedBy: 'CLAUDE_CLI', officialSource: false, label, answerCheck?}. Result of POST /api/claude/practice, shown by ClaudePracticePanel.

src/types.ts::ConversationTurn.text: One message in a chat, from the candidate or the assistant, with what the assistant took it to be about, which exam, and for the practice chat what test was built. This lets a follow-up like 'when is it?' or 'make it harder' carry on from the last message.
src/types.ts::ConversationTurn.tech: Interface {role 'user' | 'assistant', text, intent?, subject?, examId?, topics?, count?, difficulty?, at}. Stored (up to 12 per channel) in govos_chat_history; ChatContext.history.

src/types.ts::CorrigendumNotice.text: An official correction notice for an exam: its title and number, when it was published and takes effect, what it changed, a link to the document, and whether it is still in force.
src/types.ts::CorrigendumNotice.tech: Interface {id, title, noticeNumber, publishedDate, effectiveDate, summary, pdfUrl, status 'ACTIVE' | 'SUPERSEDED', diffSummary, provenance?}. Exam.corrigendums; shown in the Corrigenda Log and the corrigendum ribbon.

src/types.ts::CutoffEntry.text: One past cut-off mark for a category in a given year, with the stage, post and kind of cut-off where recorded, and its source.
src/types.ts::CutoffEntry.tech: Interface {year, category, tier1Cutoff?, value?, stage?, post?, cutoffType?, tier2Cutoff?, postsEligible?, provenance}. value/stage are the exam-neutral form and are never relabelled as Tier-1. Exam.cutoffsHistory, matched to a candidate by matchCutoffRow.

src/types.ts::DataProvenance.text: The 'where did this come from' record that sits behind nearly every fact in GovOS. It names the source document and its web address, the page and clause, when it was published and checked, who checked it, what kind of statement it is, how verified it is, and usually the exact quoted words. It can also show that a value replaced an older one, or was calculated by GovOS from other facts. This is the core idea of the product.
src/types.ts::DataProvenance.tech: Interface: id, documentTitle, officialUrl, pageNumber?, clauseNumber?, publishedDate, verifiedDate, verifiedBy, taxonomyType, verificationLevel, excerptText?; plus evidenceId? (hash identity from the builder), evidenceType? (DIRECT | RECONCILED | DERIVED), authorityName?, supersedes?[] / supersededBy?, derivation? {method, inputs[]} and claimNotInQuote? (value shown but absent from the quote, never presented as verified). Rendered by the Evidence panel.

src/types.ts::DataTaxonomyType.text: The four kinds of statement GovOS can make: a fact, an interpretation, an explanation, or a recommendation.
src/types.ts::DataTaxonomyType.tech: Union 'FACT' | 'INTERPRETATION' | 'EXPLANATION' | 'RECOMMENDATION'; the taxonomyType field of DataProvenance.

src/types.ts::DetailedExplanation.text: The full worked solution shown for a practice question: a simple explanation, the core idea, key terms, the steps, an optional shortcut and elimination tip, and the main lesson.
src/types.ts::DetailedExplanation.tech: Interface {simpleExplanation, coreConcept, technicalTerms?, stepByStepMethod: string[], shortcutTrick?, eliminationStrategy?, crucialTakeaway}. Carried by templates (detailedExp) and PracticeQuestion.detailedExplanation.

src/types.ts::DiscoveredRepository.text: A listing page on an authority's website (such as old question papers or notifications), with only the items on it that name this exam, how many items it held, items listed without a link, and a status note.
src/types.ts::DiscoveredRepository.tech: Interface {title, url, role, section, sourceLabel, items: DiscoveredSourceItem[] (this exam's only), itemCount, listedWithoutLink[], itemsForThisExam, status, note}. DiscoveredSources.repositories.

src/types.ts::DiscoveredSourceItem.text: One link GovOS found while exploring an authority's website, as an exam's page may show it: its title, address, surrounding text, what it is for, which section it belongs in, how trustworthy it is, whether it could be opened, where it was found, whether it concerns this exam and cycle, and who runs the site it is on.
src/types.ts::DiscoveredSourceItem.tech: Interface: title, url, context, role, section (OVERVIEW … OFFICIAL_LINKS | null), sourceLabel, sourceClass, status, obtainable, foundOn, foundOnTitle, relation (THIS_EXAM | THIS_EXAM_CYCLE_UNSTATED | … | ''), roleFrom? ('RULES' | 'CLAUDE'), identity {cycle?, stage?, paper?, session?}, duplicateOf, label?, owner?, relationship? (OWNED_BY_AUTHORITY | GOVERNMENT_HOST | LINKED_FROM_OFFICIAL | INDEPENDENT). From GET /api/sources/exam/<id>.

src/types.ts::DiscoveredSources.text: Everything the latest walk of an authority's website found that concerns one exam: listing pages, portals, guidance and learning links, the search result for each kind of document, and how much of the site was covered. If no walk has been done, it says so.
src/types.ts::DiscoveredSources.tech: Interface returned by GET /api/sources/exam/<id>: examId, state 'DISCOVERED' | 'NOT_DISCOVERED', estate?, note?, runId?, authorityName?, discoveredAt?, repositories?, portals?, practicalGuidance?, learning?, searchStates?, exhaustive?, coverage? {pagesFetched, officialResources, documentsFetched, skippedOutOfScope, listedWithoutLink, exhaustive, fetchFailures, unexplored, pagesWithoutLinks, skipped?}.

src/types.ts::DiscoveryExamResult.text: The shape of one exam's answer when GovOS checks which exams a student could sit. It holds the exam's name and authority, the overall verdict, a per-post breakdown, short reasons, the profile details still missing, the sources cited and simple counts.
src/types.ts::DiscoveryExamResult.tech: Interface: examId, examTitle, authorityName, cycle (the one evaluated via getExamCycle), origin ('AUTHORED' | 'MACHINE_ACQUIRED'), crucialDate ('' when the record has none), verdict: DiscoveryVerdict, posts: DiscoveryPostResult[], summary: string[], missingFields: DiscoveryProfileField[], provenanceRefs: DataProvenance[] (de-duplicated by id), and counts {eligible, ineligible, insufficient, rulesNotAvailable, total}.

src/types.ts::DiscoveryPostResult.text: The exam finder's result for one post: its name and department, the verdict, the reasons for it, the post's source, and the underlying eligibility result it came from (if all needed details were given).
src/types.ts::DiscoveryPostResult.tech: Interface {postId, postName, department, verdict: DiscoveryPostVerdict, reasons: DiscoveryReason[], provenance, engineVerdict: PostVerdict | null}. A projection of evaluatePostEligibility, not a second rule system.

src/types.ts::DiscoveryPostVerdict.text: The finder's verdict on one post: eligible, ineligible, not enough information, or rules not available.

src/types.ts::DiscoveryProfile.text: The details a student gives the exam finder. Every field is optional because a new student may not know them yet; anything missing that a rule needs is reported as missing, never guessed.
src/types.ts::DiscoveryProfile.tech: Interface of optional fields {dateOfBirth?, category?, degree?, branch?, statisticsInDegree?, mathsIn12thWith60Percent?, physicalFitnessDeclared?, colorBlind?}. Input to discoverExams(profile, exams).

src/types.ts::DiscoveryProfileField.text: The names of the personal details the 'which exams can I take?' finder can use, such as date of birth, category, degree and physical fitness.
src/types.ts::DiscoveryProfileField.tech: Union 'dateOfBirth' | 'category' | 'degree' | 'branch' | 'statisticsInDegree' | 'mathsIn12thWith60Percent' | 'physicalFitnessDeclared' | 'colorBlind'. Listed in DiscoveryReason.missingFields when a rule needs one.

src/types.ts::DiscoveryReason.text: One check's outcome for one post in the exam finder: which rule, pass, fail or unknown, the explanation in the eligibility checker's own words, any details the student has not given, whether the exam has no rule of this kind, and the source it rests on.
src/types.ts::DiscoveryReason.tech: Interface {rule: DiscoveryRule, outcome 'PASS' | 'FAIL' | 'UNKNOWN', text, missingFields: DiscoveryProfileField[], ruleNotPublished?, provenance: DataProvenance[]}. DiscoveryPostResult.reasons.

src/types.ts::DiscoveryResult.text: The shape of the full answer to 'which exams could I sit?': the student's profile, one result per exam in the register's own order (nothing is ranked), how many exams were checked, and every profile detail any exam still needs so the page can ask once.
src/types.ts::DiscoveryResult.tech: Interface: profile: DiscoveryProfile, exams: DiscoveryExamResult[] (universe order, unranked), universe {authored, machineAcquired, total}, missingFields: DiscoveryProfileField[] (union across exams).

src/types.ts::DiscoveryRule.text: Which kind of check a finder reason is about: age, qualification, or physical standards.

src/types.ts::DiscoverySearchState.text: The result of looking for one kind of document for an exam: found and verified, found but unclear, found but unreadable, not found after a full search, search incomplete, or not searched, with a reason and counts of places not read.
src/types.ts::DiscoverySearchState.tech: Interface {state (FOUND_VERIFIED | FOUND_AMBIGUOUS | FOUND_UNREADABLE | NOT_FOUND_AFTER_DISCOVERY | SEARCH_INCOMPLETE | NOT_SEARCHED), reason, notRead?: Record<skip reason, count>}. DiscoveredSources.searchStates by role.

src/types.ts::DiscoveryVerdict.text: The finder's verdict on an exam: eligible, conditional, ineligible, not enough information given, or the exam's rules are not available. The last one is never shown as 'not eligible'.
src/types.ts::DiscoveryVerdict.tech: Union 'ELIGIBLE' | 'CONDITIONAL' | 'INELIGIBLE' | 'INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION' | 'RULES_NOT_AVAILABLE'; the first three are the eligibility engine's own statuses.

src/types.ts::DocumentSpecification.text: The rules for an upload such as a photo or signature: the kind of document, size in pixels, file type, file size, rules, a description of a good sample, and optional source.
src/types.ts::DocumentSpecification.tech: Interface {documentType, dimensions, fileFormat, fileSize, rules[], sampleDescription, provenance?}. ApplicationGuideData.photoRules and signatureRules.

src/types.ts::EligibilityDiagnostic.text: The full eligibility result for an exam: overall status, the candidate's exact age on the key date, the age relaxation applied, how many posts they qualify for, the clauses involved, a plain explanation, and a verdict per post. If the record lacks what is needed, it says it cannot be evaluated.
src/types.ts::EligibilityDiagnostic.tech: Interface {isEligible, status ('ELIGIBLE' | 'CONDITIONAL' | 'INELIGIBLE' | 'NOT_EVALUABLE'), calculatedAgeOnCutoff {years, months, days, crucialDate}, categoryRelaxationApplied, totalEligiblePosts, totalAvailablePosts, legalClauses[], plainEnglishExplanation, postVerdicts: PostVerdict[]}. Output of evaluateEligibility.

src/types.ts::EligibilityRule.text: One eligibility condition as the notice states it, such as a required degree, a subject, a minimum percentage, or permission for final-year students to apply. The eligibility checker compares a candidate against these rules and nothing else.
src/types.ts::EligibilityRule.tech: Interface {id, ruleType (AGE_MIN | AGE_MAX | DOB_CUTOFF | DEGREE_REQUIRED | BRANCH_SPECIALIZATION | PERCENTAGE_MIN | NATIONALITY | CATEGORY_RELAXATION | APPEARING_ALLOWED | STATED_CONDITION), operator (>= | <= | = | IN | BETWEEN), ruleValue, category, subject?, level?, statedAs?, provenance}. STATED_CONDITION cannot be answered from a profile and leaves the post undetermined.

src/types.ts::EvidenceType.text: How a cited value relates to its source: printed directly in the quoted words, settled by a later official statement replacing an earlier one, or worked out by GovOS from other facts.
src/types.ts::EvidenceType.tech: Union 'DIRECT' | 'RECONCILED' | 'DERIVED'; DataProvenance.evidenceType. RECONCILED pairs with supersedes/supersededBy, DERIVED with derivation.

src/types.ts::Exam.text: The complete record of one exam that the whole app is built on: its name, authority, website and key dates; its posts, eligibility rules, stages, pattern and syllabus; practice questions and official papers and keys; corrections, cut-offs, resources and FAQs; the application guide, study roadmaps, admit-card and result information; and notes about where each part came from. Every exam, whether written by hand or read by machine from official documents, fits this same shape. An exam also says whether it is a recruitment or an eligibility test (such as a TET), which fills no post. It can also be an admission test (such as JEE), whose scores decide admission to institutions.
src/types.ts::Exam.tech: Interface with required id, code, title, authorityName, officialDomain, crucialEligibilityDate, isGoldenJourney, isDemoData, overviewDescription, posts, dates, globalRuleGroup, stages, syllabus, practiceQuestions, corrigendums, cutoffsHistory, resources, faqs, applicationGuide, roadmapTracks; optional minimumQualification, careerFields, categoryTag, vacanciesTotal, factEvidence, patternTree, studyGuidance, vacancyBreakups, syllabusTree, officialPapers, answerKeys, admitCardDetails, admitCardEvents, examDayChecklist, resultNextSteps, resultDeclarations, eligibilityHighlights, officialLinks, syllabusSourceNote, ageRelaxations, origin ('AUTHORED' | 'MACHINE_ACQUIRED'), sectionStates (per-section completeness + evidenceRoles), materialization (audit ledger). ALL_EXAMS and the runtime registry hold these. Optional examNature: 'RECRUITMENT' (the default) | 'ELIGIBILITY_TEST' (no posts, vacancies, pay or post-wise age band). | 'ADMISSION_TEST' (an entrance test; no posts either).

src/types.ts::ExamAdmitCardEvent.text: One admit-card related event exactly as an authority published it, such as a city slip, an admit card or a call letter for a stage. It keeps the release date separate from the exam date, can hold a rule like '7 days before the exam' instead of a date, says whether a day or only a month was printed, and links a file only where the authority published one.
src/types.ts::ExamAdmitCardEvent.tech: Interface: id, examId, kind (ADMIT_CARD | CITY_INTIMATION | EXAM_INTIMATION | OTHER), officialLabel, sourceLabel?, status (VERIFIED | NEEDS_REVIEW | NOT_PUBLISHED | NOT_EXTRACTED), cycle?, stageLabel?, stageRef?, releasedAt?, releasePrecision? (DAY | MONTH), releaseNote?, releaseRule?, releaseRuleNote?, availableUntil?, examDate?, examDateNote?, portalUrl?, portalNote?, downloadUrl?, credentials?, documents?, instructions?, supersedes?, note?, provenance?. Exam.admitCardEvents, rendered by section 14.

src/types.ts::ExamAnswerKey.text: An official answer key tied to one exact paper: whether it is provisional or final, its link, when it was published, the window for challenging it, how candidates access it, and which earlier key it replaces. The answers list is empty when the authority shows them only to each candidate after login; GovOS never fills them in.
src/types.ts::ExamAnswerKey.tech: Interface {id, identity, kind (PROVISIONAL | FINAL | REVISED | UNSPECIFIED), url, status?, sourceStatus?, publishedAt?, windowOpens?, windowCloses?, access?, revises?, note?, entries?: {questionNumber, accepted[], value?, status}[], provenance?}. Exam.answerKeys, rendered by AnswerKeyPanel.

src/types.ts::ExamCareerField.text: The broad career area an exam leads to, used by the Exam Finder’s field filter (for example banking, railways, civil services, teaching). Engineering is one of them now.
src/types.ts::ExamCareerField.tech: Union of seven labels: 'Government Job', 'Civil Services & Governance', 'Banking & Financial Sector', 'Indian Railways', 'Defence & Armed Forces', 'State Public Services', 'Teaching & Education'. The finder offers these plus any field a record declares. Eighth label: 'Engineering & Technology'.

src/types.ts::ExamCategoryTag.text: The family an exam belongs to (civil services, state commission, staff selection, banking, railways, defence), used for recommendations.

src/types.ts::ExamDayChecklistItem.text: One item on an exam-day checklist (documents, timing, allowed or banned items, centre instructions), whether it is mandatory, and optionally its source. Without an officially verified source it must not be shown as official.
src/types.ts::ExamDayChecklistItem.tech: Interface {id, category 'DOCUMENTS' | 'TIMING' | 'ITEMS_ALLOWED' | 'ITEMS_PROHIBITED' | 'CENTRE_INSTRUCTIONS', title, description, isMandatory, provenance?}. Exam.examDayChecklist (authored for no exam yet).

src/types.ts::ExamFactOverlay.text: A machine-recorded change to one fact of one exam for one cycle, such as a date or a post detail. It adds to the record rather than overwriting it, carries its source and status, can replace an earlier change while keeping the old value, and can be retired.
src/types.ts::ExamFactOverlay.tech: Interface {id, examId, cycle, domain (dates, posts, eligibility, pattern, syllabus…), targetId?, targetScope?, kind, value, provenance, status ('VERIFIED' | 'NEEDS_REVIEW' | 'NOT_PUBLISHED'), supersedesId?, previousValue?, effectiveDate?, conflictNote?, createdAt, createdBy, retired}. Overlay routes sit behind admin_required.

src/types.ts::ExamFactOverlayKind.text: The kind of change an overlay makes to an exam fact: add, amend, supersede, retire, or flag a conflict.

src/types.ts::ExamOfficialPaper.text: A question paper the authority itself published, as one entry in a catalogue: its exact identity, title and link, and whether its questions could be read. A scanned paper is listed with a note saying why its questions are not shown.
src/types.ts::ExamOfficialPaper.tech: Interface {id, identity: ExamPaperIdentity, title, url, status?, contentsStatus? (VERIFIED | NEEDS_REVIEW | NOT_PUBLISHED | NOT_EXTRACTED), contentsNote?, provenance?}. Exam.officialPapers, rendered by OfficialPaperCatalogue.

src/types.ts::ExamOverlayScope.text: Pinpoints which part of an exam an overlay change applies to: a stage, paper, post, rule, category, subject, topic or level.
src/types.ts::ExamOverlayScope.tech: Interface of optional ids/labels {stageId?, paperId?, postId?, ruleId?, categoryLabel?, subject?, topicId?, levelLabel?}; ExamFactOverlay.targetScope.

src/types.ts::ExamPaperIdentity.text: Exactly which question paper something belongs to: the exam, and where printed the cycle, stage, paper, subject, language, set code and session, plus a readable description. This keeps one paper's answer key from being attached to another paper.
src/types.ts::ExamPaperIdentity.tech: Interface {examId, cycle?, stage?, paper?, subject?, language?, setCode?, session?, describe}. Used by ExamOfficialPaper and ExamAnswerKey.

src/types.ts::ExamPatternNode.text: One part of an exam's structure as the authority published it (a stage, paper, subject or section), using the authority's own names. It can hold the number of questions, marks, time, negative marking, qualifying rules, languages and mode, and can contain smaller parts. Anything not printed stays empty instead of showing as zero, and figures GovOS calculated are marked as such.
src/types.ts::ExamPatternNode.tech: Recursive interface: id, level (STAGE | PAPER | SUBJECT | SECTION | PART | OTHER), levelLabel?, name, code?, order?, status?, questions?, marks?, durationMinutes?, marksPerQuestion?, negativeMarking?/negativeMarkPerWrong?/negativeFractionOfMarks?, qualifying? {asPrinted, qualifyingOnly, countsTowardsMerit, minimums, byCategory}, languages?, mode?, questionType?, sectionalTiming?, durationVariants?, derived?[], derivedEvidence?, underReview?[], note?, provenance?, children?. Exam.patternTree, rendered by section 05.

src/types.ts::ExamQualificationLevel.text: An education level: Class 10, Class 12, graduation, or post-graduation.
src/types.ts::ExamQualificationLevel.tech: Union 'CLASS_10' | 'CLASS_12' | 'GRADUATION' | 'POST_GRADUATION'. Used by Exam.minimumQualification (Exam Finder) and EligibilityRule.level.

src/types.ts::ExamRecommendation.text: One recommended exam with a relevance score from 0 to 100, the reasons, how strong the match is, and the main signal behind it. The score is about relevance, not the chance of selection or a guarantee of eligibility.
src/types.ts::ExamRecommendation.tech: Interface {exam: Exam, score (0–100 normalised relevance), reasons[], matchStrength 'STRONG' | 'MODERATE' | 'EXPLORATORY', primarySignal}. Output of the recommendation engine on the home page.

src/types.ts::ExamResultDeclaration.text: One result an authority declared or scheduled, read from its own document: what kind of result it is, the stage and post, when it was declared (or is only expected), the outcome and number qualified where stated, the next step, links, cut-offs, and whether it was revised or cancelled. A scheduled result is never shown as declared, and no individual candidate's details are stored.
src/types.ts::ExamResultDeclaration.tech: Interface: id, examId, kind (RESULT | WRITTEN_RESULT | … | SCHEDULED | OTHER), label, sourceLabel?, isDeclaration, status, lifecycle (ORIGINAL | REVISED | CANCELLED | SUPERSEDED), cycle?, stageLabel?, stageRef?, postLabel?, declaredAt?/declaredPrecision?/declaredNote?, expectedAt?/expectedPrecision?/expectedNote?, qualification?, qualifiedCount?, nextStep?, nextStageRef?, documentUrl?, portalUrl?, cutoffs?[], supersedes?, note?, provenance?. Exam.resultDeclarations; section 16's official results panel.

src/types.ts::ExamStage.text: One stage of an exam (for example Tier-I or the Preliminary exam): its number and name, the record's own label, time, questions, marks, negative marking, mode, whether it only needs to be passed, its sections, and any typing or skill test it includes. Figures the source did not state are listed so they show as 'not stated', not zero.
src/types.ts::ExamStage.tech: Interface: id, stageNumber, stageName, tier (free string), durationMinutes, totalQuestions, totalMarks, negativeMarking, mode, qualifyingNature, unstatedFields?, derivedFrom? ('patternTree'), meritMarks?, skillTest?: SkillTestSpec, sections[] {sectionName, modules, questions, marks, durationMinutes, negativeMarking}, provenance. Exam.stages.

src/types.ts::ExamSyllabusNode.text: One entry in an exam's syllabus as the authority published it, at any depth (paper, part, section, topic and so on). Entries can contain child entries. If the authority named something but did not list what is inside it, it stays empty rather than being filled in.
src/types.ts::ExamSyllabusNode.tech: Recursive interface {id, title, levelLabel?, order?, status? (VERIFIED | NEEDS_REVIEW | NOT_PUBLISHED | NOT_EXTRACTED), note?, scope?: {kind, label}[], provenance?, children?}. Produced by the exam builder per exam; Exam.syllabusTree, rendered in section 06's Official Syllabus view.

src/types.ts::ExcludedModule.text: A study block that does not apply to a post, with the reason and the post it applies to instead.
src/types.ts::ExcludedModule.tech: Interface {moduleId, moduleName, reason, applicableOnlyTo}. Used in PostStudyPath tier1/tier2.excludedModules (EXCLUDED_STATISTICS).

src/types.ts::FAQItem.text: One frequently asked question about an exam, with its answer, the official clause it rests on, and its source.
src/types.ts::FAQItem.tech: Interface {id, question, answer, officialClause, provenance}. Exam.faqs, shown in the FAQs reference section.

src/types.ts::FactVerification.text: How well one fact cited in a Claude answer is backed: verified only when its official source's quoted words actually state it; otherwise unsupported, still being checked, replaced, or with no source at all.
src/types.ts::FactVerification.tech: Union 'VERIFIED' | 'UNSUPPORTED' | 'UNDER_VERIFICATION' | 'SUPERSEDED' | 'UNVERIFIED', decided by tools/claude_cli/context.py fact_verification and re-derived on the page. ClaudeAnswerCitation.verification.

src/types.ts::ImportantDate.text: One milestone on an exam's timeline, such as the last date to apply or the exam day: its kind, label, date and time, whether it is tentative, whether it is available or has been replaced, and its source. A date printed only as a month or range is shown exactly as printed and never counted down to.
src/types.ts::ImportantDate.tech: Interface: id, type (NOTIFICATION | APPLICATION_OPEN | APPLICATION_CLOSE | CORRECTION_WINDOW | ADMIT_CARD | EXAM_TIER1 | EXAM_TIER2 | ANSWER_KEY | RESULT | INTERVIEW | OTHER), label, dateTimeStr, timezone, isTentative, status (AVAILABLE | NOT_YET_ANNOUNCED | SUPERSEDED), provenance, supersededBy?, stageAssociation? (STATED | NEEDS_REVIEW), stageLabel?, displayWhen? (as printed; dateTimeStr then only orders). Exam.dates.

src/types.ts::InAppChapter.text: One chapter of a handbook shown inside the app: a title and its text.

src/types.ts::LiveResourceStatus.text: A summary of the live refresh system: when SSC's board was last fetched, when link checks last ran, how many links are tracked and pending, and the refresh intervals.
src/types.ts::LiveResourceStatus.tech: Interface {sscFetchedAt, healthLastRun, healthTracked, healthPending, feedIntervalHours, healthIntervalHours}. GET /api/resources/live/status.

src/types.ts::MultiTierResultEntry.text: The marks a candidate types in (or reads from their scorecard) to check their own result: their marks and category, where the number came from, and optional per-stage figures for SSC, UPSC or IBPS, skill-test scores, and basic details like year and roll number.
src/types.ts::MultiTierResultEntry.tech: Interface: marks, category, source, declared?, examId?, examType?, SSC fields (tier1Marks, tier2Marks, legacy computerKnowledgeMarks/destMistakesPercent), skillScores? keyed by SkillTestMetric.key, UPSC and IBPS mark fields, examYear?, rollNumber?, candidateName?, allocatedPost?/allocatedService?. The candidate's self-assessment in section 16, distinct from ExamResultDeclaration.

src/types.ts::NotificationChannel.text: A way an alert can be delivered: in the app, browser push, email, or WhatsApp.

src/types.ts::NotificationEventType.text: The kind of exam event an alert is about: applications opening, application deadline, correction window, admit card, exam date, answer key, or result.

src/types.ts::NotificationPreference.text: The candidate's alert settings: which delivery channels are on, contact details, which kinds of events they want alerts for, and which reminder times (7 days, 3 days, 1 day, last day).
src/types.ts::NotificationPreference.tech: Interface {channels {inApp, browserPush, email, whatsapp}, contactInfo {email, phone, whatsappVerified}, eventSubscriptions {applicationOpening, applicationDeadlines, correctionWindows, admitCards, examDates, results}, reminderSchedule {sevenDaysBefore, threeDaysBefore, oneDayBefore, lastDayHoursBefore}}. Honoured by generatePersonalizedNotificationsForTrackedExams; stored under govos_notification_preferences.

src/types.ts::OTRStep.text: One step of an exam's online registration process: its number and title, the portal address, instructions, required fields, common mistakes to avoid, and optional source.
src/types.ts::OTRStep.tech: Interface {stepNumber, title, portalUrl, instructions[], mandatoryFields[], commonMistakesToAvoid[], provenance?}. ApplicationGuideData.otrSteps.

src/types.ts::OfficialPaperQuestion.text: A question taken from an authority's own published paper. It stores the exact exam it belongs to, the paper, year, stage and question number, the question in English, marks, whether it is an essay-style or multiple-choice question, and the official answer only if the authority published one.
src/types.ts::OfficialPaperQuestion.tech: Interface {id, examId, paperName, paperYear, stage 'PRELIMS' | 'MAINS', section?, questionNumber, promptEnglish, marks, answerFormat 'DESCRIPTIVE' | 'MCQ', options?, officialAnswerKey: string | null, officialAnswerKeyNote?, provenance (document and page)}. Accessed only via officialQuestionsForExam(examId); used for the UPSC CSE 2026 Essay paper.

src/types.ts::PostRequirement.text: One job post an exam recruits for: its name, department, pay level and scale, classification as the notice printed it, age limits, any special qualification or conditions, physical standards, colour-blindness rule, eligibility rules and source.
src/types.ts::PostRequirement.tech: Interface: id, postName, department, ministry?, payLevel, payScale, gradePay?, classification (free string, empty when unstated), minAge, maxAge, specialQualification?, postConditions?, physicalRequired?, physicalNote?, colorBlindnessAllowed?, natureOfWork?, ruleGroup? (post-specific qualification rules), provenance. Exam.posts; read by the eligibility engine.

src/types.ts::PostStudyPath.text: The full study plan for one post: its name, department, classification and pay, the Tier-1 and Tier-2 study blocks that apply or are excluded, whether Paper-II Statistics is needed, the computer and typing test expectations, and any physical or medical standards.
src/types.ts::PostStudyPath.tech: Interface {postId, postName, department, classification, payLevel, tier1 {commonModules, additionalModules, excludedModules}, tier2 {paper1Mandatory, paper2StatisticsRequired, computerQualifyingThreshold ('STANDARD_18_MARKS_QUALIFYING' | 'HIGHER_CUTOFF_MANDATED_CPT'), destTypingThreshold ('STANDARD_QUALIFYING' | 'HIGHER_ACCURACY_MANDATED'), module lists}, physicalMedical? {required, height/chest/weight?, physicalTest?, colorBlindnessAllowed}}. ALL_POST_STUDY_PATHS values; rendered by PostStudyPathEngine.

src/types.ts::PostVerdict.text: The eligibility result for one post: eligible or not, the age check result, the candidate's age and the maximum allowed, the qualification check, any physical restriction, the reason and the clause. 'Unknown' means the record could not decide, never a pass or fail.
src/types.ts::PostVerdict.tech: Interface {postId, postName, department, payLevel, eligible, ageStatus ('OK' | 'EXCEEDED' | 'UNDERAGE' | 'UNKNOWN'), calculatedAge, maxPermissibleAge, qualStatus ('OK' | 'DISQUALIFIED' | 'UNKNOWN'), physicalStatus ('OK' | 'RESTRICTED'), reason, officialClause}. From evaluatePostEligibility; EligibilityDiagnostic.postVerdicts.

src/types.ts::PracticeQuestion.text: One question as it appears in a practice test: its topic and subject, stage, where it sits in the paper, what kind of question it is (for example GovOS-made or sectional), the text, choices, correct answer, explanations, difficulty and source.
src/types.ts::PracticeQuestion.tech: Interface: id, topicId, subject, topicName, tier ('TIER_1' | 'TIER_2'), shiftInfo, questionType (OFFICIAL_PYQ | USER_SUBMITTED | GOVOS_CREATED | AI_GENERATED | CUSTOM_AI_GENERATED | SECTIONAL_MOCK | TOPIC_DRILL | REFERENCE_SOURCE), questionText, options, correctOptionIndex, explanation, detailedExplanation?, year?, difficulty (EASY | MEDIUM | HARD | ADAPTIVE), provenance. Built by the data.ts paper builders.

src/types.ts::QuestionOption.text: One answer choice of a question: a number and its text.

src/types.ts::RequirementProvenanceType.text: Why a study item is in a plan: the official notice requires it, it comes from the syllabus, GovOS recommends it, or it is optional extra help.

src/types.ts::ResearchDiscoveryMeta.text: The checks the server ran on a source Claude suggested: whether it opened, the response code, where it finally led, the trust of that final address, the page identity, and reasons. The 'why relevant' and authority name are Claude's own words and shown as such.
src/types.ts::ResearchDiscoveryMeta.tech: Interface {authorityName?, documentKind?, whyRelevant?, reachable?, httpStatus?, finalUrl?, finalTrust?, identity?, reasons?[]} (all nullable). ResearchFinding.discovery, from meta_json.

src/types.ts::ResearchExtractResult.text: The result of fetching a finding's page text: the address, the text, its length, and whether the fetch failed and why. A failure describes this fetch only, never the authority.
src/types.ts::ResearchExtractResult.tech: Interface {url, rawContent, chars, failed, failure? (SOURCE_FETCH_FAILURE | SCANNED_DOCUMENT), reason?}. POST /api/research/extract.

src/types.ts::ResearchFact.text: One candidate value for one field of one exam, pulled from a research finding, with the source, the evidence text, how it was extracted, a confidence score, its review status and notes.
src/types.ts::ResearchFact.tech: Interface: id, findingId, runId?, examId?, examName?, field, rawValue?, value?, valueType (DATE | URL | TEXT | INTEGER | ENUM), sourceUrl, sourceTitle?, sourceType (OFFICIAL | HIGH | MEDIUM | LOW), evidence?, extractionRule?, confidence, status: ResearchFactStatus, validationNotes[], conflictGroup?, retrievedAt?, reviewedAt?. Stored in research_facts.

src/types.ts::ResearchFactStatus.text: Where an extracted research fact stands: pending, validated, conflicting, rejected, or approved. Only an approved fact can go on to the promotion step; nothing is published by this alone.
src/types.ts::ResearchFactStatus.tech: Union 'pending' | 'validated' | 'conflicting' | 'rejected' | 'approved'; ResearchFact.status, distinct from a finding's reviewStatus.

src/types.ts::ResearchFinding.text: One candidate source found by a research run: its title, address, snippet, trust level, score, publication date if known, review status, any page text GovOS fetched, and the checks the server ran on it.
src/types.ts::ResearchFinding.tech: Interface {id, runId, title, url, snippet, trustLevel, score, publishedDate?, reviewStatus, hasExtractedText?, extractedText?, createdAt?, discovery?: ResearchDiscoveryMeta | null}. Stored in research_findings; reviewed in the Trust Panel.

src/types.ts::ResearchMode.text: Whether a research search keeps only official websites or any website (each labelled by trust).
src/types.ts::ResearchMode.tech: Union 'OFFICIAL' | 'WEB'; the mode of a Live Source Research run, enforced server-side.

src/types.ts::ResearchOutcome.text: The wrapper around every research call's answer: either success with the data, or failure with an error and, when Claude is not available, a setup hint so the page can show a setup notice instead of a generic error.
src/types.ts::ResearchOutcome.tech: Generic discriminated union {ok: true; data: T} | {ok: false; error; setup?; claudeUnavailable?; status?}. Returned by researchService methods.

src/types.ts::ResearchReviewStatus.text: Where a research finding stands in human review: waiting, reviewed, promoted, or rejected.
src/types.ts::ResearchReviewStatus.tech: Union 'PENDING_REVIEW' | 'REVIEWED' | 'PROMOTED' | 'REJECTED'; ResearchFinding.reviewStatus. Only PROMOTED findings may become resource additions.

src/types.ts::ResearchRun.text: One research search: the query, mode, exam, result count, when it ran, which engine ran it, its job, and the findings.
src/types.ts::ResearchRun.tech: Interface {id, query, mode, examId?, answer?, resultCount, createdAt, engine? (CLAUDE_DISCOVERY | LEGACY_SEARCH), jobId?, findings: ResearchFinding[]}. GET /api/research/runs/<id>.

src/types.ts::ResearchSearchResult.text: A finished research search as stored: the findings kept, plus the sources Claude suggested that the server refused and why.
src/types.ts::ResearchSearchResult.tech: Interface {runId, query, mode, examId?, engine?, jobId?, results: ResearchFinding[], rejected?: {url, reasons[]}[]}. The result of a DISCOVER_SOURCES job.

src/types.ts::ResearchStatus.text: The state of the research feature: whether Claude is ready to run a search, its health, whether an admin token is required, the list of official domains, and counts of runs and findings awaiting review.
