src/types.ts::ResearchStatus.tech: Interface {available, engine, claude: ClaudeHealth, adminTokenRequired, officialDomains[], runCount, pendingReview}. GET /api/research/status.

src/types.ts::ResearchTrustLevel.text: How much a source found by research can be trusted, judged only from its website address: official, trusted public, or unverified.
src/types.ts::ResearchTrustLevel.tech: Union 'OFFICIAL' | 'TRUSTED_PUBLIC' | 'UNVERIFIED'; set server-side from the domain (gov.in/nic.in vs ac.in/edu/PRS vs other).

src/types.ts::ResourceAddition.text: A resource a verifier added from the Trust Panel without editing code: its title, link, subject, format, author, description, when and from where it was added, the research finding it came from, the one exam it belongs to, and what kind of source it is. That last part is decided by the server, never by the browser.
src/types.ts::ResourceAddition.tech: Interface {id, title, url, subject, resourceFormat, author, description, addedAt, addedFrom, findingId?, examId?, sourceKind? ('OFFICIAL' | 'GOVERNMENT_SITE' | 'TRUSTED_PUBLIC' | 'THIRD_PARTY', server-derived from URL and exam)}. GET/POST /api/resources/additions; turned into a ResourceItem by additionToResource().

src/types.ts::ResourceHealthSync.text: The reply when the library registers its links for health checking: current results, how many are still waiting to be checked, when the last check ran, and how often checks run.
src/types.ts::ResourceHealthSync.tech: Interface {results: ResourceLinkCheck[], pending, lastRun, intervalHours}. POST /api/resources/health/sync.

src/types.ts::ResourceItem.text: One entry in a resource library: a link to a PDF, website, video, channel or tool, with its subject, author, type, format, description, who it suits, its source, whether it is pinned as essential, when its link last worked, and what it is for. GovOS only links to these; it stores no study material. Subjects now also include Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, architecture and planning aptitude, child development and pedagogy, languages, environmental studies and social studies.
src/types.ts::ResourceItem.tech: Interface: id, title, subject (closed union of library groups), author, type (OFFICIAL_PDF | OFFICIAL_PORTAL | SIMPLIFIED_GUIDE | RECOMMENDED_BOOK | VIDEO_LECTURE | ONLINE_TOOL | THIRD_PARTY), resourceFormat (DIRECT_PDF | YOUTUBE_COURSE | YOUTUBE_CHANNEL | INTERACTIVE_HANDBOOK | ONLINE_TOOL | OFFICIAL_PORTAL | EXTERNAL_PAGE), url, directPdfUrl?, youtubeUrl?, youtubeEmbedId?, inAppHandbookContent?, description, recommendedFor, rating?, officialTag?, provenance?, isEssential?, linkVerifiedDate?, role?. Exam.resources. subject union + 'Physics' | 'Chemistry' | 'Mathematics' | 'Architecture & Planning Aptitude' | 'Child Development & Pedagogy' | 'Languages' | 'Environmental Studies' | 'Social Studies'.

src/types.ts::ResourceLinkCheck.text: One link-check result: the address, its status, the web response code, and when it was checked.
src/types.ts::ResourceLinkCheck.tech: Interface {url, status: ResourceLinkStatus, httpCode, checkedAt}. Returned by the verify-links and health endpoints; ResourceHealthSync.results.

src/types.ts::ResourceLinkStatus.text: The result of checking whether a link works: healthy, redirected, blocked, broken, or unreachable.
src/types.ts::ResourceLinkStatus.tech: Union 'HEALTHY' | 'REDIRECT' | 'BLOCKED' | 'BROKEN' | 'UNREACHABLE', as classified by the server's link checker.

src/types.ts::ResourceRole.text: What a resource is for, such as a notification, a syllabus, a question paper, an admit card, study material or a lecture video. Only study material, lecture videos and practice tools appear in the Resource Library; the rest go to the section they belong to.
src/types.ts::ResourceRole.tech: Union of 22 roles matching tools/exam_builder discover.DocKind (EXAM_PAGE … STUDY_MATERIAL, LECTURE_VIDEO, PRACTICE_TOOL, DISCOVERY_SIGNAL, UNKNOWN). Used by ResourceItem.role, resourceRoleOf, RESOURCE_SECTION placement, and discovery types.

src/types.ts::ResultActionOption.text: One suggested next action after a result: a title, description, optional badge, a section of the exam page to jump to, and a suggested timeline.
src/types.ts::ResultActionOption.tech: Interface {title, description, badge?, linkSection? (section id), recommendedTimeline?}. ResultNextStepStage.actions.

src/types.ts::ResultNextStepStage.text: Guidance shown for a result outcome (qualified, not qualified, waiting, skill test, document check): a headline, summary, suggested actions, whether it is GovOS guidance and what it was based on, the stages involved, and an optional backup plan.
src/types.ts::ResultNextStepStage.tech: Interface {status 'QUALIFIED' | 'NOT_QUALIFIED' | 'AWAITING_RESULT' | 'SKILL_TEST' | 'DOCUMENT_VERIFICATION', headline, summary, actions: ResultActionOption[], isGuidance?, basis?, fromStage?, nextStage?, provenance?, contingencyPlan? {summary, alternativeExams[], weakAreaStrategy}}. Exam.resultNextSteps (authored for none yet).

src/types.ts::RoadmapPhase.text: One phase of a study roadmap: its number, title, length in weeks, focus, and a week-by-week schedule with goals, suggested daily hours and a milestone test.
src/types.ts::RoadmapPhase.tech: Interface {phaseNumber, phaseTitle, durationWeeks, focusArea, weeklySchedule: {weekNumber, weekTitle, goals[], suggestedDailyHours, milestoneTest}[]}. RoadmapTrack.phases.

src/types.ts::RoadmapTrack.text: A whole study roadmap option, such as a 90-day or 180-day plan or one for working professionals: its name, daily hours, who it suits, its phases and a daily timetable.
src/types.ts::RoadmapTrack.tech: Interface {id 'TRACK_90_DAYS' | 'TRACK_180_DAYS' | 'TRACK_WORKING_PRO', name, subtitle, targetDailyHours, suitableFor, phases: RoadmapPhase[], dailyTimetable: {timeSlot, activity, focus}[]}. Exam.roadmapTracks; Study Roadmap section.

src/types.ts::RuleGroup.tech: Recursive interface {id, operator 'AND' | 'OR', rules: EligibilityRule[], childGroups?: RuleGroup[]}. Used as Exam.globalRuleGroup and PostRequirement.ruleGroup.

src/types.ts::ShortcutTrick.text: A quick method for solving a question: its name, an optional formula, an explanation or one-line version, and how much time it saves.

src/types.ts::SkillTestSpec.tech: Interface {name, description?, qualifying?, durationMinutes?, requirements?[], sectionNames?[], metrics?: SkillTestMetric[], provenance?}. Lives on ExamStage.skillTest; its presence alone gives an exam a skill-test card in Results.

src/types.ts::SourceHealthLog.text: A monitoring record for one official source address in the admin Trust Panel: the response code, when it was checked, fingerprints of its content, whether the text changed, the review status, and old and new values.

src/types.ts::SscNoticeFeed.text: The latest SSC notice-board entries as served by GovOS's server: the items, total, whether it shows CGL only or all, when it was fetched, whether the copy is out of date, any error, the source and the refresh interval.

src/types.ts::SscNoticeFile.tech: Interface {name, url (absolute ssc.gov.in attachment link), sizeKb}. SscNotice.files.

src/types.ts::StudyModuleRequirement.text: One study block in a post's plan, such as Tier-1 Reasoning: its subject and stage, why it is included, the clause it cites, the number of questions and marks, negative marking, high-yield topics, a tip, and its source.
src/types.ts::StudyModuleRequirement.tech: Interface {id, title, subject: SyllabusSubject, stage 'TIER_1' | 'TIER_2' | 'BOTH', requirementType, officialClause, questionsCount, marks, negativeMarking, highYieldTopics[], keyTakeaways, provenance}. The MODULE_* constants in data.ts.

src/types.ts::SyllabusRevision.text: One verifier decision about an exam's syllabus, stored on the server and applied on top of the original syllabus: add a topic, change one, or hide one, with a note and the notice it was based on.
src/types.ts::SyllabusRevision.tech: Interface {id, examId, kind 'ADD' | 'AMEND' | 'RETIRE', topicId?, topic?: SyllabusRevisionTopic, note?, noticeTitle?, noticeUrl?, noticeDate?, appliedAt, appliedBy}. Table syllabus_revisions; merged by applySyllabusRevisions.

src/types.ts::SyllabusWatch.text: The notices on an authority's live board that might change the syllabus and are dated after it was last verified, with when they were fetched, whether the copy is old, any error, which board was read, and a note.

src/types.ts::TechnicalTermDefinition.text: A technical word used in a solution and its plain meaning.

src/types.ts::UserInteractionEvent.text: One recorded action by the candidate, such as viewing an exam, with what it was about and when, used to recommend exams.
src/types.ts::UserInteractionEvent.tech: Interface {id, type, targetId?, targetType? ('EXAM' | 'RESOURCE' | 'TOPIC' | 'SEARCH_QUERY'), examId?, categoryTag?, timestamp (number), metadata?}. Input to the time-decayed recommendation engine.

src/types.ts::UserInteractionType.text: The kinds of action a candidate takes that feed recommendations: searching, viewing, bookmarking, following, opening a resource, or reading a syllabus.

src/types.ts::UserProfile.text: The candidate's saved details used for eligibility: date of birth, degree and branch, maths and statistics background, percentage, category, gender, home state, nationality, and physical fitness and colour-blindness answers.
src/types.ts::UserProfile.tech: Interface {dateOfBirth, degree, branch, mathsIn12thWith60Percent?, statisticsInDegree?, percentage, category ('GENERAL' | 'OBC' | 'SC' | 'ST' | 'PwBD' | 'EWS'), gender, domicileState, nationality, physicalFitnessDeclared?, colorBlind?}. Stored under govos_candidate_profile; read by the eligibility engine and chat context.

src/types.ts::UserReport.text: An error report a candidate filed: what it is about, the kind of problem (wrong eligibility, outdated date, broken link, wrong question), a description, when it was made, and the admin's decision.
src/types.ts::UserReport.tech: Interface {id, entityType, entityId, issueCategory ('WRONG_ELIGIBILITY' | 'OUTDATED_DATE' | 'BROKEN_LINK' | 'INCORRECT_QUESTION'), description, createdAt, adminStatus ('PENDING' | 'RESOLVED' | 'REJECTED')}. Backed by /api/reports.

src/types.ts::VacancyBreakupTable.text: A table of vacancies by post and zone that the authority printed, read from the document's grid. It is kept only when its own printed totals add up, and records the checks done, the column headings as printed, the rows, and the source.
src/types.ts::VacancyBreakupTable.tech: Interface {id, documentTitle, documentUrl, pages[], checks[], columns[] (header paths), rows[] {postId, postCode, printedName, zone, counts: {fresh, carriedForward}[], postTotal?, page?}, tableTotal?, provenance}. Exam.vacancyBreakups, produced by the exam builder.

src/types.ts::VerificationLevel.text: How well a piece of information is confirmed: officially verified, still being checked, or replaced by a later official statement.
src/types.ts::VerificationLevel.tech: Union 'OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED' | 'UNDER_VERIFICATION' | 'SUPERSEDED'; the verificationLevel field of DataProvenance.

src/ui.tsx::AIAssistant.text: The Ask GovOS AI chat screen. It answers questions about the exam in hand from GovOS's own record, shows which exam the chat is about, offers starter questions, and labels every answer by what kind of claim it is (official fact, how GovOS works, guidance, needs your details, not in the record) with citations, evidence and 'take me there' buttons. Only for a question the record cannot place, and only if Claude is available, it asks Claude to answer from that exam's facts; the candidate can stop waiting and take the record's own reply, and any Claude failure falls back to it with a note. Switching exam starts a fresh conversation.
src/ui.tsx::AIAssistant.tech: Component (props onOpenProvenanceModal, onNavigate, exam = SSC_CGL_EXAM). respondTo builds buildChatContext(exam, 'ASSISTANT'), calls answerCandidateQuery, appends user/assistant turns to conversationService (subject, intent, examId = switchedExamId || exam.id). If sourceKind is UNVERIFIED (or unverified with no kind) and claudeService.healthCached() is ready, it shows a waiting message and resolveWithClaude calls claudeService.ask(examId, question, last 6 turns), then waitForJob (60 s, 1 s poll, abortable); success shows the Claude answer with ClaudeAnswerBadge/ClaudeAnswerFacts and claudeAnswerAction; failure, ANSWER_REJECTED or timeout cancels the job and shows the register reply with claudeNote. stopWaiting aborts and cancels. On exam.id change it clears the ASSISTANT history, resets to a new greeting and cancels pending Claude jobs. Replies are shown 300-400 ms after sending via setTimeout.

src/ui.tsx::AIAssistantProps.text: Describes what the Ask GovOS AI screen needs: a way to open a fact's evidence, a way to navigate to another part of the app, and the exam being discussed.

src/ui.tsx::APP_SIM_PROVENANCE.tech: DataProvenance constant (id 'prov-app-sim', officialUrl SSC_NOTICE_URL, clauses 'Para 5, 8, 9, 10 and 12', publishedDate 2026-05-21, empty verifiedDate, taxonomyType EXPLANATION, verificationLevel UNDER_VERIFICATION) used for the inline review paper rebuilt in PracticeEngine's handleReviewPastAttempt.

src/ui.tsx::ARCHIVE_WORDS.tech: Case-insensitive RegExp for 'gazette' or the whole word 'archive'; such items become OFFICIAL_PORTAL unless they name question papers or answer keys.

src/ui.tsx::ASSISTANT_FILLER.text: Common filler words (the, is, please, what, exam, kya and so on) that carry no meaning about what the candidate is asking, ignored when judging how much of a question was understood.
src/ui.tsx::ASSISTANT_FILLER.tech: Set of stop words including English function words, question words, 'ssc', 'cgl', 'exam', 'govos', 'platform', 'app' and a few Hinglish words; used by contentWordsOf.

src/ui.tsx::ASSISTANT_PARAPHRASES.text: A list of everyday phrasings and what they mean, so the assistant understands, for example, that ‘who can apply’ is an eligibility question, ‘till when can I fill the form’ means the last date, ‘wrong tick’ means negative marking and ‘hall pass’ means admit card.
src/ui.tsx::ASSISTANT_PARAPHRASES.tech: Array of {pattern: RegExp, means: string}; 16 rules ("who can/may apply|appear" → eligibility, then last date, negative marking, salary, physical test, admit card, vacancies, attempts, tentative, prelims, mains, interview, final year, which post, csat, cutoff). Each match appends its concept; none replaces the words.

src/ui.tsx::AdminTokenField.text: A small password box that appears only when the server requires an admin token for Trust Panel actions. The administrator enters it once and it is kept for the current browser tab only.
src/ui.tsx::AdminTokenField.tech: Props: required. Returns null unless required. Local state seeded from adminToken.get(); 'Use token' calls adminToken.set(value.trim()) (sessionStorage-backed per the services layer) and flips the button to 'Saved for this tab'. Editing the field clears the saved flag.

src/ui.tsx::AdminVerificationPanel.text: The Trust Panel: the back-office screen where a human checker reviews changes before candidates see them. It has tabs for corrigenda (official corrections) and syllabus revisions, for error reports sent in by candidates, and for Live Source Research, where Claude suggests official web pages that the checker then reads, approves or rejects and can add to an exam's Resource Library. In development builds only, it also shows two sample tabs (a source-change monitor and a PDF-reading demo) filled with made-up example data.
src/ui.tsx::AdminVerificationPanel.tech: Tabbed admin component (HEALTH | EXTRACTION | CORRIGENDUM | REPORTS | RESEARCH; HEALTH and EXTRACTION render only when SHOW_DEV_FIXTURES, with hard-coded SourceHealthLog fixtures and a static JSON sample; default tab is CORRIGENDUM in production). CORRIGENDUM lists unresolved fixture conflicts, every exam's corrigendums from ALL_EXAMS, and syllabus revisions for an exam picked from ALL_EXAMS with a syllabus (starts on storageService.getCurrentExamId()); it loads syllabusLiveService.watch(examId, syllabus[0].officialProvenance.verifiedDate) and .revisions(examId), resets the ADD/AMEND/RETIRE form when the exam changes, posts via syllabusLiveService.addRevision (ADD needs subject and name; appliedBy 'GovOS verifier (Trust Panel)') and undoes via retireRevision. REPORTS GETs /api/reports and POSTs /api/reports/<id>/status with adminHeaders() (RESOLVED/REJECTED), showing OFFLINE on failure. RESEARCH loads researchService.getStatus/history(15), resourceLiveService.additions() and claudeService.listJobs(15); runResearch queues researchService.startSearch(query, mode, examId, 8) and waits with claudeService.waitForJob (600 s, 1.5 s poll); per finding it can fetch page text (researchService.extract), run 'Read with Claude' (extract first if needed, then extractFactsWithClaude, 300 s wait), set review status, approve/reject extracted facts, and add a PROMOTED finding to the library via resourceLiveService.addResource (examId = the research exam, addedFrom LIVE_RESEARCH); it also mounts ClaudeSetupNotice, AdminTokenField, ClaudeJobsPanel (cancel/retry) and AuthoritySourceDiscoveryCard. Fetch failures are worded as fetch facts, never as 'not published'.

src/ui.tsx::AdminVerificationPanelProps.text: Describes what the Trust Panel (admin verification screen) needs from the app: a way to open a fact's evidence.
src/ui.tsx::AdminVerificationPanelProps.tech: Interface with a single onOpenProvenanceModal(provenance) callback.

src/ui.tsx::AdmitCardSection.text: The Admit Card part of an exam page. It shows what the exam's authority has actually published about admit cards and exam-city slips, one card per document, with its release date or release rule in the authority's own words. A banner at the top says which of four situations applies: the release date has passed, a release is published, nothing is published yet, or GovOS has not read the authority's documents at all. It also lists what you need to sign in, some general printing tips clearly labelled as GovOS advice, any regional download sites, and a sample admit card that shows only field names, never made-up values.
src/ui.tsx::AdmitCardSection.tech: Props: exam, onNavigateChecklist?, onOpenProvenanceModal. Splits exam.admitCardEvents by kind (ADMIT_CARD vs CITY_INTIMATION; also labels EXAM_INTIMATION); hasBeenRead = events.length > 0, isAvailable = hasBeenRead && some ADMIT_CARD releasedAt <= today; hasAnnouncedDate also considers exam.admitCardDetails.releaseDateStr or a dates[] entry of type ADMIT_CARD. Heading and badge use each event's officialLabel; release shown by releasePrecision (MONTH vs day) or releaseRule. Download button only where an event has downloadUrl, else a 'Sign in' link to portalUrl or exam.officialDomain. Credentials come from events' credentials[] when present, otherwise three generic cards; regional mirrors from admitCardDetails.regionPortals; sample hall ticket fills only the exam date (first non-superseded EXAM_TIER1/2, via shownWhen). selectedRegion state is initialised to 'NR' and never changed (setter unused).

src/ui.tsx::AdmitCardSectionProps.text: The settings handed to an exam's admit card section: the exam itself, and optionally a way to jump to the exam-day checklist and a way to open the evidence panel.
src/ui.tsx::AdmitCardSectionProps.tech: Interface: `exam: Exam`, optional `onNavigateChecklist?: () => void`, optional `onOpenProvenanceModal?: (p: DataProvenance) => void`; consumed by `AdmitCardSection`.

src/ui.tsx::AnswerKeyPanel.text: Lists the answer keys the exam's authority has issued, grouped by the exact paper each key answers. It shows what kind of key it is, when it was published, the viewing window, and whether a later key replaced an earlier one; both are kept. If the authority only shows answers to each candidate through their own login, it says so instead of filling in answers, and it warns when every key belongs to a different exam year.
src/ui.tsx::AnswerKeyPanel.tech: Component {exam, onOpenProvenanceModal}; returns null when exam.answerKeys filtered to identity.examId === exam.id is empty. Derives the page cycle from exam.cycle or a 20xx year in exam.title, flags otherCyclesOnly, and groups keys by identity.describe in a Map. Each key shows kind (verified badge only when sourceStatus === 'OFFICIAL_VERIFIED', else NEEDS REVIEW), publishedAt, 'supersedes the ... key' when key.revises matches a sibling id, windowOpens/windowCloses, entry count or key.note (default text that answers are not public), a notice link (key.url) and EvidenceButton. A group from another cycle carries an 'Another cycle' badge.

src/ui.tsx::ApplicationGuide.text: The 'how to apply' part of an exam page, built from that exam's own notice. It opens with the official portal's address and a button to it, and, where a practice form exists, a switch between the practice form and the written instructions. The instructions have tabs: the application steps (each opens to show its action items, required details and common mistakes), the fee and documents the notice lists, the photo and signature rules, category certificate rules, and rejection pitfalls with their consequences and how to avoid them. Tabs with nothing recorded are hidden, and empty parts say plainly that the record holds nothing rather than inventing rules. For SSC CGL only, it adds a note about SSC's new portal and a checker that tells you whether a category certificate's issue date fits SSC's rules. Every fact has an Evidence button showing where it came from.
src/ui.tsx::ApplicationGuide.tech: Props `guide`, `examId`, `onOpenProvenanceModal`, `initialTab`; `isSscPortal` is `/ssc\.gov\.in/` on `guide.officialPortal`, and `hasSimulator = !!guide.simulator || isSscPortal`. `applicationMode` ('PRACTICE_SIMULATOR' | 'INSTRUCTIONS') starts on the simulator only when there are no official instructions (no otrSteps, requiredDocuments, fee, or photo/signature rules); the simulator branch renders `ExamApplicationSimulator` for `guide.simulator`, else `PracticeApplicationSimulator` on SSC's portal. State also holds `activeTab`, `expandedStep`, `selectedCertCategory`, `certificateIssueDate` and `certValidityResult`, all reset during render when `examId` changes (tracked in `guideExamId`). Tabs render `guide.otrSteps` (accordion; the EvidenceButton stops click propagation), `guide.fee` (named fee rules, `statedAs`, `acceptedModes`, amount-less rules, `exemptions` with evidence) and `guide.requiredDocuments`, `guide.photoRules`/`guide.signatureRules`, `guide.certificateRules` and `guide.rejectionPitfalls`; DOCUMENTS_FEE, CERTIFICATES and PITFALLS appear only when their data exists. `handleCheckCertificate` is shown only on SSC's portal and hard-codes SSC CGL 2026's 25-06-2026 closing date: OBC is always valid (no issue-date window), EWS is valid only if issued on or after 01-04-2026, and every other choice, PwBD included, gets the SC/ST Annexure-IX message; other exams instead get buttons to pick among their recorded certificate rules. No storage or API calls.

src/ui.tsx::ApplicationGuideProps.text: The settings handed to an exam's application guide: the guide's content, which exam it is for, a way to open the evidence panel, and optionally which tab to open first.
src/ui.tsx::ApplicationGuideProps.tech: Interface: `guide: ApplicationGuideData`, `examId: string`, `onOpenProvenanceModal: (provenance: DataProvenance) => void`, optional `initialTab?: ApplicationGuideTab` for deep links (for example straight to documents and fee).

src/ui.tsx::ApplicationGuideTab.text: The list of tabs in an exam's application guide: how to apply, documents and fee, photo and signature, category certificates, and rejection pitfalls.
src/ui.tsx::ApplicationGuideTab.tech: String union 'OTR_STEPS' | 'DOCUMENTS_FEE' | 'PHOTO_SIGNATURE' | 'CERTIFICATES' | 'PITFALLS', used for `ApplicationGuide`'s `activeTab` state and its `initialTab` prop.

src/ui.tsx::ApplicationSourcesPanel.text: Shown in the Application & Documents part of the exam page. It lists where to register and apply: the authority's registration and application portals, other related links, and any practical guidance, each labelled by source.
src/ui.tsx::ApplicationSourcesPanel.tech: items = examResourcesFor(..., 'APPLICATION'); portals = discovered.portals with role OTR_PORTAL or APPLICATION_PORTAL not already linked; guidance = discovered.practicalGuidance; listed = discoveredForSection(..., 'APPLICATION') items not already linked. Returns null when all are empty.

src/ui.tsx::AssistantAction.text: Describes a 'take me there' button the assistant can attach to an answer: its text, which screen it opens, optionally which exam-page section, and which exam it belongs to.
src/ui.tsx::AssistantAction.tech: Exported interface: label, tab (GovOSTab), optional section (stable section id), optional examId - set on actions into exam-bound views so the button opens the exam the answer was about, not whichever is open at click time.

src/ui.tsx::AssistantActionButton.text: The blue 'take me there' button shown under an assistant answer.
src/ui.tsx::AssistantActionButton.tech: Exported component; props action and onNavigate(tab, section?, examId?). On click passes the action's tab, section and examId to onNavigate. Exposes data-action-tab/section/exam attributes for checks.

src/ui.tsx::AssistantReply.text: The shape of one assistant answer: the text, whether it is verified and what kind of claim it is, what it was about (so follow-ups can refer back), and optionally a source citation, a direct link to a resource and a 'take me there' button.
src/ui.tsx::AssistantReply.tech: Interface: switchedExamId?, text, verified, sourceKind?, unresolved? (could not place the question), subject? (recorded for follow-ups), resourceLink? {title, url, label}, citation? {documentTitle, pageNumber, clauseNumber, provenance}, action? (AssistantAction).

src/ui.tsx::AssistantSourceKind.text: The five kinds of answer the assistant can give: an official fact from the record, an explanation of how GovOS works, guidance (advice, not an official rule), a question back to the candidate, or something not in the verified record.
src/ui.tsx::AssistantSourceKind.tech: Exported union 'OFFICIAL' | 'PLATFORM' | 'GUIDANCE' | 'CLARIFY' | 'UNVERIFIED'; drives the badge each chat message wears and whether a reply is sent on to Claude.

src/ui.tsx::AuthorityArt.text: Simple line drawings for exam cards that hint at each authority's world: a clipboard with ticks (staff selection), a columned building with a flag (civil services), a bank with coins and a rising chart (banking), a secretariat with a clock tower and map pin (state commission), and a train (railway). They are GovOS's own drawings, not official logos. It also draws a blackboard with books and an apple for teaching exams, and a drawing sheet with compasses and a turning gear for engineering exams.
src/ui.tsx::AuthorityArt.tech: Component {kind: AuthoritySketch}: SVG viewBox 180x130 (.deck-art, aria-hidden) rendering one of five groups built from SKETCH_LINE and INK, with CSS hook classes (deck-tick-N, deck-chart, deck-lamp, deck-art-glyph). + teaching and engineering groups; the gear turns on hover (.deck-gear), only on a fine pointer without reduced motion.

src/ui.tsx::AuthoritySketch.text: The kinds of drawing that can decorate an exam card: selection commission, civil services, banking, state commission and railway. Two more were added for teaching exams (a blackboard and books) and engineering exams (a drawing sheet, compasses and a gear).
src/ui.tsx::AuthoritySketch.tech: Union 'selection' | 'civil' | 'banking' | 'state' | 'railway'; selects AuthorityArt's drawing. Deliberately not logos or the State Emblem. + 'teaching' | 'engineering'; chosen by authoritySketchOf.

src/ui.tsx::AuthoritySourceDiscoveryCard.text: A Trust Panel card that lets an administrator 'walk' an exam authority's official website to catalogue its documents, portals and listings. It shows when the last walk ran, how much was read, whether it was complete, and for each kind of document what the search could honestly conclude. An optional tick lets Claude name links the rules could not classify; nothing found becomes a candidate fact.
src/ui.tsx::AuthoritySourceDiscoveryCard.tech: Props: examId, optional onQueued. Exam choices are ALL_EXAMS plus the stored current exam if it is not in the register (storageService.getCurrentExamId). On exam change it loads sourceDiscoveryService.forExam(examId, {fresh: true}). 'Walk' calls sourceDiscoveryService.discover(examId, useClaude), then claudeService.waitForJob(jobId, {timeoutMs: 300000, intervalMs: 2000}); on SUCCEEDED it reloads, on other statuses shows errorMessage, on timeout says it is still running. Renders coverage (pagesFetched, officialResources, repositories, exhaustive or counts of fetchFailures/pagesWithoutLinks/unexplored) and each searchStates entry with RESOURCE_ROLE_LABEL. found === null shows 'No answer from the GovOS server'; a non-DISCOVERED state shows found.note.

src/ui.tsx::CAMERA_ORIGIN.text: The point in the picture that the gentle zoom-in centres on.
src/ui.tsx::CAMERA_ORIGIN.tech: {x: 330, y: 430}; ClubSkyline scales the camera group about this point.

src/ui.tsx::CATALOG_SUBJECT_TO_LIBRARY.text: A small translation table from the practice-question subject names to the Resource Library's subject names, so a topic like 'geometry' can point the search at the right shelf.
src/ui.tsx::CATALOG_SUBJECT_TO_LIBRARY.tech: Record mapping TOPIC_CATALOG subjects to library subjects: Quantitative Aptitude -> Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning & General Intelligence -> Reasoning, English Comprehension -> English Comprehension, General Awareness -> General Awareness & Static GK, Computer Proficiency -> Computer & Typing. Used by readNavigatorQuery to infer subjects from parsed topics.

src/ui.tsx::CLAUDE_JOB_LABELS.text: Readable names for each kind of background Claude job (source discovery, reading a page for facts, exam build, and so on), used in the jobs list.
src/ui.tsx::CLAUDE_JOB_LABELS.tech: Record from operation code to label: DISCOVER_SOURCES, EXTRACT_FIELDS, BUILD_EXAM, ORDER_ROADMAP, ANSWER_QUESTION, GENERATE_PRACTICE, DISCOVER_AUTHORITY. Unknown operations fall back to the raw code where it is used.

src/ui.tsx::CLAUDE_NAV_SECTIONS.text: The list of exam-page sections a Claude answer is allowed to point to (Overview, Dates, Eligibility and so on), each with its section number and button text.
src/ui.tsx::CLAUDE_NAV_SECTIONS.tech: Record from Claude's navigateTo code (OVERVIEW, DATES, ELIGIBILITY, APPLICATION, PATTERN, SYLLABUS, ROADMAP, RESOURCES, PRACTICE, CUTOFFS, FAQS, PORTALS, CORRIGENDA, ADMIT_CARD, EXAM_DAY, RESULTS, MOCKS) to {section: stable section id 1-17, label: 'Open ...'}.

src/ui.tsx::CLUB_FAQ.text: The questions and answers about how GovOS works shown on the home page, grouped into Evidence, Dates & alerts, Eligibility, Practice and Ask AI, each with its own colour.
src/ui.tsx::CLUB_FAQ.tech: Array of {key, label, colour, items: ClubFaqItem[]} with five groups (evidence/pink, dates/orange, eligibility/green, practice/periwinkle, ask/cyan) and 11 static Q&A pairs in total; rendered by ClubFAQ.

src/ui.tsx::CLUB_TONE.text: Translates each exam colour theme into the colour name used by the home page's card styles.
src/ui.tsx::CLUB_TONE.tech: Record mapping passToneOf output to CSS colour words: ink to violet, saffron to yellow, jade to green, plum to pink, tide to cyan; used for deck-<colour> and club-<colour> classes.

src/ui.tsx::COMMON_WORDS.text: Ordinary words that the spelling corrector must leave alone (till, form, pass, video, prelims and many more), so it never 'corrects' a real word into something else.
src/ui.tsx::COMMON_WORDS.tech: String array added to the vocabulary built by assistantVocab, so these words count as known and are never rewritten by correctAssistantQuery.

src/ui.tsx::CandidateResultStatus.text: The list of possible result situations the results screen can show, including general ones, UPSC Civil Services ones and IBPS PO ones.
src/ui.tsx::CandidateResultStatus.tech: Union of status strings: generic (TIER2_PREP, BOTH_PASSED_SELECTION, TIER1_FAILED_RECOVERY, TIER2_MISSED_RECOVERY, SKILL_TEST, QUALIFIED_TIER2, DOC_VERIFICATION, NOT_QUALIFIED), UPSC_* (MAINS_PREP, INTERVIEW_PREP, FINAL_SELECTION, CSAT_RECOVERY, PRELIMS_RECOVERY, MAINS_MISSED, FINAL_MISSED) and IBPS_* (MAINS_PREP, INTERVIEW_PREP, FINAL_SELECTION, PRELIMS_RECOVERY). Used for selectedStatus in ResultNextStepsSection.

src/ui.tsx::ChapterHeader.text: A heading that opens each section of the home page: a number, a small label, a big title, an optional line of explanation and an optional button.
src/ui.tsx::ChapterHeader.tech: Component {index, eyebrow, title, sub?, action?} rendering header.chapter-header[data-reveal] with .chapter-index, .chapter-title and an optional .chapter-sub.

src/ui.tsx::ClaimValue.text: The value shown next to an Evidence button: a piece of text, a number, nothing, or a list of alternative ways of writing it.
src/ui.tsx::ClaimValue.tech: Type: string | number | null | undefined | (string | number | null | undefined)[]; consumed by claimInQuote, withClaim and factVerification.

src/ui.tsx::ClaudeAnswerBadge.text: The coloured badge shown on a Claude-written answer, carrying the label chosen by claudeAnswerBadgeText.
src/ui.tsx::ClaudeAnswerBadge.tech: Renders a span with a Bot icon and claudeAnswerBadgeText(answer). Class badge-demo when basis is VERIFIED_DATA and answerVerification is VERIFIED, badge-pending for NEEDS_CLARIFICATION, else badge-changed. Sets data-answer-verification for checks.

src/ui.tsx::ClaudeAnswerFacts.text: Lists the facts a Claude answer relied on, each with its own verification state and its own Evidence button, followed by a note explaining how far the answer as a whole can be trusted. An answer is never presented as verified when only some of its facts are.
src/ui.tsx::ClaudeAnswerFacts.tech: Props: answer (ClaudeAnswerResult), optional onOpenProvenanceModal. For each answer.citations entry computes citationVerification(c) and shows FACT_VERIFICATION_TEXT[state]; renders EvidenceButton with claim = c.claim (if non-empty) else c.text. Footer text depends on basis and answerVerification (VERIFIED / PARTLY_VERIFIED / none verified). Sets data-fact-verification per row.

src/ui.tsx::ClaudeJobsPanel.text: The Trust Panel's list of Claude background jobs. Each shows what it was, its status, current step, duration and short id, with Cancel for running jobs and Retry for failed or cancelled ones; a failure shows a safe reason and a reminder that a tool failure is not a finding about any exam.
src/ui.tsx::ClaudeJobsPanel.tech: Presentational component: props jobs (ClaudeJob[]), onRefresh, onCancel(job), onRetry(job). Active = QUEUED or RUNNING (shows stage and Cancel); FAILED/CANCELLED show Retry; FAILED shows errorMessage and errorCategory. Footer line shows jobId first 8 chars, templateVersion, retryCount and examId. Uses CLAUDE_JOB_LABELS, claudeJobColor and jobSeconds; all actions are delegated to the parent.

src/ui.tsx::ClaudePracticePanel.text: An optional panel, shown only when Claude is ready, where a candidate picks a topic from the exam's syllabus, a number of questions (1-5) and a difficulty, and Claude writes new multiple-choice practice questions. It is clearly labelled as GovOS-written, not an official past question; each answer key was confirmed by a separate independent solve, and questions that failed checks are left out. Clicking an option reveals whether it was right and the explanation; nothing is scored or saved.
src/ui.tsx::ClaudePracticePanel.tech: Props: exam. Topics = unique, whitespace-normalised exam.syllabus topicName values; returns null unless claudeService.healthCached() reports ready and topics exist. 'Write questions' calls claudeService.practice(exam.id, topic, count, difficulty), then waitForJob(jobId, {token, timeoutMs: 120000}); on a wait failure it cancels the job; a non-SUCCEEDED job shows errorMessage. Renders result.questions (stem, options, correct_index, explanation) with one locked pick per question in local state, result.label, a note when answerCheck is INDEPENDENT_SOLVE_AGREED, and the count of result.dropped. No storage writes.

src/ui.tsx::ClaudeSetupNotice.text: An amber notice shown in admin tools when Claude is not available on the server. It explains how to turn it on (install the Claude CLI and sign in, set GOVOS_CLAUDE_ENABLED=1, restart the server) and stresses that no API key is used and the rest of GovOS works without it.
src/ui.tsx::ClaudeSetupNotice.tech: Presentational component taking optional health (ClaudeHealth), message and status. Shows message || health.message || a default sentence, and the status code (status || health.status) in monospace, followed by fixed setup steps. Purely an infrastructure message; never states anything about an exam.

src/ui.tsx::ClubBand.text: A home page band with the headline 'Think inside the notice.', a line saying every rule, date and fee comes from the authority's own document, and buttons to check eligibility and open the timeline.
src/ui.tsx::ClubBand.tech: Component {onEligibility, onTimeline?}: section.club-band.bleed with a two-strip h2, copy text, a JiggleLabel button calling onEligibility and an optional timeline button rendered only when onTimeline is given.

src/ui.tsx::ClubCategories.text: A 'choose from' section on the home page that lists every exam and every career field (such as banking or railways) in big type. As you scroll, the page holds still and the list moves one line at a time, the middle line large and the others faded. Clicking an exam opens it; clicking a field filters the exam browser by it. For people who prefer less motion, it is a plain list.
src/ui.tsx::ClubCategories.tech: Lines interleave exam lines (examDisplayCode, run onOpenExam) and unique careerFields lines (key 'f-<field>', run onField). When motion is on, an effect maps the section's scroll progress p to a smoothstep-eased reel position, translates the <ul>, sets --p and per-item --d (distance, capped at 2) and data-active. A 220 ms settle snaps the scroll to the next line in the direction of travel once 15% past (only while pinned). It re-measures on ResizeObserver, resize and fonts.ready. The section carries data-scroll-rate='0.55' (read by installSmoothWheel), --lines, up to six mini covers, and a 'Find my exam' sticker calling onFind.

src/ui.tsx::ClubFAQ.text: The FAQ section near the bottom of the home page: a side list of categories that jumps to each group, and questions that open in place to show their answers, one at a time.
src/ui.tsx::ClubFAQ.tech: State open (one id 'key-index' or null). The category links preventDefault and scrollIntoView #faq-<key> (smooth unless reduced motion). Each row's button toggles open, with aria-expanded/aria-controls pointing at an answer region whose aria-hidden is !isOpen.

src/ui.tsx::ClubFaqItem.text: One question and its answer in the home page FAQ.

src/ui.tsx::ClubFooter.text: The bottom of the home page: the GovOS logo, the line 'Exams today. A better tomorrow.', the name 'GovOS' in huge letters, and a 'Back to top' button.
src/ui.tsx::ClubFooter.tech: Component {onTop}: footer.club-footer.bleed with a wave SVG, GovOSMark size 64, the tagline, per-letter .cf-char spans (--ci) in a [data-reveal] wordmark, and a button calling onTop.

src/ui.tsx::ClubHero.text: The top banner of the home page: the headline 'Government exams, simplified for you.', a short promise, a search box, 'Find my exam' and 'Explore exams' buttons, one quick chip per exam GovOS holds, counts of exams, authorities and dates on record, and the animated journey picture. Two small stickers show the nearest upcoming dates GovOS holds and open those exams. The quick chips are one per exam GovOS holds and open that exam; the search hint names the first exams held. The stickers only ever use dates that are verified by their own evidence, so an unverified date is never advertised on the home page.
src/ui.tsx::ClubHero.tech: Uses usePointerDepth(stageRef) and an IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.05) to set live, which drives data-live and ClubSkyline's live. milestones = the 2 exams with the smallest nextMilestoneOf days (null days sort as 9999). Figures: exams.length, unique authorityName count, and the count of non-superseded dates. Search input calls onSearch on change and onFind on Enter; chips call onSearch(name). Sticker buttons call onOpenExam. Chips map exams → examDisplayCode and call onOpenExam (they used to search fixed names, including RRB NTPC, which GovOS does not hold). Each exam's dates are filtered to factVerification(d.provenance, dateClaim(d)) === 'VERIFIED' before nextMilestoneOf picks the next one.

src/ui.tsx::ClubHeroProps.text: What the home page's top banner needs: the exams, the search text and its handlers, and actions to find, explore or open an exam.
src/ui.tsx::ClubHeroProps.tech: Interface {exams, searchQuery, onSearch(value), onFind, onExplore, onOpenExam(exam)}.

src/ui.tsx::ClubIntro.text: A short opening animation shown on the first visit in a browser session: the GovOS logo pops in on a coloured screen and a ribbon sweeps away. It never plays for people who prefer less motion and removes itself after about two seconds.
src/ui.tsx::ClubIntro.tech: show state is true only if !prefersReducedMotion() and sessionStorage 'govos_intro_seen' is unset (false if storage throws). When shown it sets that key, adds html.intro-run, hides itself after 2300 ms and removes intro-run at 4200 ms. Renders .club-intro with an SVG ribbon path and GovOSMark size 92.

src/ui.tsx::ClubSkyline.text: The animated picture on the home page: at dawn, a candidate walks a road towards a domed government building flying the national flag, lighting up Discover, Apply, Exam and Result as he reaches each, while the view eases forward and sparks celebrate the result. It runs only while visible; for people who prefer less motion it shows the finished journey as a still picture. A small 'official notice' card with an Evidence tick sits beside it.
src/ui.tsx::ClubSkyline.tech: Component {live=true}. moving = !prefersReducedMotion(); stage starts at -1 (or 3 when not moving). place(f, camera, fade) positions the walker via roadRef.getPointAtLength (scale 0.96 - 0.44f), sets its opacity, the travelled path's stroke-dashoffset and the camera group's scale about CAMERA_ORIGIN, all by direct DOM writes. A layout effect places the start or the finished state; a rAF loop (when moving and live) accumulates elapsed time capped at 0.1 s per frame, waits 1.5 s (2.6 s during intro-run), then applies journeyAt(elapsed mod LOOP_S) and updates stage/walking state only on change. Exposes data-stage and data-walking for CSS.

src/ui.tsx::ClubWaves.text: A decorative wavy ground of three layered bands, drawn at the bottom of coloured banners.
src/ui.tsx::ClubWaves.tech: Component {className?}: SVG (viewBox 1440x360, preserveAspectRatio none) with three grouped wave paths .w1/.w2/.w3 for CSS colouring and animation; aria-hidden.

src/ui.tsx::DEICTIC_WORDS.text: Pointing words like 'it', 'this', 'that', 'same' and 'instead' that refer back to the conversation rather than naming anything new.
src/ui.tsx::DEICTIC_WORDS.tech: RegExp of whole words (it, its, this, that, these, those, them, they, there, same, again, instead, one, ones); used by needsInheritedSubject to ignore such words.

src/ui.tsx::DISCOVERY_FOLLOW_UPS.text: Extra yes/no questions asked only when some post's rule needs them (Statistics in your degree, 60% in Class 12 Maths, physical standards, colour blindness), each with a line saying why it is asked.
src/ui.tsx::DISCOVERY_FOLLOW_UPS.tech: Record keyed by DiscoveryProfileField minus dateOfBirth, category, degree and branch: statisticsInDegree, mathsIn12thWith60Percent, physicalFitnessDeclared, colorBlind, each {label, why}. ExamDiscovery shows only the fields listed in result.missingFields.

src/ui.tsx::DISCOVERY_VERDICT_LABELS.text: The plain-language headings and explanations shown for each eligibility result, such as 'Eligible for some posts' or 'One more answer needed', with their colours.
src/ui.tsx::DISCOVERY_VERDICT_LABELS.tech: Exported Record<DiscoveryVerdict, {title, hint, color, bg}> for ELIGIBLE, CONDITIONAL, INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION, INELIGIBLE and RULES_NOT_AVAILABLE; used by ExamDiscovery for groups and per-post chips so enum text never reaches the screen.

src/ui.tsx::DISCOVERY_VERDICT_ORDER.text: The order in which eligibility result groups are listed, from 'eligible' down to 'not eligible'.
src/ui.tsx::DISCOVERY_VERDICT_ORDER.tech: ['ELIGIBLE', 'CONDITIONAL', 'INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION', 'RULES_NOT_AVAILABLE', 'INELIGIBLE']; ExamDiscovery groups results in this order and drops empty groups.

src/ui.tsx::DevFixtureNote.text: An amber warning that says the data below is sample data used only during development, not something GovOS detected.
src/ui.tsx::DevFixtureNote.tech: Static component with data-dev-fixture='true'; rendered only behind SHOW_DEV_FIXTURES in the Trust Panel's HEALTH and EXTRACTION tabs.

src/ui.tsx::DiscoveryStatusLine.text: A small note saying whether and when GovOS read the authority's website for this exam, how much it read, and what it could not read. If GovOS has not explored the site yet, it says that this is a gap, not a statement about the authority.
src/ui.tsx::DiscoveryStatusLine.tech: Component { exam, discovered }: null while discovered is null; state !== 'DISCOVERED' shows a not-walked note; otherwise prints discoveredAt date, coverage.pagesFetched and officialResources, and either notReadWords(coverage.skipped) or a summary of fetchFailures / pagesWithoutLinks / unexplored.

src/ui.tsx::EVIDENCE_KIND_TEXT.text: The label, short explanation and colours for each kind of evidence shown at the top of the Evidence window.
src/ui.tsx::EVIDENCE_KIND_TEXT.tech: Record<EvidenceKind, {label, means, color, bg}> with entries for DIRECT, RECONCILED, DERIVED, INTERPRETATION and UNSUPPORTED; read by EvidencePanel.

src/ui.tsx::EXAM_BOUND_TABS.text: The screens that always show one particular exam (exam page, eligibility, planner, practice, resources, assistant). A button into one of these must remember which exam it was for.
src/ui.tsx::EXAM_BOUND_TABS.tech: Exported ReadonlySet<GovOSTab>: EXAM_DETAIL, ELIGIBILITY, PLANNER, PRACTICE, RESOURCES, AI_ASSISTANT. Used by actionForExam and assistantDestination.

src/ui.tsx::EXAM_SECTIONS.text: The list of the 13 main parts of every exam's page (Overview, Dates & Timeline, Eligibility & Posts, and so on through Results & Next Steps), each with its fixed number and icon. The numbers are permanent ids used for links into a section, not positions, which is why Mock Tests is number 17.
src/ui.tsx::EXAM_SECTIONS.tech: Constant array of {num, label, icon}: 1 Overview, 2 Dates & Timeline, 3 Eligibility & Posts, 4 Application & Documents, 5 Exam Pattern, 6 Syllabus, 7 Study Roadmap, 8 Resources, 9 Practice & PYQs, 17 Mock Tests, 14 Admit Card, 15 Exam Day, 16 Results & Next Steps. Drives ExamDetailView's side navigation, step bar and previous/next pager.

src/ui.tsx::EligibilityCalculator.text: The 'Am I Eligible?' screen. The candidate fills in a short form (date of birth, category, highest qualification, degree subject, and, only where the exam needs them, maths/statistics and physical-fitness questions) and GovOS checks them against every post of the chosen exam. It shows their exact age on the exam's cut-off date, an overall verdict with the rules it used, and a card per post marked Eligible, Not eligible or Not determined, which can be filtered. Nothing typed here is saved; the form starts with sample values.
src/ui.tsx::EligibilityCalculator.tech: React component (props: onSelectExam, onOpenProvenanceModal, exam defaulting to SSC_CGL_EXAM; onSelectExam is unused in the body). Holds a local UserProfile in state seeded with hard-coded sample values (DOB 2001-05-15, B.Tech, GENERAL, etc.) and a postFilter (ALL/ELIGIBLE/INELIGIBLE/UNDETERMINED/PHYSICAL). Each render runs evaluateEligibility(exam, profile), calculateDetailedAge against exam.crucialEligibilityDate, findAgeRelaxation/getCategoryAgeRelaxation for the category, and qualificationQuestionsFor(exam) to decide whether the Maths-in-12th / Statistics checkboxes show; physical checkboxes show only if some post has physicalRequired. Post cards use postVerdictState and carry an EvidenceButton on the post's provenance. Note the category dropdown's labels ('+3 Yrs' etc.) are static text, while the badge and card text use the exam's recorded relaxation or say none is recorded. No storage or API writes.

src/ui.tsx::EligibilityCalculatorProps.text: What the eligibility calculator page needs: the exam whose posts to check, a way to open another exam, and a way to show evidence.
src/ui.tsx::EligibilityCalculatorProps.tech: Interface {onSelectExam?, onOpenProvenanceModal, exam? (the current exam; the comment says it defaults to the reference exam)}.

src/ui.tsx::ErrorItem.text: One mistake found when the practice application form is checked. It has a title, whether it is critical or only a warning, what went wrong, why it matters, a rule to remember, and the notice clause it is based on.
src/ui.tsx::ErrorItem.tech: Interface: `id`, `title`, `severity: 'CRITICAL' | 'WARNING'`, `problem`, `whyItMatters`, `rememberRule`, `officialClause`. Produced by `evaluateApplication()` in `PracticeApplicationSimulator` and rendered as the red cards on its results screen.

src/ui.tsx::EvidenceButton.text: The single 'Evidence' button placed next to a fact. Clicking it opens the window showing where the fact came from. It does not appear at all when there is no source to show, and it adds 'not verified' when the quote does not contain the value.
src/ui.tsx::EvidenceButton.tech: Applies withClaim(provenance, claim); returns null without onOpen or when !provenanceHasEvidence. Renders a button with data-evidence-id (evidenceId or id), data-evidence-type = evidenceKind, a title naming documentTitle and page, an Eye icon and label ('Evidence' by default), with ' · not verified' for UNSUPPORTED; onClick calls onOpen with the (possibly marked) provenance.

src/ui.tsx::EvidenceButtonProps.text: The settings an Evidence button accepts: the source, what to do when clicked, an optional label and size, and the value it vouches for.
src/ui.tsx::EvidenceButtonProps.tech: Interface: provenance?, onOpen?(p), label? (default 'Evidence'), compact?, style?, claim?: ClaimValue (run through withClaim so a value missing from the quote opens as 'Not in the quoted words').

src/ui.tsx::EvidenceKind.text: The kinds of evidence GovOS can show for a fact: quoted directly, reconciled between an older and newer notice, calculated by GovOS, GovOS's own wording, or 'the quote does not actually contain this value'.
src/ui.tsx::EvidenceKind.tech: Type alias: EvidenceType ('DIRECT' | 'RECONCILED' | 'DERIVED') plus 'INTERPRETATION' | 'UNSUPPORTED'. Returned by evidenceKind() and keyed by EVIDENCE_KIND_TEXT.

src/ui.tsx::EvidencePanel.text: The Evidence window. It shows what kind of evidence a fact has and its honest status (verified, superseded, under verification, source incomplete, or the quote does not contain the value), the authority, document, page, clause, dates, the quoted words, how GovOS calculated a derived figure, and which notice replaced or was replaced. It shows only what the source actually states and fills nothing in.
src/ui.tsx::EvidencePanel.tech: Status precedence: claimNotInQuote, then SUPERSEDED/supersededBy, then provenanceIsVerified, then OFFICIALLY_VERIFIED-but-incomplete ('Source incomplete — not presented as verified'), else 'Under verification'. Rows appear only for present fields (claimNotInQuote as 'Value shown', authorityName, documentTitle, pageNumber, clauseNumber, publishedDate, verifiedDate). Renders the excerpt, derivation.method plus inputs (for DERIVED), supersedes and supersededBy via EvidenceSourceLine, the evidenceId, and an 'Open Official Source' link only for an http(s) URL. Root has data-evidence-id and data-evidence-type.

src/ui.tsx::EvidencePanelProps.text: What the Evidence window needs: the source to describe and a way to close it.

src/ui.tsx::EvidenceSourceLine.text: A small box describing one source inside the Evidence window: the document's name, page and clause, the quoted words and a link to open it.
src/ui.tsx::EvidenceSourceLine.tech: Component {p}: renders documentTitle, 'Page N · clause' (only parts present), the excerpt in quotes if any, and an 'Open this source' link only for an http(s) officialUrl. Used for derivation inputs, supersedes and supersededBy.

src/ui.tsx::ExamApplicationSimulator.text: A practice application form for any exam whose real online form GovOS has written down from the exam's own notice (UPSC CSE is one). It shows the portal's own stages as tabs, the questions on each stage with notes taken from the notice, a 'Next card' button, and on the last stage a summary of everything about to be submitted. When the candidate submits, it checks the answers against the notice's known pitfalls and lists each one that applies, marked 'would be rejected' or 'worth knowing', with why it matters, what to remember and the notice's own words. It also shows how long the form took, and offers buttons to fill it again, open the real portal, or see the evidence. Nothing is saved, and it refuses to appear at all if it is handed another exam's form.
src/ui.tsx::ExamApplicationSimulator.tech: Props `spec`, `examId`, `onOpenProvenanceModal`; returns null and logs `console.error` when `spec.examId !== examId`. State: `moduleIndex`, `values` (field id to string, seeded from each field's `defaultValue`), `isSubmitted`, `startedAt`, `elapsedSeconds`. Fields render by `kind` (TEXT, DATE, SELECT with a full 'Selected:' line for labels over 60 characters, RADIO as buttons) plus `noteFromNotice`; the header shows `spec.modelledOnNote` and an `EvidenceButton` labelled `spec.sourceDocumentTitle`. `ruleFires` evaluates each trap's rule: VALUE_IN, VALUE_IN_ALL, and DATE_OUTSIDE (an empty or unparseable date never fires); fired traps are counted by severity to choose the headline, and with none `spec.cleanSubmissionNote` is shown. Results list each fired trap's title, problem, whyItMatters, rememberRule, `noticeReference` and quoted `officialClause`, with 'Fill it again' (reseeds values and the clock), a link to `spec.portalUrl` and an `EvidenceButton` for `spec.provenance`. It writes no storage and makes no API call.

src/ui.tsx::ExamApplicationSimulatorProp.text: The settings handed to the general practice application form: the exam's own description of its form, which exam is being shown, and a way to open the evidence panel.
src/ui.tsx::ExamApplicationSimulatorProp.tech: Interface: `spec: ApplicationSimulatorSpec`, `examId: string`, `onOpenProvenanceModal: (provenance: DataProvenance) => void`. `examId` is compared with `spec.examId` so one exam's form is never shown under another.

src/ui.tsx::ExamAttemptHistory.text: A small 'Past tests' list showing this exam's own saved practice attempts (up to 10) with their scores. It refreshes when a new attempt is saved and never shows another exam's attempts.
src/ui.tsx::ExamAttemptHistory.tech: Component {exam}. Initial state from storageService.getMockAttempts(exam.id); an effect calls storageService.loadMockAttemptsFromSQLite(exam.id) and keeps only attempts whose canonicalExamId(a.exam_id) equals canonicalExamId(exam.id) (with a cancelled guard). A second effect listens for the window event 'govos:attempt-saved' and bumps reloadKey to re-fetch. Renders count, an empty message, or the first 10 attempts as subject plus score / total_marks.

src/ui.tsx::ExamCalendar.text: The My Timeline page, with two views. 'My exam timeline' shows each tracked exam with its upcoming milestones, a 'Next' countdown and a button to reveal completed ones; 'All exams calendar' lists every exam's dates as a month-by-month agenda that can be filtered to upcoming, all or completed and by month. Each date says what its own evidence supports (officially verified, pending, superseded and so on), dates printed without a day are never counted down to, and the page re-checks the clock every minute.
src/ui.tsx::ExamCalendar.tech: Component with state for the active view, selected month, timeFilter (UPCOMING default) and per-exam 'show past' toggles, plus a now clock refreshed by a 60 s setInterval. Flattens ALL_EXAMS[].dates into events sorted by milestoneTime, each with monthKey, relativeWhen text (blanked when displayWhen is set), and factState = SUPERSEDED or factVerification(provenance, dateClaim(d)) mapped to a STATE_CHIP label. Month chips come from the months actually present; an out-of-range month selection falls back to all. The timeline view excludes SUPERSEDED dates, splits upcoming/completed, and shows ExamVerifiedBadge; the agenda keeps superseded dates struck through. TYPE_WORDS turns ImportantDate types into plain words (EXAM_TIER1/2 read as 'examination'). Calls onToggleTrackExam, onSelectExam, onOpenPreferences; no storage of its own.

src/ui.tsx::ExamCalendarProps.text: Describes what the My Timeline / calendar page needs: how to open an exam, which exams the candidate tracks, how to track or untrack one, how to open notification settings, and which view to start on.
src/ui.tsx::ExamCalendarProps.tech: Interface: onSelectExam(exam), trackedExamIds: string[], onToggleTrackExam(examId), onOpenPreferences(), optional defaultMode 'TIMELINE' | 'CALENDAR'.

src/ui.tsx::ExamCompare.text: The Compare Exams page. The candidate picks two exams from dropdowns and sees them as two facing 'passes' with their next milestone, then a table comparing authority, vacancies, age limits, education, pay levels, number of posts, selection stages, physical standards, latest cut-off, key date and career fields. Every cell is worked out from the exams' own records, and an Explore button opens each exam.
src/ui.tsx::ExamCompare.tech: Component with two exam ids in state (defaults ALL_EXAMS[0] and ALL_EXAMS[1]). Row renderers derive values: age range from min(post.minAge)-max(post.maxAge) with '(varies by post)'; qualification from minimumQualification; distinct payLevels sorted by their first number; stages joined with arrows, or with semicolons when any stage has derivedFrom (pattern-projected order); physical-post count; latest cut-off via cutoffFigure on the highest year; and 'Key Upcoming Date' as the first non-superseded APPLICATION_CLOSE date (else the earliest date) by string sort, shown with shownWhen - note it is not filtered to future dates. Uses nextMilestoneOf, passToneOf, examDisplayCode and PageStage; the table is responsive via CSS. No side effects beyond calling onSelectExam.

src/ui.tsx::ExamCompareProps.text: Describes what the Compare Exams screen needs from the app: a way to open an exam when the candidate clicks 'Explore'.
src/ui.tsx::ExamCompareProps.tech: TypeScript interface for ExamCompare: a single onSelectExam(exam: Exam) callback. (The span also covers the doc comment that introduces SyllabusWatchState.)

src/ui.tsx::ExamDayChecklistSection.text: The Exam Day part of an exam page: a tick-off checklist of the exam's own exam-day instructions (documents to carry, reporting time, allowed and banned items, centre rules, conduct). It never shows a generic list: if no instructions have been extracted for this exam, it says so plainly. A badge says whether the list is source-backed or still under verification, a progress bar shows how much you have packed, and each item can open its source. Your ticks are remembered per exam in the browser.
src/ui.tsx::ExamDayChecklistSection.tech: Status from examDayChecklistStatus(exam): 'NONE' renders an honest 'NOT YET EXTRACTED' card; 'VERIFIED' vs otherwise picks the badge. Items = exam.examDayChecklist, grouped by examDayDisplayCategory into DOCUMENTS / TIMING / ITEMS_ALLOWED / ITEMS_PROHIBITED / CENTRE_INSTRUCTIONS / CONDUCT. Tick state is held as {key, ids} and reloaded during render when examChecklistKey(exam.id) changes, so ticks are only ever written under the key they were read from (writeExamChecklist); Reset writes {}. Each row shows title, description (if different), MANDATORY badge, a source link and an EvidenceButton whose clicks don't toggle the row.

src/ui.tsx::ExamDayChecklistSectionProps.text: The list of inputs the exam-day checklist part of the page needs: the exam, and optionally a way to open the evidence panel.
src/ui.tsx::ExamDayChecklistSectionProps.tech: Props interface for ExamDayChecklistSection: { exam: Exam; onOpenProvenanceModal?: (p: DataProvenance) => void }.

src/ui.tsx::ExamDetailView.text: An exam's own page: a side list of its 13 parts plus four reference parts, a header with the exam's name, authority, verification badge, next milestone, stages and key dates, with buttons to track it, open the official site, report an error, bookmark it or ask the AI. The body shows whichever part is open (overview and posts, timeline, eligibility rules, application guide, pattern, syllabus in three views, roadmap, resources, practice, mock tests, admit card, exam day, results, cut-offs, FAQs, official links, corrigenda), with a status note, a progress bar and previous/next buttons. A 'practice' button anywhere on the page turns to part 09. Switching to another exam resets the page to that exam's starting section, and ticked syllabus topics are only the ones the candidate ticked. For an eligibility test the Quick Info says it fills no post, and a second exam-date tile appears only when the exam has a second stage. An admission test likewise says it fills no post, and the exam level reads as words (‘Class 12’). The Study Roadmap part opens on the study plan GovOS builds for the exam.
src/ui.tsx::ExamDetailView.tech: Exported component taking ExamDetailViewProps. State: activeSection (from initialSection; reset during render when exam.id changes, along with showPastDates, guide index and resource modal), nowTs (ticks every 60 s only while section 2 is open), syllabusWatch (syllabusLiveService.watch(exam.id, verifiedDate)), syllabusViewMode (defaults by examHasStudyPaths), completedTopics (storageService.getCompletedTopics(exam.id) from the first render; an exam.id effect re-reads it), isBookmarked. Effects call storageService.recordInteraction on open and for sections 6/8/12, onSyllabusOpened when section 6 opens, and scroll the active side-nav chip into view. Derived: liveDates (non-SUPERSEDED), header tiles (examHeaderWindowTiles plus stage tiles for EXAM_TIER1/EXAM_TIER2 skipping stageAssociation NEEDS_REVIEW), nextMilestoneOf, stage rail, latestUpdates (top 5). onNavigatePractice = () => turnTo(9) is passed to PostStudyPathEngine and ResultNextStepsSection. Renders SectionStateNote, each section's block (ApplicationGuide, ApplicationSourcesPanel, PatternNodeCard, PublishedSyllabusPanel, PostStudyPathEngine, SyllabusTreeMap, PreparationPlanner, ResourceLibrary, ExamPracticeRouter with PRACTICE/MOCKS scope, AdmitCardSection, ExamDayChecklistSection, ResultNextStepsSection, OfficialDocumentsPanel, OfficialNoticeBoards), a SectionSourcesPanel when SECTION_PANEL_FOR[activeSection] exists, a pager using turnTo (sets the section and smooth-scrolls the card), and ResourceReaderModal. The EXAM_TIER2 header tile is added only when exam.stages has 2+ entries or an EXAM_TIER2 date exists; Quick Info 'Posts' reads 'None — an eligibility test fills no post' for examNature ELIGIBILITY_TEST. ADMISSION_TEST reads 'None — an admission test fills no post'; 'Exam Level' maps minimumQualification through QUALIFICATION_WORDS (it printed the code CLASS_12). Section 07 renders GeneratedStudyPlan (with the syllabus ticks) above PreparationPlanner.

src/ui.tsx::ExamDetailViewProps.text: The list of things the exam page needs from the app around it: the exam to show, and the actions it can trigger such as going home, opening the AI chat, showing a source, reporting an error, tracking the exam, and which section to open first.
src/ui.tsx::ExamDetailViewProps.tech: Interface: exam (required), onOpenProvenanceModal and onOpenReportModal(entityType, entityId) (required); optional onSyllabusOpened, onBackHome, onAskAI, onNavigateEligibility, isTracked, onToggleTrack, initialSection (number) and onSelectAlternativeExam(examCode). Practice is the page's own part 09, so there is no practice or planner callback.

src/ui.tsx::ExamDiscovery.text: The 'Tell us a little about yourself' box on the home page. The candidate gives their date of birth, category and highest qualification, and GovOS checks them against every exam it holds, grouping the results (eligible, some posts, one more answer needed, rules not available, not eligible). Each exam has a 'Why?' view listing every post's result with the age, qualification or physical reason and its evidence, plus a button to open the exam. It asks follow-up questions only when a rule needs them, and assumes nothing.
src/ui.tsx::ExamDiscovery.tech: profile state starts from discoveryProfileFromUserProfile(storageService.getProfile()) and is not written back. run() sets result = discoverExams(profile, exams) and resets openWhy. Follow-up yes/no selects render for result.missingFields found in DISCOVERY_FOLLOW_UPS ('' maps to undefined). Results are grouped by DISCOVERY_VERDICT_ORDER with item.counts, item.summary and per-post reasons labelled by rule (AGE / QUALIFICATION / otherwise Physical) with EvidenceButtons for each provenance. If result.exams is empty it says no records are loaded (not a statement about eligibility). Section id 'exam-discovery'.

src/ui.tsx::ExamDiscoveryProps.text: What the eligibility discovery box needs: the exams to check, a way to open one, and a way to show evidence.

src/ui.tsx::ExamFinder.text: The whole home page. From top to bottom: the banner with search and the journey picture, the fanned row of popular exam cards, the scrolling list of exams and career fields, the 'Think inside the notice' band, the eligibility check, the 'How GovOS works' steps, a 'Recommended for You' shortlist built from what the candidate actually searches, opens, saves and reads (with an activity log they can clear), an exam browser filtered by who you are and what you want, and finally the FAQ and footer. Each exam card can be tracked, saved or opened. The field filter offers the standard fields plus any field an exam’s record declares, such as Teaching & Education. The exam deck near the top shows a card for every exam GovOS holds — the register and the published registry alike — so a newly added exam appears there automatically.
src/ui.tsx::ExamFinder.tech: State: selectedPersona, selectedInterest, searchQuery, recommendations (storageService.getPersonalizedRecommendations(exams)), interactions, bookmarkedIds and showInteractionsModal; refreshRecommendations re-reads all three and runs when trackedExamIds or exams change. handleSearchChange records a SEARCH interaction for the first exam whose title, code or authority matches a 3+ character query. openPopular opens the ALL_EXAMS exam whose id contains the given part, or else searches for it. The browse filter (a two-step .grid-2: qualification, field) keeps exams matching the search, QUALIFICATION_RANK of the persona >= the exam's minimumQualification (missing means shown) and careerFields including the interest (missing or empty means shown). Exam cards show ExamVerifiedBadge (or DEMO DATA), QUALIFICATION_WORDS, getExamCycle and the code (hidden for MACHINE_ACQUIRED); Guide buttons record a VIEW and call onSelectExam. The activity modal lists events with INTERACTION_WEIGHTS times SIGNAL_STRENGTH_MULTIPLIER and the stated decay formula, and its 'Clear All Events' calls storageService.clearUserInteractions(). Nothing on the page writes activity the candidate did not do. `interests` = the six standard fields followed by every careerFields value the exams declare (de-duplicated). ExamPassRail items = exams.map(exam → {name: examDisplayCode, sub: authorityName, sketch: authoritySketchOf(exam), exam, onClick: onSelectExam}); the five hand-written cards (and openPopular, which matched exams by a fragment of their id) are gone.

src/ui.tsx::ExamFinderProps.text: What the home page needs: the exams, ways to open evidence, move between screens, open an exam or the eligibility page, and track exams.
src/ui.tsx::ExamFinderProps.tech: Interface {exams? (default ALL_EXAMS), onOpenProvenanceModal?, onNavigate?(tab, section?), onSelectExam, onNavigateEligibility, trackedExamIds?, onToggleTrackExam?}.

src/ui.tsx::ExamPassItem.text: The details for one card in the home page's fanned row of exam cards: its name, subtitle, the exam (if GovOS has it), what happens on click, and which drawing to show.
src/ui.tsx::ExamPassItem.tech: Interface {name, sub, exam?, onClick, sketch?: AuthoritySketch}; consumed by ExamPassRail.

src/ui.tsx::ExamPassRail.text: A fanned row of overlapping, slightly tilted exam cards on the home page, each in its authority's colour with a drawing, the exam's name, quick facts (number of stages and posts, minimum qualification) and its next date. Pointing at a card brings it forward. A card for an exam GovOS does not have yet says so and offers a search instead.
src/ui.tsx::ExamPassRail.tech: Component {items: ExamPassItem[]}: div.deck role=list; each slot is a button.popular-exam-card.deck-card.deck-<CLUB_TONE colour or 'blank'> with alternating --tilt and --lift. It shows the authority (bracketed acronym if present) or 'coming to GovOS', an optional AuthorityArt, tags (stage and post counts, qualification word) or ['Not in GovOS yet'], and nextMilestoneOf with a day count or the printed date. onClick is item.onClick.

src/ui.tsx::ExamPatternPanel.text: A short summary card of how the exam is scored: each stage with its total marks, time allowed and negative marking, and the sections inside it with their question counts and marks. Used inside each exam's practice area.
src/ui.tsx::ExamPatternPanel.tech: Pure component {exam}. Maps exam.stages to cards showing stageName, totalMarks, optional durationMinutes and negativeMarking, and a pill per stage section (sectionName, optional questions and marks). Holds no exam-specific data; shared by every practice engine.

src/ui.tsx::ExamPracticeRouter.text: The single place that picks the right practice screen for the open exam, used by both Practice & PYQs and Mock Tests. It looks the exam up in the registry, shows the 'not available yet' screen if it has none, and adds the panel of official question-paper sources (outside Mock Tests) and the optional Claude-written practice panel. Switching exam completely resets the practice screen.
src/ui.tsx::ExamPracticeRouter.tech: Exported component {exam, scope='ALL', onOpenProvenanceModal}. Looks up PRACTICE_ENGINES[exam.id]; renders entry.render(...) or UnavailablePracticeEngine, then QuestionPaperSourcesPanel when scope !== 'MOCKS', then ClaudePracticePanel, all inside a React.Fragment keyed by exam.id so every switch remounts the engine.

src/ui.tsx::ExamVerifiedBadge.text: The badge on an exam that says how trustworthy its dates and posts are. It says 'Officially verified' only when every one is verified by its own source; otherwise it says 'N of M facts officially verified', or warns how many facts are not in their quoted source. An exam with no dates or posts gets no badge.
src/ui.tsx::ExamVerifiedBadge.tech: Props {exam: Pick<Exam,'dates'|'posts'>, compact?}. n = unsupportedClaims(exam), shown = examFactStates(exam). Returns null when shown is empty and n is 0; a neutral 'X of Y facts officially verified' badge (data-verified-facts) when n is 0 but not all are VERIFIED; badge-verified 'Officially verified' when all are; otherwise an amber 'N facts not in their quoted source' badge (data-unsupported-claims).

src/ui.tsx::FACT_CANONICAL.text: For each fact topic, the phrase that leads the assistant back to it (for example 'salary' for pay), used when a follow-up borrows the earlier topic.
src/ui.tsx::FACT_CANONICAL.tech: Record from intent id to a phrase that scores on that intent in FACT_INTENTS. Includes interview → 'interview'.

src/ui.tsx::FACT_INTENTS.text: The list of factual topics the assistant can answer (target post, next step, study plan, age, eligibility, dates, pattern, vacancies, pay, syllabus, fee, resources, admit card, cut-off and pass marks, attempts, whether there is an interview, physical standards, whether dates are final, documents to upload, how to apply, practice), each with the phrases that signal it.
src/ui.tsx::FACT_INTENTS.tech: Array of {id, keys}; scored with bestMatch/scoreKeys. 'pattern' includes 'how many papers'; 'cutoff' includes 'pass marks'; 'documents' (documents required/needed/to upload) answers from applicationGuide.requiredDocuments, else falls through to 'apply'. 'interview' (is there an interview / interview / personality test / viva voce / interview marks) answers from the record's stages.

src/ui.tsx::FACT_SUBJECTS.text: Short readable names for each fact topic the assistant answers (for example ‘the age limits’, ‘the documents to upload’), remembered on each answer so a later follow-up knows what was being discussed.
src/ui.tsx::FACT_SUBJECTS.tech: Record from FACT_INTENTS id to subject label (now including documents); stored as AssistantReply.subject. Includes interview → 'the interview'.

src/ui.tsx::FACT_VERIFICATION_TEXT.text: The exact words and colours candidates see for each fact state, such as 'Officially verified' in green or 'Source found — verification pending' in amber.
src/ui.tsx::FACT_VERIFICATION_TEXT.tech: Record<FactVerification, {text, color}>: VERIFIED emerald; UNSUPPORTED, UNDER_VERIFICATION and SUPERSEDED in #a55a05; UNVERIFIED in --text-muted.

src/ui.tsx::FeatureUnavailable.text: A yellow warning box used when an exam does not have the data for a feature yet. It states the title, the reason, and optionally what the candidate can do instead, rather than showing fake content.
src/ui.tsx::FeatureUnavailable.tech: Presentational component {title, reason, nextStep?} rendering an amber-soft box with an AlertTriangle icon, bold title, reason text and optional nextStep line. No state or side effects.

src/ui.tsx::FormState.text: Everything the SSC practice application form holds while the candidate fills it in, grouped by the form's steps. It covers personal details, education (including 12th-class maths percentage and whether statistics was studied), category and relaxation claims, four post preferences, and the photo and signature, either as real uploaded files or as chosen 'trap' examples. It also records whether the declaration box is ticked.
src/ui.tsx::FormState.tech: Interface: personal (`candidateName`, `fatherName`, `motherName`, `dob`, `gender`, `aadhaarNumber`, `nationality`), education (`highestQualification`, `graduationStatus`, `graduationStream`, `mathTwelfthPercentage`, `hasStatisticsInDegree`, `marksheetUpload`), category (`category` 'UR'|'OBC_NCL'|'EWS'|'SC'|'ST', `seekingAgeRelaxation`, `isPwBD`, `isExServiceman`, `certUpload`), `pref1`-`pref4` post ids, and step 5 (`uploadMode` 'REAL_UPLOAD'|'PRESET_TRAPS', `photoType`, `signType`, `photoUpload`, `signUpload`, `declarationAgreed`). Several fields (motherName, aadhaarNumber, nationality, graduationStream, isPwBD, isExServiceman) are seeded but have no input in the rendered form.

src/ui.tsx::FullText.text: Shows a long official passage in full but folded to a few lines, with a 'View full' button to open it. Nothing is cut out; folding only changes how much is visible.
src/ui.tsx::FullText.tech: Props {text, collapseAfter=600, label='clause', style}. When text.length > collapseAfter it measures scrollHeight against 9.6em (ResizeObserver) to decide if it overflows; when folded it applies maxHeight 9.6em with a gradient mask. A toggle button (aria-expanded/controls, id from useId) switches 'View full <label>' and 'Show less'.

src/ui.tsx::GENERIC_EXAM_WORDS.text: Words in exam titles that do not identify any one exam (services, civil, group, commission, state, 2026 and so on), so that a question like 'how many services' is not mistaken for naming a particular exam.
src/ui.tsx::GENERIC_EXAM_WORDS.tech: Set of lower-case words excluded by examNamedIn when deriving an exam's identifying tokens.

src/ui.tsx::GeneratedStudyPlan.text: Section 07’s study plan for every exam: the candidate picks a paper (where there are alternatives), 60/90/120/180 days or the days to the exam, and hours a day; it shows the totals, where the hours go and why, and the plan week by week with a tick box and Evidence for each topic.
src/ui.tsx::GeneratedStudyPlan.tech: Component {exam, completedTopics, onToggleTopic, onOpenProvenanceModal}: prefs from storageService.getStudyPlanPrefs (reset on an exam switch, during render), hours default to the saved daily hours or 4 (labelled an assumption), plan = generateStudyPlan (memoised); ticks are the syllabus ticks of ExamDetailView. Renders “none” honestly when the record has neither topics nor scored sections.

src/ui.tsx::GovOSMark.text: GovOS's own logo: a ring with a bold 'G' whose crossbar is a tick mark. It is drawn in code, not taken from an outside image.
src/ui.tsx::GovOSMark.tech: Component {size=56}: inline 64x64 SVG (circle, G path, tick path) stroked with currentColor, aria-hidden.

src/ui.tsx::GovOSTab.text: The list of names for GovOS's main screens, such as home, exam page, compare, timeline, Ask AI, Trust Panel and My Exams.
src/ui.tsx::GovOSTab.tech: Union of 11 members: 'FINDER' | 'ELIGIBILITY' | 'EXAM_DETAIL' | 'PLANNER' | 'PRACTICE' | 'RESOURCES' | 'COMPARE' | 'CALENDAR' | 'AI_ASSISTANT' | 'ADMIN' | 'MY_EXAMS'. main.tsx switches on it; PLANNER, PRACTICE and RESOURCES are redirected into EXAM_DETAIL by navigate().

src/ui.tsx::Handwritten.text: A short handwritten-style note whose letters drop in one by one; screen readers read it as normal text.
src/ui.tsx::Handwritten.tech: Component {text, className?}: .handwritten span with an .sr-only copy and aria-hidden .hw-word/.hw-char spans; --ci is a running character index across words.

src/ui.tsx::Header.text: GovOS's top bar: the logo (back to home), links to Home, Exam Finder, My Exams (with a count of tracked exams), Compare, My Timeline, Ask AI and Trust Panel, the current exam's name while an exam page is open, the alerts bell with an unread count, and a profile menu. The bar gets smaller once you scroll and takes on the colour of what is beneath it, switching to light text on dark backgrounds.
src/ui.tsx::Header.tech: State: scrolled (scrollY > 24), surface {rgb, dark} sampled via elementsFromPoint just below the bar (only full-width fields of at least 90% viewport width, alpha >= 0.5, ignoring .club-intro/.page-wipe; luminance < 0.5 is dark), throttled to at most one sample per ~90 ms with a trailing read, plus timed re-samples at 120/450/1200/2600 ms per activeTab. It sets --bar-rgb, data-surface and data-scrolled. link() marks the active tab; 'Exam Finder' uses 'not-current' and scrolls to #exam-finder-engine after 60 ms. examShort strips parentheticals and some long phrases from the title. The bell badge caps at '9+'. The profile dropdown (isProfileOpen, closed by an outside mousedown or Esc) shows the owner's card ('Sainath', single-user by design) with buttons to ADMIN, MY_EXAMS, ELIGIBILITY and AI_ASSISTANT.
